title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Principal AI Engineer – R&D is a senior individual-contributor technology leader responsible for defining the architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction for enterprise AI solutions that transform research and development across Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. This role combines hands-on solution design and development with cross-functional technical leadership to build, validate, and scale production-grade AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, and intelligent engineering workflows across product development, systems engineering, software engineering, verification and validation, quality, and regulatory activities. The Principal AI Engineer partners with R&D and technology leaders to identify high-value opportunities, establish reusable architecture patterns and responsible AI controls, mentor engineering teams, and deliver secure, observable, compliant solutions that improve productivity, product quality, traceability, and speed to market. This position reports to the AI Transformation Leader and is part of the Global Technology Organization located in Bangalore, India and will be an on-site role.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Architect and deliver production-grade AI agents, engineering assistants, and agentic workflows that improve requirements development, systems engineering, risk management, design reviews, technical documentation, and end-to-end traceability.
  • Design and scale intelligent solutions that accelerate software development, code and test generation, verification and validation, defect investigation, technical data analysis, and repetitive engineering work.
  • Develop secure and scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions grounded in engineering documentation, standards, technical reports, design history files, and lessons learned.
  • Own the technical direction for agent architecture, orchestration frameworks, model selection and evaluation, reusable design patterns, enterprise integration, and standards for AI governance, validation, security, observability, model risk management, and responsible AI.
  • Partner with R&D, quality, regulatory, security, and technology teams to prioritize high-value use cases, lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and scale solutions that deliver measurable improvements in productivity, product quality, traceability, and speed to market.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical discipline.
  • 14+years of experience developing enterprise software solutions using Python, C#, Java, or similar languages in medical device industry.
  • Experience building AI applications utilizing LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, and cloud AI services (Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent).

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements: if applicable for role

  • 25% Ability to travel domestic and international
  • Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
  • Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 25lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries.
  • Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), requirements management, risk management, or engineering lifecycle tools.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Business Analytics Analyst
description:
Role Summary

The Business Analytics Intermediate Analyst is a developing professional role focused on the credit card and consumer banking sectors. The analyst applies strong analytical skills to solve key business challenges in areas like portfolio management, customer engagement, and profitability. Integrating a solid understanding of the banking and credit card industries, the role involves working independently to interpret complex data, make fact-based recommendations, and communicate findings to stakeholders. The quality and timeliness of this work directly impact the effectiveness of the team and related business units.

Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis and Performance Review: Utilizes hands-on expertise in SAS, SQL, or Python to gather and analyze operational data from various cross-functional stakeholders, examining and reporting on past business performance.
  • Strategic Recommendations: Applies a strong understanding of the credit business to formulate and recommend data-driven actions for future developments, strategic business opportunities, and enhancements to operational policies.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicates analytical findings, insights, and recommendations clearly and effectively to business partners and senior leadership.
  • Process and Strategy Improvement: Works to continuously improve analytical processes and business strategies by exploring, evaluating, and leveraging new data sources, tools, and capabilities.
  • Collaboration on Decision Strategies: Works closely with internal and external business partners to build, implement, track, and improve data-informed decision strategies.
  • Risk and Control Management: Appropriately assesses risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets. This is achieved by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations; adhering to Policy; applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior and business practices; and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of relevant professional experience – preferably across Banking domain
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with SAS, SQL, and/or Python for data analysis and manipulation.
  • Strong understanding of the credit business (e.g., credit cards, personal loans), including key performance drivers and risk principles.
  • Advanced process management skills with a highly organized and detail-oriented approach.
  • Strong ability to generate insights, connect business concepts, and manage stakeholder relationships.

Education

  • Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience is required.
  • Master's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field is preferred.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - Bone Marrow Transplantation and Cellular Therapy
description:
A postdoctoral research associate position is available in the lab of Dr. Senthil Bhoopalan.

Project Description:

Bone marrow failure (BMF) disorders are catastrophic diseases of childhood that result in failure to produce hematopoietic cells leading to severe morbidity and eventually mortality. Treatment options are limited to supportive care and allogeneic bone marrow transplantation. We are interested in developing curative therapies for patients with these rare but severe disorders. Using a combination of disease model systems such as induced pluripotent stem cell-derived hematopoietic stem cells and engineered hematopoietic stem cells from healthy donors to model patient mutations, we have advanced development of gene therapy for Diamond-Blackfan anemia which is anticipated to move to clinic in the coming months. Now we are developing individualized genome editing-based treatments using base editors and prime editors for BMF disorders. As part of an academic/industry team, we recently received funding from ARPA-H to advance development of in vivo genome editing for BMF disorders (https://www.stjude.org/research/departments/hematology/drive.html). This translational project, called DRIVE which stands for Delivering Rare-disease In Vivo Editors, will involve development of preclinical models and pipelines to demonstrate efficacy and safety and accelerated development of personalized bespoke genomic medicines for patients with BMF disorders such as Diamond-Blackfan anemia and GATA2 deficiency. You will work with a multidisciplinary team of scientists with expertise in genome editing, high throughput screens, hematology, cell biology, LNP formulation, technology development and commercialization, cGMP practices, technical writing, regulatory affairs, clinical trial design and project management.


Position Responsibilities:

Develop novel research project(s) and idea(s) in collaboration with mentor Design and perform experiments, interpret data, and communicate results with scientific community Work with mice models of human disease Work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team and with collaborative labs inside and outside St. Jude Generate initial draft for grants and research manuscripts Professional development requirement, including grant writing


Minimum Education and/or Training:

PhD



Special Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

­

  • Experience working with mice
  • Strong background in cell biology and HSC biology
  • Exposure to high-throughput screens, CRISPR/Cas9, base editors will strengthen the application

About the lab and St. Jude:

The Bhoopalan lab’s goal is to advance our mechanistic understanding of human hematopoiesis in health and disease and leverage these findings to develop curative therapies for human blood disorders. The Bhoopalan lab is a diverse multidisciplinary group that utilizes various tools from molecular biology, cell biology, computational data science and translational medicine. Trainees will have access to the deep technical expertise in the lab, and the opportunities to participate in wide range of collaborative efforts, lead projects, learn grantsmanship and develop a path towards independent research.


St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital is a world-class research institution dedicated to pediatric cancer and other catastrophic diseases of childhood. The first and only National Cancer Institute (NCI)-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center devoted solely to children. Our 300 faculty work across the spectrum of basic, translational, clinical, and population science in a highly collaborative multidisciplinary environment that includes a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy of Science and the National Academy of Medicine. St. Jude is ranked on Fortune Magazine’s “Best Workplaces in Health Care & Biopharma” and Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work,” and is located in the heart of Memphis, Tennessee, a vibrant and friendly city at the historic American crossroads of music, trade, food and culture.


We are in pursuit of the brightest minds in biomedical sciences, individuals poised to contribute to our research progress. Other than access to top-quality scientists and mentors, as a postdoctoral trainee at St. Jude, you will have:


  • A Blend of Academic Freedom and Industrial Efficiency: Access to shared resources and facilities led by expert scientists, coupled with cutting-edge technology, accelerates research productivity.
  • Customized Professional and Career Growth: Experience specifically designed programs to enhance professional growth and career readiness empowering postdocs for success beyond their training. This includes access to grant writing workshops, individual development plans, teaching and mentoring opportunities, non-research career advancement programs, professional development allowance, and so much more.
  • Competitive Compensation: Embark on your journey with a competitive salary starting at $72,530 a year, comprehensive benefits and generous relocation assistance, reflecting our commitment to recognize and invest in talent.
  • A Sense of Community: St. Jude fosters a vibrant postdoc community that supports a well-balanced life. A dynamic environment promotes connections and camaraderie among postdocs from all backgrounds.




We are committed to a human-centered hiring experience. Technology may support portions of our process, but recruiting decisions involve human review and engagement. Learn more about our approach to AI.


St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer


No Search Firms

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. Please do not call or email. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

title: Staff Engineer, Flight Test (R6064)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

As a Hivemind Solutions Staff Integration & Flight Test Engineer (ACP Programs), you will serve as a key contributor for the integration, verification, and flight test of Hivemind AI Pilot capabilities on Group 5 UAS/Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP).

You will translate program objectives into executable integration and flight test plans across multiple test environments. Using disciplined test, analysis, and feedback methodologies, you will drive rapid capability maturation while maintaining rigorous safety, configuration control, and mission assurance standards.

This role serves as the technical contributor for integration and flight test execution on assigned ACP programs, responsible for coordinating test readiness, managing technical and safety risk, and leading day-to-day test execution. Here, you will serve as the primary focal point to facilitate coordination across internal program leadership and functional teams, OEM partners, and government customers and stakeholders to deliver high-impact autonomy capabilities at scale. Successful candidates are curious engineers who use disciplined integration and flight test to generate knowledge, reduce technical risk, and accelerate delivery of operational capability.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and execute detailed integration and flight test plans that support the overall program verification and test strategy across simulation, SIL, HIL, ground, and flight test environments
  • Coordinate readiness of simulation environments, integration laboratories, aircraft, and flight test assets required to execute program objectives
  • Apply aviation knowledge, aircraft performance and operational mission understanding to develop safe, efficient, and operationally relevant integration and flight test plans
  • Define test objectives, performance metrics, and success criteria, ensuring traceability from requirements to test outcomes and operational capability
  • Lead and support aircraft integration and flight test activities, including system configuration, software integration, mission planning, real-time troubleshooting, flight execution support, and post-flight data analysis
  • Coordinate with platform OEMs, government ranges, and flight operations personnel to establish test readiness criteria and ensure technical and safety requirements are satisfied prior to test execution
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution across software, hardware, systems engineering, flight operations, safety, and program leadership teams
  • Evaluate test results, identify technical issues, and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and accelerate capability maturation

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 6+ years with a Master’s
  • Demonstrated experience planning, conducting, and evaluating flight test of aircraft systems in military or defense aviation environments
  • Strong understanding of safety-of-flight principles, risk management, and disciplined test execution in aviation environments
  • Demonstrated understanding of aircraft performance, flight operations, and environmental effects influencing aircraft mission planning, test execution, and safety
  • Experience with system-level verification & validation across multiple test environments (SIL, HIL, simulation, and flight)
  • Experience working cross-functionally across software, hardware, avionics, systems engineering, safety, and program teams
  • Experience with scripting or software tools (Python preferred) for test automation, data analysis, or system validation
  • Ability to effectively communicate with pilots, operators, and engineers to develop executable flight test objectives, mission plans, and risk mitigations
  • Excellent technical leadership and communication skills, including briefing to program leadership and external customers
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required

Preferred qualifications:

  • Military aviation experience as aircrew, flight test engineer, mission systems operator, or engineer supporting military aircraft development or test programs
  • Prior role as Flight Test Director, Test Conductor, or Lead Flight Test Engineer on full-scale aircraft programs
  • Understanding of military air operations, mission planning, and Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) supporting autonomous aircraft employment
  • Experience supporting Autonomous Collaborative Platforms (ACP), loyal wingman concepts, or multi-vehicle autonomous systems
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition and developmental test processes
  • Experience operating in or supporting government flight test ranges and operational environments
  • Background in autonomy, AI/ML-enabled systems, or human-machine teaming in aviation contexts
  • Experience with airworthiness processes, flight clearance, and configuration control for aircraft systems
  • Familiarity with tools such as Git, Jira/Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Active SECRET clearance

title: Sr. Kubernetes Platform Engineer
description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Sr. Kubernetes Platform Engineer

Austin TX



Silicon Labs in Austin, Texas is seeking a motivated Sr. Kubernetes Platform Engineer to help define, build, operate, and lifecycle-manage the infrastructure, tools, and platforms required for our organization to operate at scale. This role spans both on-premises and cloud environments, with responsibilities across Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD, identity, observability, cost management, and developer enablement. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience owning CNCF and open-source infrastructure in production, including upgrades, troubleshooting, automation, and long-term maintainability. This is an engineering ownership role, not a support-escalation role; success requires the ability to understand, operate, and improve the platforms we depend on while collaborating closely with software and IT teams and supporting AI/ML initiatives.



Your Responsibilities Will Include:

· Collaboration: Building productive relationships and generously sharing expertise via presentations and training sessions.

· Documentation: Creating and maintaining effective documentation and written communications.

· Automation: Enhancing team productivity by identifying opportunities to automate and eliminate waste in new and existing processes.

· Infrastructure Lifecycle Management: Designing, building, operating, upgrading, and retiring infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments, with attention to reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and developer productivity.

· Kubernetes Platform Ownership: Operating and evolving Kubernetes-based platforms and supporting technologies, including cluster lifecycle, networking, ingress, storage, policy, virtualization, secrets, identity, observability, and cost visibility.

· CNCF and Open-Source Stewardship: Owning and maintaining CNCF and open-source platforms in production, including troubleshooting, upgrades, automation, documentation, and internal enablement. Candidates should be comfortable operating systems where internal expertise is required rather than relying primarily on vendor support.

· Developer Experience: Improving software developer experience and productivity by reducing friction and automating testing and deployments.

· CI/CD Pipelines: Designing, developing, and maintaining CI/CD and GitOps pipelines for software and infrastructure.

· Security, Identity, and Policy Automation: Supporting secure platform operations through policy enforcement, secrets management, workload identity, OIDC integrations, and automated governance.

· Observability: Building and operating observability platforms for metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and service health using modern cloud-native tooling.

· AI/ML Integration: Working with software teams to support development and implementation of AI/ML infrastructure and services.

· Cost Efficiency: Reducing waste and cutting costs in cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure.


Skills and Qualifications Desired:

· Education: Bachelor's degree in a technology-related field or equivalent training.

· Experience: 5+ years in software development, DevOps, Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Platforms engineering, or a related field.

· Hybrid Infrastructure Lifecycle: Experience managing infrastructure lifecycle across on-premises data centers and public cloud, including provisioning, upgrades, patching, scaling, decommissioning, and operational automation.

· Cloud Platforms: Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, etc.; AWS certifications are a plus.

· Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible, Salt, Chef, or similar infrastructure automation tools.

· Programming Languages: Proficiency in at least one language, preferably Go, Python, Groovy, or Java.

· System Administration: Proficiency in Linux, Windows, and macOS system administration; Talos Linux experience is a plus.

· Scripting: *Nix shell and PowerShell scripting experience.

· Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Platforms: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and ecosystem technologies such as Talos Linux, Cilium, Gateway API, CSI, KubeVirt, Kyverno, Helm, and Kustomize.

· CI/CD, GitOps, and Artifact Management: Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, Artifactory, and GitOps-based deployment workflows.

· Secrets, Identity, and Access Management: Experience with Vault, External Secrets Operator, OIDC, Keycloak, Okta, workload identity, and secrets lifecycle management.

· Observability: Experience operating observability stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry.

· Cloud Cost Management: Experience with cloud and Kubernetes cost visibility, optimization, and tools such as OpenCost.

· Open Source Operations: Demonstrated ability to operate, troubleshoot, upgrade, and maintain open-source infrastructure platforms in production.

· Network Administration: Firewalls, ACLs, and core networking concepts including switching, routing, DNS, ingress, and troubleshooting.

· AI/ML Experience: Familiarity with AI and ML frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.

· Certifications: CNCF Kubernetes certifications such as CKA, CKAD, or CKS are a plus.

description:
Family Engagement and Enrollment Coordinator

People, Incorporated is a human service Agency serving the Southcoast community, including the Greater Fall River, New Bedford, and Taunton areas. As a partnership of specialized, integrated programs, we provide unique opportunities to people with life challenges. SUMMARY: The Family Engagement and Enrollment Coordinator serves as a member of the Early Childhood Education team and is responsible for fostering positive relationships with families while supporting enrollment, family engagement, and daily program operations. Guided by the Principles of Family Strengthening and Support, the Coordinator engages with parents and guardians in relationships based on equality and respect, recognizing their existing strengths, resilience, and resources.   • Skills in oral and written communication

To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.

title: Firmwide BIM Lead
description:
At SOM, we are a collective committed to shaping a better future for our clients, communities and planet. We aspire to create the most sustainable, impactful work through creative, interdisciplinary teams with all the resources and diversity of a global firm. We value those who are passionate about excellence, innovation, integrity, inclusivity, and collaboration. Together we can achieve great things.

Success at SOM Means

  • Ideas: We believe in a meritocracy of ideas. We look to everyone to actively contribute to the discourse in the firm.
  • Knowledge: We believe that expertise is the result of lifelong learning. We are not expected to know everything, but rather to passionately pursue answers, develop new skills and deepen our knowledge.
  • Product: We strive for excellence in the concept, quality, and delivery of our work.
  • Individual: We value individuals who bring the highest standards of professionalism and personal integrity in the way they work. Each person can develop and contribute their wealth of attributes, skills and knowledge to support the overall health of the firm.
  • Team: We value the power of interdisciplinary integration. A positive team culture in which everyone collaborates openly towards common goals is essential.
  • Firm: We have a history of making transformative contributions to the profession and our communities. We are constantly innovating and attempting to bring new approaches, solutions and processes to our work.


Position Responsibilities


You will be responsible for the development and firmwide implementation of BIM workflows, custom applications, and integrations across our architecture and structural engineering disciplines’ digital ecosystem.


  • Explores, defines, and helps oversee the firmwide implementation of SOM’s BIM workflows across the full project lifecycle for our architecture and structural engineering disciplines, working with the firmwide Design Technology team.
  • Works with the BIM Standards Lead to establish standards, assets, guidelines, and best practices for BIM workflows, collaborating with SOM’s firmwide Design Technology team, BIM leaders, and computational design experts.
  • Develop, test, and deploy automation and agentic tools and standardized workflows for delivery phases to streamline documentation and reduce manual effort. This may include automated sheet creation, model data organization, automated dimensioning and tagging, and model health checking.
  • Implement automated QA/QC protocols and data-validation pipelines to ensure models meet required Level of Development (LOD) standards, internal modeling and drawing standards, and contain accurate asset and material parameters required for downstream construction coordination, cost and embodied carbon tracking.
  • Design and support digital workflows for coordination and Construction Administration, including model-based issue tracking, coordination clash resolution, digital submittal reviews, and tracking of field changes to maintain design integrity through construction.
  • Develops and implements BIM data management strategies for projects of various types, phases, and scales to fulfill client deliverables and directly feed our internal data lakehouse of project design information.
  • Maintains comprehensive documentation of standard assets and workﬂows.
  • Develops training plans and materials for SOM's BIM best practices. In support of training the trainers, organizes and conducts initial training sessions to promote BIM workflows and best practices as part of program roll-outs.
  • Contributes to tools and processes related to project speciﬁcations, tracking of material lists, energy, water and carbon use intensities on Projects.
  • Leads organization, management and maintenance of BIM technologies and other related resources in collaboration with the Oﬃce of Technology.
  • Keeps informed of industry standards, trends and developments related to BIM practices.
  • Performs quality assurance testing of new tools related to BIM or asset management.
  • Manages planning, development and advancement of innovative ideas/solutions to support BIM workﬂow. Coordinates such development with other Design Technology subject matter experts.
  • Manages external parties to develop standard content or custom tool development within the framework and infrastructure deﬁned by Oﬃce of Technology; Manages change, adoption and integration of new standard or workﬂow into existing BIM workﬂows.
  • Additional expertise in one or more of the following specialities is highly beneficial: computational design, environmental performance analysis, visualization, AI-driven automation and design, scripting and software development, digital fabrication, DfMA / industrialized construction, and construction-phase BIM efforts.

Leadership Responsibilities


  • Fosters collaborative relationships with BIM Leads, discipline subject matter experts, and knowledge leaders to align BIM standards and workflows with project delivery goals and SOM's overall technology vision.
  • Drives strategic initiatives and delivery methods to maintain SOM's leadership position in BIM services and project delivery.
  • Champion the strategic exploration, testing, and piloting of emerging project delivery methods and cloud-first "BIM 2.0" ecosystems (such as multi-platform interoperability, open data environments, and cloud-native collaboration tools) to future-proof firm workflows.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate artificial intelligence, design-assist agents, and advanced scripting into delivery workflows, scaling productivity gains while ensuring appropriate governance and data quality.
  • Partner with regional BIM leaders, technical design directors, and sustainability teams to bridge the gap between design intent and construction-phase execution, establishing unified global standards that enhance cross-office collaboration and data continuity.
  • Co-leads and organizes regular ﬁrm-wide BIM Leadership meetings with regional BIM and Design Technology Leads.
  • Engages in talent strategy to ﬁnd specialists, leaders, and future professionals for the ﬁrm.
  • Keeps informed of security risks in tools and processes, and data management strategies through close collaboration with the Oﬃce of Technology.
  • Creates and drives new ways of working through contributing to the development of services, standards, procedures based in an understanding of the business principles that protect SOM from ﬁnancial and legal risk.
  • Effectively communicates and promotes the work of the ﬁrm.

Minimum Qualiﬁcations


  • Completion of a professional degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related ﬁeld.
  • Minimum 8 years of focused professional experience in applying and developing digital tools and processes to AEC project work, including experience in Revit to document a variety of large-scale building projects.
  • Demonstrates attention to detail and consistency in the work.
  • General knowledge of architectural practice including site-planning, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical engineering, and construction.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of architectural design, documentation, detailing, building materials, construction techniques, building systems selection, related engineering principles and building codes.
  • Wide knowledge of concepts, workﬂows and tools used in other design technology ﬁelds such as Computational Design, Performance Analysis/Simulation, Visualization, etc.
  • General understanding of sustainable strategies and principles including familiarity with LEED or other green building rating systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in digital tools such as Revit, Forma, Dynamo, and Revizto.
  • Demonstrated understanding of scripting, programming, Grasshopper, Rhino and their relationship to BIM workﬂow.
  • Demonstrated experience in data visualization and ability to create engaging visual communication.
  • Demonstrates proﬁciency in Google Workspace, Adobe, Miro, and other business communication and collaboration tools.
  • LEED or other green building accreditation preferred.


Are you ready to join a team of creative professionals working on transformational projects around the world? Take advantage of this exciting opportunity to build a better future with SOM.


Compensation for this role is based upon experience, qualifications, location, and education and typically ranges from $140,000 to $160,000.

JOB DESCRIPTION


The Director of Case Management is a senior leadership position within the Fifth Judicial Circuit. This role is responsible for directing, strengthening, and expanding the circuit’s Case Management, Problem-Solving Court, and Mediation Services operations across all five counties.


The Director serves as a key member of the Circuit’s senior management team, providing strategic direction, supervising multidisciplinary staff, and ensuring uniform, high‑quality service delivery. The position requires a confident, experienced leader capable of managing complex systems, building effective teams, and working collaboratively with internal and external justice partners.


The Director works independently and reports major activities, trends, and operational issues to the Trial Court Administrator and/or Chief Judge during scheduled leadership meetings. Travel within the 5th Judicial Circuit is required.


DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS OF WORK


The Director of Case Management:

  • Leads circuit‑wide case management initiatives for family, civil, and dependency.
  • Supervises all Mediation Services operations, ensuring mediators follow established standards, deliver high‑quality service, and maintain consistent procedures across all circuit locations.
  • Oversees all Problem-Solving Court programs, including staffing, workflows, compliance with program requirements, and coordination with treatment providers and justice partners.
  • Ensures compliance with Florida Statutes, court rules, Administrative Orders, OSCA directives, and established circuit policies.
  • Manages state and county budgets, grants, inventory, equipment, and program resources with strong fiscal accountability.
  • Oversees performance standards, data integrity, workflow efficiency, and consistent procedures across Citrus, Hernando, Lake, Marion, and Sumter Counties.
  • Serves as a primary liaison with justice partners, including the State Attorney’s Office, Public Defender’s Office, Regional Counsel, DCF, DJJ, Clerks of Court, and OSCA.
  • Provides leadership and guidance to Case Managers, Mediation staff, and Problem‑Solving Court personnel, promoting high professional standards, teamwork, and innovation.



EDUCATION AND TRAINING GUIDELINES

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or public administration, social work, law, or a closely related field.
  • Five years of related professional experience, including at least two years of supervisory experience.
  • Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum County Court Mediation certification preferred: required within 6 months of hire

  • Comprehensive understanding of Florida Statutes, court rules, and judicial branch policies.

  • Strong leadership and supervisory skills, with the ability to coach, motivate, and manage staff.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and handle sensitive matters appropriately.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast‑paced environment with frequent interruptions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, specialized court applications, and general technology systems.

title: Senior Vice President, Client Implementations, Revenue Cycle (REMOTE)
description:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.
Position Summary
The SVP, Implementation is responsible for overseeing all functions included with new and existing contract/client implementations, client system conversions, relevant internal onboarding initiatives, enhanced solution design, internal enhancement initiatives and general efficiency enhancements. This role will plan, execute, and coordinate onboarding customers into the EnableComp service suite. The VP is responsible for managing an implementation team and ultimately accountable for timelines, deliverables, and client satisfaction. The VP, Implementation will continually analyze existing solution-delivery effectiveness, inter- and intra-departmental efficiencies, and product integration efficiencies existing solutions for internal/external customers and recommend, prioritize, and execute enhancing relevant processes. This role also contributes heavily to internal change management functions and general integration/adoption efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Implementation team, comprised of project managers and analysts, responsible and accountable for all software-based product implementations and service integration activities for new and existing clients
  • Provide leadership and guidance to internal resources and clients for best-possible solution design in a software-based environment, including integration methods with major Health Information Systems and Clearinghouses such as Epic, Soarian, McKesson, Emdeon, Experian and others.
  • Represent the Company's operational expertise and develop and manage executive relationships with the appropriate client representatives while ensuring immediate resolution of client reported issues and other actionable items.
  • Develop and implement processes to plan, track, monitor, and measure the status and effectiveness of the implementation organization, most importantly time to delivery, quality, and client satisfaction.
  • Ensure Business Roadmap and objectives are aligned with IT Roadmap by planning needs and objectives from all functional areas including Operations (COO), Sales/Marketing (CSMO), Finance (CFO), and IT (CFO).

description:

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Embark on a transformative journey as ML Operations Engineer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first-class support to our clients with expertise and care.

Purpose of the role:

To design, implement, and maintain robust MLOps frameworks that streamline the deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models, ensuring efficient and reliable production operations on AWS.

Responsibilities of the role:

  • Build and optimize scalable, secure, and cost-effective AWS-based infrastructure for ML/GenAI workloads

  • Develop automated workflows for data ingestion, model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring using tools like AWS SageMaker, Step Functions, and Lambda

  • Implement data quality checks, lineage tracking, and compliance standards for curated datasets

  • Integrate ML pipelines with DevOps practices, ensuring seamless collaboration between data science and engineering teams

  • Deploy monitoring solutions for model performance, drift detection, and system health using AWS CloudWatch and custom dashboards

  • Ensure adherence to security best practices and governance requirements for AI deployments

  • Work closely with Data Scientists to operationalize models and optimize deployment strategies

Technical skills required for this role include:

  • Experience in Programming & Automation: Python, Bash, SQL.

  • Worked in MLOps Tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker Pipelines.

  • Cloud Platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch)

  • DevOps: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Docker, Kubernetes

  • Data Management: Data curation, governance, and ETL processes.

The ML Ops Engineer role focuses on building and managing automated pipelines, AWS-based architectures, and monitoring frameworks to enable efficient deployment and lifecycle management of AI and Generative AI models in production environments.

This role requires a flexible working approach, ensuring availability during select hours that overlap with US-based partners and stakeholders.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based out of Noida.

title: Lot Attendant - Melrose Wakefield Hospital
description:
About Towne

Towne is an exceptional arrival through departure experience company. With its best-in-class parking and hospitality solutions and its fully integrated technology platform, we deliver seamless parking and mobility experiences in the places where people live, learn, work, play, rejuvenate, and recover. Towne’s 14,000 team members create smiles by delivering exceptional experiences for the millions of people we proudly serve each year. For nearly 40 years, Towne has been committed to providing the best experience, delivered by the best team, powered by innovative technology, enhancing lives and communities. For more information, visit and follow us on LinkedIn.



Click here for important notices that may be applicable to you.

For more information about our privacy policy, please click here.

Job Details

Compensation: Towne Park is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location. The hourly base pay range for this position is $18 per hour.

Work Schedule: The work schedule for this position is Monday-Friday 9am-2pm.


Benefits: Employees are eligible to enroll in accident insurance, critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, and telemedicine benefits. Employees are also able to enroll in the company’s 401k retirement savings plan.


Eligibility requirements depend on your job classification, length of employment and number of hours worked. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.


Seasonal and temporary roles are not eligible for benefits outlined above.


SUMMARY


The Lot Attendant is responsible for accurately collecting and reconciling revenue and parking reports while providing exceptional hospitality services in an attentive, friendly and efficient manner to all guests during their entire stay. The Lot Attendant is also responsible, when stacking is necessary, for properly parking and retrieving guest vehicles while exhibiting standards of exceptional customer service. The Lot Attendant, when required, is also responsible for upholding sites management teams parking policy and procedures.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform all functions.


Descriptive Statement(s) - % of Time

  • Maintains pleasant, friendly and professional demeanor with all guests, location staff and co-workers. Acknowledges and greets guests immediately while maintaining a professional and friendly demeanor. Uses guest last name at all times when appropriate.-15%
  • Maintains accuracy and composure while under pressure. Appropriately uses salutation of the day and welcome guests to the location. Uses proper Towne Park phone etiquette. Assists guests with directions and all other inquiries. Stands while serving guests.- 15%
  • Provides information about surrounding area as well as main attractions to guests as needed. Protects guest confidentiality in accordance with HIPPA requirements. Maintains the security of customer financial and identifying information.- 10%
  • Stacks vehicles when necessary using Towne Park standards for parking. Properly secures keys for stacked vehicles. Promptly retrieves a stacked vehicle and drives slow and cautiously when delivering vehicle to the guest(s). Collects data in accordance with parking operations, if applicable.-20%
  • Collects and reconciles revenue accurately; furnishes receipt upon request. Accurately categorizes tickets for audit purposes. Accurately completes shift report. Follows all bank standard operating procedures. Competently operates equipment (i.e., register, gate, POS, credit card machine, etc.).-20%
  • Obtains information about daily events and rates to be charged. Secures guest keys immediately after each interaction. Maintains claim checks and guest folio archives. Produces guest vehicle inventory for billing purposes.-20%

The total amount of time for all functions of the job - 100%


QUALIFICATIONS


Education:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); OR

Required Licensure, Certification, etc.:

  • Must be at least 18 years of age and be able to pass a criminal background check and drug screen
  • A valid driver’s license and clean driving record

Work Experience:

  • One to three months related experience and/or training; OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of customer service

Skills:

  • Customer service experience preferred
  • Register/Computer experience preferred
  • Must be able to drive manual transmission and perform parallel parking
  • Must be able to read and write standard English language
  • Must be able to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence and memos
  • Must be able to write simple correspondence
  • Must be able to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to guests, clients and other employees of the organization
  • Ability to add and subtract three digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10’s and 100’s; ability to perform these operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume and distance
  • Ability to understand 24 hour and military time systems
  • Ability to understand rates applicable to time passed

SCOPE

Authority to Act:

  • Job is fairly routine. Incumbent follows established practices and procedures. Duties are performed with specific directions given and work is checked or verified on a frequent basis. Decisions are made within specific operational instructions and departmental guidelines. Errors in judgment could affect the smooth and efficient operation of the department.

Budget Responsibility:

  • The employee has control over resources available only

WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL DEMANDS


The working conditions and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Physical Requirements


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit or stand for extended periods of time and may be required to run; walk; handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.


Lifting Requirements

Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.


Working Environment

The majority of work will be performed outdoors for extended periods of time including up to the entire duration of shift. Employees are subject to environmental conditions including extreme heat and cold weather. Protection from weather conditions may be provided, but not necessarily from temperature changes.


Travel

Travel of up to 5% may be required.

ACKNOWLEDGEMENT AND ACCEPTANCE

I understand that every effort has been made to make this job description as complete as possible. However, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties that I will be required to perform. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or is a logical assignment of the position. I accept that at any time there may be modifications or changes to the above job description.

description:

Major Responsibilities:
  • Acts as a resource to employees and students, which includes training/orienting and providing day-to-day work direction. Assigns, monitors, and reviews progress and accuracy of work. Monitors productivity, maintains appropriate staffing levels, directs efforts and provides guidance on more complex issues.
  • Assists with human resource responsibilities, which may include interviewing and selection of new employees, staff development, resolution of employee concerns, and employee morale. Assists in interpreting department policies and procedures, and advises and updates staff on procedural changes.
  • Monitors general department operations, adjusts schedules, records essential information and ensures that work is completed in a timely manner. Conducts daily checks on employee staffing and makes adjustments/substitutes as necessary; assigns non-routine tasks and duties.
  • Provides work direction and guidance to designated food service staff and assigns tasks to provide efficient and timely service. Maintains a quality food production operation for internal and external customers. Assists in resolving issues, dealing with customer complaints, workflow, employee staffing, and equipment failures during the shift.
  • Acts as a resource person, works with employees to resolve problems, complex issues and provides training in food preparation, pre-serving/serving activities, recipe standardization, cashiering, infection control, fire safety, and cleanup activities.
  • Forecasts amount of required food for patients, cafeterias, and special functions; maintains records of meal census and food usage.
  • Capable of managing and responding to purchasing, tray-line, cafeteria, and/or special function requests.
  • Inspects equipment and work areas to ensure proper use, maintenance and sanitation standards and corrects deficiencies as required.
  • Utilizes established production safety and sanitation standards to ensure safe food handling techniques and prevent bacteria contamination.
  • May function as a Food Service Assistant or Food Ambassador which may include assembly and delivery of patient meals, dish room and cleaning duties, assisting patients, cash handling, balance sheets, food production, servicing cafeteria customers, preparing, serving and maintaining supplies of food, and utensils.

Licensure, Registration, and/or Certification Required:
  • ServSafe Food Handler certification issued by the National Restaurant Association needs to be obtained within 1 year.

Education Required:
  • High School Graduate.

Experience Required:
  • Typically requires 3 years of experience in food preparation, service techniques, cashiering and sanitation standards, general and modified diets, in a large hospital or hotel/restaurant food service environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required:
  • Strong knowledge in food service from within a hospital, restaurant or a related environment.
  • Excellent customer service skills and communication skills to effectively interact with a variety of people. The ability to work in close cooperation with nursing personal is required.
  • Ability to read and understand written and oral communications.
  • Must be self directed, able to work independently and make decisions with minimal supervisor.
  • Ability to maintain a friendly and cheerful demeanor, reflecting the culture of healing.
  • Excellent phone etiquette.
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of food/drug interactions and food allergens.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.
  • Intermediate computer skills in Microsoft Office or similar products. Ability to use e-mail and internet.
  • Must be self-directed.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:
  • Operates equipment (i.e. dish-machine, tray line, garbage disposal, etc.) necessary to perform the job. Demonstrating ability to safely and effectively, utilize necessary power equipment.
  • Stands walks and reaches above shoulders the majority of the workday as well as squats, bends, twists, kneels and climbs throughout shift.
  • Must be able to:
  • lift up to 40 lbs. from floor to a maximum 5 ft.
  • lift and carry up to 40 lbs. at waist height a reasonable distance.
  • Must be able to:
  • push/pull with 20 lbs. of force.
  • Working atmosphere also contains fumes, odors, and dust/dirt. floor, spices, etc. (Fumes are trucks, dust/dirt from storeroom or cleaning agents).
  • May be exposed to mechanical, electrical and chemical hazards. Protective clothing must be worn as necessary.
  • May be required to enter patient isolation rooms wearing appropriate coverings during meal service tray delivery and pick up.
  • Will be exposed to sharp knives, other sharp cooking utensils, heat from ovens and other hazards in a kitchen environment.

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. title: Landscaping Job Coach (Rancho Cucamonga)
description:
Introduction

At VIP, Inc., people are at the heart of our mission. With over 260 passionate team members, we are dedicated to improving the lives of individuals with disabilities. Each year, we support more than 700 individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, helping them build the skills they need to succeed in the workplace and thrive independently.

Position Purpose

We’re hiring a Landscaping Job Coach to join our team. If you have landscaping experience, enjoy working outdoors, and want to make a meaningful impact by helping individuals with disabilities develop valuable workplace skills, this role is for you. As a Landscaping Job Coach, you’ll work side-by-side with a small group of clients, providing hands-on training, guidance, and support while completing landscaping work at various job sites.

Schedule & Pay

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.

  • Starting Pay: $20.00 per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Perform a variety of landscaping tasks, including mowing, edging, trimming, planting, watering, weeding, fertilizing, and monitoring plant health.

  • Work side-by-side with a small group of clients (typically 3 clients), providing hands-on training, instruction, and support.

  • Demonstrate proper landscaping techniques and help clients develop job skills, independence, and confidence.

  • Provide supervision and guidance while ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to job-site expectations.

  • Track and document client progress through weekly notes and other required documentation.

  • Communicate with supervisors and case managers regarding client progress, needs, and challenges.

  • Maintain professional and positive relationships with VIP’s business partners and job-site contacts.

  • Help create a positive, respectful, and supportive work environment for clients.

What We’re Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Must be 21 years of age or older.

  • Valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and vehicle registration required.

  • Landscaping knowledge or previous landscaping experience required.

  • Experience working with individuals with disabilities is preferred, but not required.

  • Comfortable working outdoors and performing physical landscaping duties.

  • Ability to provide hands-on instruction and work effectively with a small group.

  • Reliable, patient, and motivated to help others succeed.

Why VIP

  • Starting pay: $20.00/hour

  • Monday–Friday schedule with weekends off

  • Health, dental, vision, and life insurance options

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Paid time off & holidays

  • Employee discounts on theme parks, retail, entertainment, and more

  • Opportunities for growth in a supportive, people-first culture

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful difference while helping others develop valuable workplace skills

Other job titles may include: Landscaper, Gardener, Groundskeeper, Maintenance Worker, Job Coach, and Direct Support Professional.

Equal Opportunity Statement

VIP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, or retaliation. All employment decisions—including hiring, promotion, discipline, or termination—are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and job requirements. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or partnership status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.

title: Microsoft 365 Solutions Lead
location: NSW - Sydney, CBD, Inner West and Eastern Suburbs
description:
Job Description:

Microsoft 365 Solutions Lead


Better and fairer care. Always.

St Vincent’s has been a leader in Australia’s health and aged care landscape for more than 165 years. Since our founders, the Sisters of Charity, opened our first hospital in 1857, our services and nearly 30,000 people have been behind some of Australia’s most important medical breakthroughs. We are a microcosm of Australia’s health and aged care system and are uniquely positioned to lead and respond to our rapidly changing environment.

We are looking for a special kind of person. A St Vincent’s kind of person. Someone who puts excellence, compassion, connection and caring for other people at the heart of everything they do.

Reporting directly to the Head of EUC & Assets, the Microsoft 365 Solutions Lead is a pivotal enterprise technology leadership role responsible for the strategic ownership, governance and optimisation of St Vincent’s Health Australia’s Microsoft 365 ecosystem. This includes Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Entra ID and Power Platform services. The role is responsible for ensuring our digital workplace remains secure, compliant, innovative and aligned to organisational priorities while supporting more than 30,000 employees, contractors and partners nationally.

You will drive the future direction of Microsoft 365, digital workplace technologies and Copilot AI-enabled productivity across SVHA, working closely with Cyber Security, Infrastructure Operations, Service Management, Information Management and business stakeholders to maximise organisational value from Microsoft technologies. You will also serve as SVHA’s primary operational relationship manager for Microsoft, helping shape the organisation’s digital workplace roadmap.

This is a Permanent Full-Time position based in Brisbane, Sydney or Melbourne with a hybrid working arrangement of three days per week in the office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and govern SVHA’s enterprise Microsoft 365 platform and associated services.
  • Develop and maintain the strategic roadmap for Microsoft 365, Digital Workplace and Copilot capabilities.
  • Lead governance, adoption and value realisation initiatives for Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled workplace technologies.
  • Optimise Microsoft licensing investments through utilisation analysis, forecasting and commercial governance.
  • Manage strategic relationships with Microsoft, support providers and licensing partners.
  • Lead organisational adoption, communication and change initiatives that increase productivity and employee experience outcomes.
  • Monitor platform health, performance, governance compliance and service maturity, providing strategic insights and recommendations to leadership.

Things That Work For Us

Microsoft 365 Strategy & Governance

  • Establish and maintain enterprise governance frameworks, standards and operating models across Microsoft 365 services.
  • Define and execute the strategic roadmap for Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Viva, Entra ID and related services.
  • Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and identify opportunities to improve collaboration, productivity and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to the evolution of SVHA’s Digital Workplace and AI strategies.

Microsoft 365 Service Ownership

  • Act as the enterprise owner and custodian of the Microsoft 365 platform.
  • Ensure services remain secure, compliant, scalable and aligned to organisational requirements.
  • Manage tenant governance, administration standards, delegated access and platform lifecycle activities.
  • Drive continual service improvement and platform maturity initiatives.

Microsoft Copilot & AI Enablement

  • Lead governance, administration and adoption of Microsoft Copilot capabilities across the organisation.
  • Develop standards, policies and best-practice guidance supporting the responsible use of AI technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation and emerging Microsoft capabilities to improve employee productivity and experience.
  • Partner with stakeholders to develop use cases and value realisation outcomes.

Security, Compliance & Information Governance

  • Support information protection, data governance, records management and lifecycle management capabilities.
  • Partner with Cyber Security, Information Management and Risk teams to maintain a secure and compliant environment.
  • Ensure Microsoft 365 governance aligns with privacy, healthcare and regulatory requirements.

Microsoft Relationship & Commercial Management

  • Serve as SVHA’s primary operational liaison with Microsoft and Microsoft Unified Support.
  • Coordinate support escalations, strategic engagement activities and roadmap discussions.
  • Support management of SVHA’s Microsoft licensing portfolio through utilisation monitoring, forecasting and optimisation activities.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance and Microsoft representatives to maximise value from the organisation’s Microsoft investment.

Stakeholder Engagement & Adoption

  • Build trusted partnerships across clinical, corporate, aged care and technology teams.
  • Lead communication, organisational readiness and adoption activities supporting new platform capabilities.
  • Promote modern ways of working and increase user adoption of collaboration, digital workplace and AI technologies.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into practical business outcomes that deliver measurable value.

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive experience administering and governing enterprise-scale Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Strong expertise across Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience developing governance frameworks, platform standards and operating models.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft licensing, subscription management and commercial governance.
  • Experience leading vendor relationships and working within large, complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills.
  • Experience delivering adoption, organisational change and continual improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to translate technology opportunities into strategic business outcomes.

Highly Regarded

  • Microsoft Copilot administration and adoption experience.
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview, information protection and records management.
  • Experience with Microsoft Viva and Power Platform governance.
  • Experience in healthcare or other highly regulated environments.
  • ITIL certification and Microsoft certifications across Microsoft 365, Security, Compliance or Copilot.

Things That Work For You

  • Opportunity to lead enterprise-scale Microsoft 365, Digital Workplace and AI initiatives supporting more than 30,000 users.
  • Competitive salary packaging options.
  • Discounted private health insurance.
  • Employee Assistance Program for staff and their families.
  • Access to Fitness Passport.
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
  • The ability to make a meaningful contribution to one of Australia’s largest not-for-profit healthcare organisations.

At St Vincent’s we value inclusivity and diversity and acknowledge the importance of creating a work environment that is welcoming, safe, fair and impartial and invites people from all backgrounds to join us.

title: Lead-Data Engineer
description:
The Lead Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting enterprise data solutions that enable clinical research, operational excellence, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. This role translates complex business and research requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable data architectures, integration solutions, and analytics platforms using established development standards, tools, and best practices. In addition to technical leadership, the Lead Data Engineer is expected to drive strategic data initiatives, proactively identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, AI adoption, and data modernization, and provide expert guidance on emerging technologies that support clinical research and institutional objectives. The Lead Data Engineer serves as a technical lead for complex projects, providing end-to-end ownership from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, documentation, deployment, and operational support. The role requires strong prioritization, stakeholder engagement, communication, and project management skills to successfully manage multiple initiatives and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions. This position is responsible for ensuring solutions meet functional, technical, governance, security, and compliance requirements while adhering to St. Jude development standards and architectural principles. The Lead Data Engineer also monitors and optimizes databases, data warehouses, cloud platforms, ETL pipelines, and scheduling processes to ensure system reliability, performance, scalability, and data quality.

The successful candidate will demonstrate leadership through proactive communication, meaningful participation in cross-functional discussions, high-quality technical documentation, mentorship of team members, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Experience with AI-enabled technologies, advanced analytics, and data engineering solutions supporting clinical research, healthcare, or regulated environments is highly desirable.




Job Responsibilities:


  • Participate in the development of enterprise data and analytics strategies that support clinical research, operational excellence, AI-enabled innovation, and organizational objectives.
  • Provide expert leadership and guidance on industry best practices related to data engineering, data architecture, data integration, data governance, cloud platforms, analytics, and reporting.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of scalable data models, data warehouses, and data integration solutions that enable efficient access, analysis, visualization, and sharing of data.
  • Serve as a technical lead for data modernization and digital transformation initiatives, including the Clinical Research Workbench and broader data modernization efforts, by providing architectural guidance, driving adoption of modern data and AI technologies, identifying opportunities for process innovation, and ensuring alignment with institutional research, analytics, governance, and operational objectives.
  • Translate complex business, research, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions using established development standards, tools, and processes.
  • Drive end-to-end ownership of data engineering initiatives, including requirements gathering, architecture, development, testing, implementation, documentation, deployment, operational support, and continuous improvement.
  • Implement and monitor data governance practices to ensure compliance with institutional standards, regulatory requirements, security policies, and data quality expectations.
  • Collaborate with researchers, business stakeholders, domain experts, and IT teams to develop secure and effective data sharing, analytics, and reporting solutions.
  • Evaluate operational processes, business needs, and research requirements to identify opportunities for data modernization, automation, process improvement, and platform optimization.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, advanced analytics capabilities, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering tools that deliver measurable value to the institution.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, advanced analytics, and automation technologies to improve clinical research operations, data management, and decision-making processes.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex data integration, performance, quality, and architecture issues across on-premises and cloud-based environments.
  • Monitor and optimize databases, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion frameworks, and cloud platforms to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, security, and operational excellence.
  • Lead complex technical projects and analytics initiatives from concept to deployment, including dashboard development, advanced data visualization, automated reporting, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and support.
  • Proactively manage project timelines, dependencies, risks, issues, and stakeholder communications while balancing multiple priorities and competing demands.
  • Provide clear, concise, and leadership-ready status updates, escalating risks early and recommending practical solutions to maintain project success.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality technical documentation, solution designs, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, support documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop junior team members by promoting technical excellence, knowledge sharing, best practices, and professional growth.

Minimum Education and/or Training:


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information science, business, or related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.

Minimum Experience:


  • Minimum requirement: 5+ progressive years of IT experience including strong database design, data architecture and data transform processes.
  • Experience in data architecture and design.
  • Some experience with data governance including implementation of a data governance framework.
  • Experience with leading industrial tools for data lake, big data, or ETL.
  • Experience with enterprise reporting tools for development of reports as applicable.
  • Experience creating dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. PBI, Tableau, Qlik, and data warehousing applications) and source control systems (e.g., Epic, Workday) as applicable.
  • Some experience and knowledge in Master Data Management and Data Dictionary Standards.
  • Some experience with regulatory requirements and standards as applicable.
  • Experience providing technical guidance and mentorship within Data Engineering.
  • Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.

Other Desirable Qualifications:

  • Experience evaluating or working with Epic is highly desirable, especially where that experience includes translating clinical, administrative, or operational workflow pain points into product requirements, business cases, or adoption plans preferred.
  • Working experience with Common data models like I2B2/OMOP/PCORnet is preferred
  • Working knowledge of commercially available AI and GenAI solutions, including healthcare products and enterprise copilots or assistants preferred.

Experience with other enterprise platforms such as Microsoft, ServiceNow, Workday, or comparable healthcare and business technology products preferred.


Licensure, Registration and/or Certification Required by Law:


  • None

Licensure, Registration and/or Certification Required by SJCRH Only:


  • None

This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $94,640 - $169,520 per year for the role of Lead-Data Engineer.

title: Senior Audit Associate
description:
Doeren Mayhew is the 36th largest U.S. tax, assurance and advisory firm headquartered in Troy, Michigan with over 25 offices across the country and abroad. Founded in 1932, Doeren Mayhew is positioned for successful future growth. Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2+ years of current experience in audit practice

  • Ability to demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
