Proactively shares associate feedback and suggestions with the District Manager or assigned Account Manager. Sees that new associates get off to the right start through proper orientation and on-the-job training.- 10%
  • Recognizes great performance and provides opportunities for top performers to learn and grow. Recognizes where the team and individual performers need to improve and properly trains and coaches. Provides feedback and coaching for all team members. Ensures that shift huddles happen on every shift. Practices positive discipline and provides accurate and timely performance documentation. Promotes a teamwork philosophy through leading by example and effective communication skills.- 15%
  • Develops cohesive working relationships with the clients’ staff members. Maintains regular meeting rhythms and communication channels with the client and follows through on commitments as directed by the District Manager or assigned Account Manager. Knows when to be present at the site and maintains a high level of visibility. Understands what objectives are important to the client and ensures the entire team is focused on exceeding expectations. Capitalizes on opportunities to grow Towne Park’s business by building client loyalty and creating clients who are promoters of the company.- 15%
  • Ensures that controls are in place for scheduling, overtime, tip reporting, and timekeeping. Effectively utilizes standardized business systems as developed by Towne Park and ensures compliance with policies and procedures. Builds work schedules and makes calls to notify fellow associates of schedule changes or openings. Ensures District Manager or assigned Account Manager reviews and approvals all time prior to payroll closing. Identifies and collects revenue for all vehicles. Completes accurate cash drop slips and cash drop envelopes. Completes the shift report and other shift paperwork with detail and accuracy. Reconciles revenue and tickets at the end of every shift. Reports to the District Manager or assigned Account Manager methods for improving operating procedures and overall efficiency. Effectively communicates information to the work group.-10%

The total amount of time for all functions of the job - 100%

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university

Required Licensure, Certification, etc.:

  • A valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Must be at least 18 years of age and be able to pass a criminal background, MVR and drug screen

Work Experience:

  • One to two (1-2) years of related experience and/or training; OR equivalent combination of education and/or experience

Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of GSA procedures

Skills:

  • Ability to effectively plan, set priorities, and manage several projects simultaneously while working under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Demonstrated work ethic, drive, energy, and persistence to achieve goals
  • Ability to maintain stability, dependability and professionalism when faced with changing and difficult situations
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office (Excel, Word and Outlook) and various technology and point-of-sale applications
  • Written and verbal communication skills to effectively address all levels within the organization
  • Ability to represent the company effectively in a variety of settings with a demonstrated understanding and appreciation for diverse cultures
  • Must be able to speak, read and write Standard English language.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business policies, procedures, equipment manuals, training materials, and corporate communications
  • Ability to compose professional internal and external business communications including reports, memos, letters, and e-mails

SCOPE

Decisions are made within specific operational instructions and departmental guidelines. Errors in judgment could affect the smooth and efficient operation of the department.

WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL DEMANDS


The working conditions and physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Physical Requirements


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit or stand for extended periods of time and may be required to run; walk; handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Lifting Requirements

The majority of work will be performed outdoors for extended periods of time including up to the entire duration of shift. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT AND ACCEPTANCE

title: Early Career Consult Program - Associate Visual Designer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Your Role

As a Visual Designer, you will shape how Kyndryl shows up across key brand touchpoints by creating clear, compelling, and consistent visual experiences. You will translate business, customer, and brand requirements into high-quality design solutions that strengthen brand recognition, enhance communication, and support business goals. Working closely with marketing, communications, experience, and product teams, you will balance hands-on design execution with collaboration to deliver impactful visual assets across multiple channels.

What You Will Do

  • Create visual assets for digital, social, web, print, presentation, and campaign needs.

  • Translate briefs, content, and business objectives into engaging visual designs and layouts.

  • Apply brand standards, design systems, and templates to ensure consistency across customer and internal touchpoints.

  • Design graphics, mockups, high-fidelity screens, presentations, and other visual assets that support storytelling and business goals.

  • Collaborate with writers, marketers, UX designers, developers, and stakeholders to deliver effective visual solutions.

  • Adapt existing design systems and assets for new formats, platforms, and audiences.

  • Use feedback, testing, and data insights to refine and improve designs.

  • Prepare production-ready assets that meet quality, accessibility, and delivery requirements.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Why Kyndryl:

We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Required Skills

  • Portfolio demonstrates strong visual design work and individual contributions across multiple touchpoints.

  • Strong foundation in typography, color, layout, composition, spacing, and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to translate business and user requirements into polished visual solutions.

  • Proficiency with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, or equivalent platforms.

  • Early career experience applying brand guidelines, design systems, templates, and reusable components.

  • Ability to maintain visual consistency across digital products, presentations, campaigns, and experiences.

  • Understanding user-centered design, usability, responsive design, and accessibility principles.

  • Early career experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, UX, content, and development.

  • Ability to communicate design rationale and participate effectively in design reviews.

  • Awareness of technical constraints and implementation considerations.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing for enterprise, technology, or B2B audiences.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.

  • Experience supporting integrated campaigns across digital and physical environments.

  • Experience creating executive presentations and visual storytelling materials.

  • Exposure to design systems, customer experience initiatives, or product design environments.

  • Experience using customer insights, testing, or analytics to inform design decisions.

The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is - $63,360 to $114,120 based on a full-time schedule. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. title: OCS Specialist
description:

The OCS Specialist maximizes and supports the use of the OCS for organ retrieval and transport prior to, during and after transplantation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

This position is responsible for, but not limited to, the following:

  • Completion of rigorous hands-on training and OCS certification across all organ platforms at

  • TransMedics’ training facility in Andover, MA.

  • Apply OCS knowledge during organ retrieval, preservation, transport, and assessment according

  • to TransMedics protocols and policies.

  • When not on OCS call days, perform assigned tasks during standard working hours, either

  • remotely from home or as assigned, including but not limited to:

  • Managing inventory & shipments on a weekly basis

  • Assist with Lab Trainings

  • Participate in R&D activities in lab

  • Assist with establishing launch points

  • Participate in medical and scientific conferences and meetings (inside or outside the US)

  • Communicate regularly with Organ Management Phone Support to relay real time updates while

  • supporting ongoing OCS cases

  • Regularly communicate OCS utilization activities and users’ feedback

This position manages the following positions on a daily basis.

  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills; able to work collaboratively and build

  • Excellent customer interaction skills

title: Interns - Continuous Improvement, Drug Substance Manufacturing
description:
We are seeking dedicated interns eager to gain hands-on experience in optimizing processes, facilitating workshops, analyzing data, creating dashboards, and supporting improvement initiatives within the biopharmaceutical manufacturing sector. This internship offers a unique opportunity to contribute to dynamic projects emphasizing LEAN, performance, and Shingo methodologies in Drug Substance Manufacturing.

While you will have the autonomy to work independently, robust support and guidance are available whenever required, with a strong emphasis on mentoring during your initial month to ensure seamless integration and skill development.

We are looking for four interns, each bringing their unique strengths:

  • Data-Oriented Intern to support analytics and reporting efforts.
  • Hands-On Shop Floor Intern to assist with on-ground activities and improvements.
  • 3D Printing Enthusiast to contribute to prototyping and creative tasks.
  • Intern with a Quality mindset, contributing to our compliance level on site.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Workshop Facilitation: Collaborate with teams to plan and facilitate workshops aimed at process improvement.
  • Data Analysis & Dashboard Creation: Utilize Alteryx to build robust data sources and develop dashboards and apps in Tableau and Power Apps.
  • Improvement Projects: Lead and execute projects focused on continuous improvement and systematic problem-solving.
  • Problem-Solving & Kaizen Activities: Participate in activities to identify and solve operational challenges, enhancing efficiency.
  • Performance Metrics: Contribute to the development and refinement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Culture Promotion: Advocate for Continuous Improvement (CI) culture across the manufacturing site.
  • Performance Board Support: Assist and/or facilitate performance board meetings focusing on operational excellence.
  • LEAN Tools Application: Gain proficiency in applying LEAN tools such as 5S, 3C, A3, and PDCA to real-world scenarios.

Project Involvement:

  • Simplifying shopfloor: Contribute to efforts making operations more human-centric and easier.
  • 3D Printing: Support prototyping efforts to streamline and enhance processes.
  • Work Instruction Enhancement & Standardization: Participate in initiatives to simplify and improve documentation.
  • Equipment Utilization: Gather data to support the correct decisions and project throughout DSM.

Learning Objectives:

  • Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing Exposure: A comprehensive introduction to biopharmaceutical manufacturing, from the first action in Upstream to the final purification in Downstream.
  • CDMO Experience: Gain insights into the social, technical, and business context of working at a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization.
  • Project Responsibility: Lead projects to familiarize yourself with LEAN tools, from stakeholder management to workshop facilitation.


Qualifications:

  • Open interest or academic background in biopharmaceutical manufacturing or process optimization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and visualization platforms like Alteryx, Tableau, and Power Apps.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment. The working language is English.

Eligibility Requirement: Candidates must be currently enrolled in an educational program in Denmark. Preferably related to biopharmaceuticals, engineering, or a similar field to qualify for this internship. However, we consider enrolled candidate, no matter the education. The internship must be eligible for ECTS credits at your educational institution.


Application Process:

Please submit your resume and cover letter in English as soon as possible, detailing your relevant experience and motivation for applying to this internship.


In your application, please answer these three questions to be considered

  • What motivates you to join FUJIFILM Biotechnologies and work with Continuous Improvement in Drug Substance Manufacturing?
  • Which focus area fits you best (Data-Oriented, Hands-On Shop Floor, 3D Printing, or Quality) and why? You can mention a short example from a course, project, or your work experience.
  • Can you confirm that you can start in February and complete a 6-month, full-time (37 hours/week) internship as part of your education, awarding ECTS points?

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the posting when the positions are filled.

This full-time internship is 5-6 months, start February 2026, and will be shaped according to your needs and the educations’ rules regarding internship.

Join us at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies Denmark and take part in shaping the future of drug substance manufacturing.


Working at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies
We offer a competitive compensation package in a site/company growing rapidly, with many opportunities for individual growth, we also offer access to fitness and an attractive canteen.


FUJIFILM Biotechnologies is an industry-leading Biologics Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) with locations in Hillerød, Denmark, Teesside, UK, RTP, North Carolina and College Station, Texas, USA. We use our skills, dedication and ambition to enable impact for the world’s most innovative biotech and biopharma companies reimagining healthcare’s potential. We work across the entire lifecycle of our customers’ products – enabling success throughout. Every cure, vaccine, biologic, and advancement we contribute to starts with our people and our passion. We fuel one another’s passion, help accelerate progress, expand capabilities, strengthen innovation, and improve processes to improve lives.


Our Manufacturing site in Hillerød, Denmark, brings together a complete range of expertise, capabilities and technologies to manufacture advanced biologics. As we continue to enhance and expand our capabilities, we are looking for people who share our passion, drive, and energy – what we call Genki – to join our team.


We offer the chance to be part of a global workplace where passion, drive and commitment are met with opportunities for professional and personal development. Deeply committed to diversity and inclusion, we ensure that everyone no matter their background or gender has an opportunity to develop. We take pride in enriching our communities, caring for our environment, and cultivating a world of opportunity for future generations.


We aim to foster a collaborative, innovative and rewarding environment, where diverse perspectives and people come together united by a common purpose and shared values. We pursue our fullest potential as individual contributors and team members. We strive to be the employer of choice and offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.


FUJIFILM Biotechnologies Denmark (FLBD) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identify or any other protected class.

description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Measure Technician (In-Home Advisor) works independently in a traveling field role in support of The Home Depot's Field Services Organization. The Measure Technician’s role is to provide quality professional customer service that consistently meets or exceeds Company standards of excellence and customer expectations. This position is responsible for performing in-home measure appointments, including creating, maintaining, and improving customer relationships while interacting with customers daily. title: Crew Leader - NON CDL
description:
Position Summary

The primary function of the Crew Leader is to be responsible and held accountable for their team members and equipment and to maintain control and consistency on every jobsite. The Crew Leader positively encourages and motivates team members to conduct themselves in a safe and professional manner in the eyes of the customer and is expected to uphold all qualifications and certifications for the safe operation of all company equipment.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for understanding and adhering to all aspects of the Crew Leader Handbook.
  • Represent and demonstrate Company leadership attributes while performing job duties and developing others.
  • Check truck loads against customer Purchase Orders to ensure accuracy before leaving the yard and review and sign off on items at the delivery site as the final customer order accuracy check.
  • Assist with loading and unloading of materials in a safe manner and in accordance with company best practices and direct others in the loading process to ensure efficiency and safety.
  • Remain in charge at every jobsite ensuring jobs are completed safely and that proper materials and counts are delivered and distributed per customer request.
  • Ensure compliance with company, state, and federal guidelines, particularly as they relate to OSHA.
  • Exhibit a positive attitude that results in a productive team environment.
  • Be accountable for team member safety, the integrity of company equipment, and the professional product delivered to customers.
  • Perform additional tasks and duties as assigned by management.

Basic Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED.
  • Must have a clear three (3) year Motor Vehicle Report (MVR).

Core Competencies

  • Strive to do the right thing by displaying trust and integrity.
  • Embody the principles of servant leadership by putting the needs of others first, valuing diverse perspectives, and demonstrating a positive and humble attitude.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and on a team, lead and execute tasks, and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships at every level of the organization and build relationships with Field Operations and Field Support Center team members.
  • Help champion an inclusive working environment by empowering others and valuing diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • Ability to self-manage, show initiative, be proactive, and drive results.
  • Communicate professionally, both verbally and in writing, to coworkers and customers.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 40% of the time.
  • Must be able to lift heavy building materials up to 80 lbs. for loading and unloading.
  • Will constantly move to job sites and throughout the yard.
  • Must be able to communicate with team members and management and exchange accurate information.
  • Constantly working in an outside or warehouse environment.

Required Cognitive Skills

  • Must be able to prioritize job sites and deadlines.
  • Must be able to manage stress depending on customers’ deadlines.
  • Must be able to multitask.
  • Must be able to receive information and directions.
  • Must be able to quickly communicate solutions if problems occur.
  • Must be able to demonstrate a high degree of sound judgement.

Job Description

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


Pratt & Whitney is working to once again transform the future of flight—designing, building and servicing engines unlike any the world has ever seen. And because transformation begins from within, we’re seeking the people to drive it. So, calling all curious.

Come ready to explore and you’ll find a place where your talent takes flight—beyond the borders of title, a country or your comfort zone. Bring your passion and commitment and we’ll welcome you into a tight-knit team that takes our mission personally. Channel your drive to make a difference into shaping an organization and an industry that’s evolving fast to the future.

What You Will Do

This position is designed to give individuals with little or no machining or grinding background the skills they need to become a Certified Operator at Pratt & Whitney.

Employees selected for this position will attend a 3-week training program and participate in 4-8 weeks of the on the job training.

Learn to set up and operate NC milling/grinding machines, vertical turret lathes or VTC’s to perform routine production operations on a variety of similar weldments and assemblies.

Learn to work from operation sheets, part travelers, BOROPS, and oral instruction to set up equipment for grinding, turning, facing, boring and/or chamfering operations involving a limited number of surfaces to be machined.

Learn to verify conformance of finished work to specifications using precision measuring instruments.

Obtain operator Certification to be able to accept/reject parts.

Learn to maintain machines by performing required total preventive maintenance (TPM)

Learn to work collaboratively with engineers, quality assurance, programmers and other production personnel or others to resolve machining problems and assist in part process development.

This is a Second Shift role, Monday-Thursday, 3:00PM-1:00AM, 4x10's.

Skills, systems, and processes critical to aerospace manufacturing within a stat of the art facility.

Training and advancement opportunities at all levels through a supportive and collaborative employee experience.

On -the -job training using the most advanced technology in the industry today.

High School or GED

Qualifications We Prefer

1+ Years Manufacturing experience (Non-Aerospace acceptable)

Familiar with precision measuring equipment.

Communication skills, both verbal and written

Computer skills

Basic Shop Math

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) organization is the central focus for Mission Systems Integration activities within Raytheon, responsible for defining customer needs, functional and product architecture, requirements definition and decomposition, Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), algorithm development and system performance. The Radar Systems Department within the SE&TC is seeking a Systems Engineer to help in the development of requirements, concepts of operations and algorithms, and the execution of integration and analysis activities. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities to solve complex problems. In this role, you’ll collaborate across disciplines and partner closely with engineering teams to turn ideas into integrated, working solutions. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where your work directly enables teams to deliver reliable, mission-ready systems.

What You Will Do

In this role, you will support one or more of the following types of activities:

  • Develop concepts of operations for radar systems.
  • Develop radar processing algorithm.
  • Develop Radar systems/software requirements.
  • Be responsible for statistical and numerical analysis of radar performance data.
  • Be responsible for analysis tool development in support of problem identification and resolution.
  • Collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to develop and implement solutions.
  • Present findings and solutions to Leadership and/or Customers.
  • This role can be based out of either Tewksbury, MA or Marlborough, MA.
  • May require up to 20% travel to RTX facilities, test sites, vendor facilities, and customer locations to support test events and mission execution.

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 2 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Experience with systems hardware, systems/software requirements, systems integration, and/or systems test.
  • Experience with MATLAB, Python, C/C++ and/or other programming language.

  • Experience with design, development, and analysis of radar system and software architecture.
  • Experience with signal processing techniques in complex propagation environments.
  • Proven experience in system-level requirements development, documentation, and maintenance, or design and development of system-level software architecture.
  • Experience with DOORS, Rhapsody, Cameo or other digital engineering tools.
  • Experience with evaluating systems using simulated environments.
  • Experience with military systems.
  • Current/Active DoD security clearance.

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

• Reports directly to the Store Manager.

• May show others how to perform certain procedures.

FINANCIAL AND MATERIAL MANAGEMENT:
• Moderate material responsibility.
• May occasionally handle petite cash.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

• This is a permanent full-time position.
• Normal store environment.
• Constant physical effort (such as stretching, lifting up to 30 pounds with no assistance, bending, twisting, pushing, standing, and walking).

• Frequent amount of interpersonal conflict dealing with guests, donors, vendors, and employees.

• Willingness to develop an understanding and support for the mission and purpose of The Salvation Army in Canada and its implications as related to position responsibilities.

• Alternative combination of education and Experience may be considered.

Education, Qualifications and Certifications:
• Completion of some high school.

Experience and Knowledge:

Skills and Capabilities:
• Proven interpersonal and communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.

• Attention to details.

title: Sr. SAP FICO Consultant
description:
Syskoplan Reply is a part of the Reply Network, focused on delivering transformative projects to our clients leveraging SAP solutions. Syskoplan Reply is an SAP Gold partner and has recognized expertise executing global projects in various industries and a wide range of competencies including business process consulting, customer experience, intelligent automation, ERP and more.

At Syskoplan Reply, we are seeking a Senior SAP FICO Consultant to join our team. You are an individual who has technical and functional expertise of the SAP FICO module which allows you to solve problems and deliver optimum solutions for the client. You will act as both a strategic advisor and hands-on configurator, delivering best-in-class solutions aligned with SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach. You have strong business acumen, technical expertise, and the ability to translate complex finance processes into standard cloud-based solutions using SAP Best Practices. You have hands on S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud experience including use case of standard Fiori applications.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a business consultant to help customers achieve their objectives understanding the importance of communication in a consultant's role
  • Problem solve with an extraordinary technical and functional understanding of business process and FICO Principles and SAP products
  • Support end users from a functional and/or technical perspective working closely with them and the business to analyze and review their business requirements or processes
  • Troubleshoot and configure SAP FICO including integration points with other modules and cross functional design/build of other modules. Working on multiple projects as a project team member or team lead.
  • Leads fit/gap and other types of working sessions to understand needs driven by business process requirements. Translate requirements into solutions, using SAP Best Practices
  • Prepare clear and concise documentation, as well as provide timely status updates
  • Proactively identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate potential issues. Assess corporate impacts of changes and recommend strategies to senior management
  • Provide knowledge transfer to clients and fellow consultants, in formal and ad hoc settings

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Travel up to 50%
  • 8 years of SAP experience with a minimum of 3 full-cycle SAP implementations; Implementation experience in SAP Cloud environments both public and private.
  • Proficient in the business processes associated with financial operations, which includes expertise in general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset management, cost center accounting, product cost controlling, profitability analysis, and profit center accounting.
  • Expert in set-up and configuration of FICO as well as cross functional design/build of other module(s)
  • Proficient in all aspects of a project from requirement gathering and gapping to realization to testing, go-live prep and go-live execution as well as hyper-care support. Ability to lead sessions and create requirements to develop the right client solution
  • Highly skilled in FICO master data set-up, cleansing, harmonization and migration, including LSMW and Migration Cockpit
  • Ability to be a thought leader in your domain and contribute to ecosphere both within and external of Reply

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of IOT, Machine Learning and Big Data a plus
  • International project or SAP configuration experience in NAFTA, LATAM and/or EMEA is a plus
  • S/4 Public and/or Private Cloud Certification
  • SAP Activate methodology and SAP’s fit-to-standard approach.
About Reply
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.
The base compensation range for this full-time position is between $125,000 - $165,000 plus benefits. Compensation decisions are supported through market data, where regional variances may exist based on cost of labor. We also take into consideration prior experience, relevant skills, education and/or training, certifications and, as applicable, other required qualifications. If you have questions regarding compensation, the talent acquisition team can provide relevant details during the interview process.
Reply is an equal opportunity employer. title: Product & FF&E Coordinator
description:
At SOM, we are a collective committed to shaping a better future for our clients, communities and planet. We aspire to create the most sustainable, impactful work through creative, interdisciplinary teams with all the resources and diversity of a global firm. We value those who are passionate about excellence, innovation, integrity, inclusivity, and collaboration. Together we can achieve great things.


Success at SOM Means

  • Ideas: We believe in a meritocracy of ideas. We look to everyone to actively contribute to the discourse in the firm.
  • Knowledge: We believe that expertise is the result of lifelong learning. We are not expected to know everything, but rather to passionately pursue answers, develop new skills and deepen our knowledge.
  • Product: We strive for excellence in the concept, quality, and delivery of our work.
  • Individual: We value individuals who bring the highest standards of professionalism and personal integrity in the way they work. Each person can develop and contribute their wealth of attributes, skills and knowledge to support the overall health of the firm.
  • Team: We value the power of interdisciplinary integration. A positive team culture in which everyone collaborates openly towards common goals is essential.
  • Firm: We have a history of making transformative contributions to the profession and our communities. We are constantly innovating and attempting to bring new approaches, solutions and processes to our work.

Position Summary


The Product & FF&E Coordinator provides project, operational and administrative support for SOM's Global Product Design & FF&E Practice. Working closely with the Product & FF&E Manager &/or Director, the Coordinator helps maintain the systems, resources and processes that enable the practice to support projects worldwide. The role coordinates documentation, digital resources, manufacturer communications, archive research and product development activities while ensuring information

remains organized, accurate and accessible.


The Coordinator plays an important role in maintaining the day-to-day operations of the practice, allowing project teams and practice leadership to deliver high-quality design solutions efficiently and consistently.



Position Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day coordination and operational support for the Global Product Design & FF&E Practice.
  • Maintain organized project records, schedules and documentation to support efficient practice operations.
  • Assist with preparation of presentation materials, product information and design documentation.
  • Coordinate meetings, action items and communications between internal teams and external manufacturing partners.
  • Maintain and organize the practice's furniture specification resources, digital libraries, product information and reference materials.
  • Support the maintenance of Revit content, product databases, digital assets and specification documentation.
  • Ensure resources remain current, accurate and accessible to project teams across the firm.
  • Assist in organizing practice priorities, tracking initiatives and coordinating deliverables across multiple concurrent activities.
  • Coordinate product samples, finish information and manufacturer documentation in collaboration with the firm's Materials Library and external manufacturing partners.
  • Assist project teams by gathering product information, preparing documentation and coordinating responses to best support project FFE needs..
  • Support project-specific product research and furniture investigations as directed by the Product & FF&E Manager &/or Director.


Product Design & Development

  • Coordinate the development of licensed and custom furniture and product initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Facilitate communication between designers, manufacturers and internal project teams throughout the product development process.
  • Coordinate design reviews, prototype evaluations, technical feedback and implementation schedules.
  • Support product launches and the ongoing evolution of SOM's licensed product portfolio.

FF&E Strategy & Project Support


  • Provide strategic FF&E support to project teams during planning, design and implementation.
  • Assist project teams in identifying opportunities for custom furniture, licensed products and innovative FF&E solutions appropriate to individual project goals.
  • Support complex and high-profile projects requiring specialized product knowledge or manufacturer coordination.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Acts as a key operational partner in implementing the firm’s global FF&E strategy.
  • Builds collaborative relationships that enable knowledge sharing, design excellence and effective project delivery while supporting the broader objectives of the Global Product Design & FF&E practice.
  • Mentors and supports junior staff involved in specifications, documentation, and coordination.
  • Ensures project scope & deliverables exceed all contract requirements.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Strong understanding of furniture, product design and FF&E processes.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary design initiatives.
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities across numerous concurrent initiatives.
  • Knowledge of furniture manufacturing methods, materials and production processes.
  • Familiarity with specification development and digital resource management.
  • Understanding of Revit, specification platforms and digital design tools.
  • Ability to identify opportunities that improve design quality, project delivery and practice efficiency.
  • Commitment to design excellence and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Industrial Design, Architecture or a related discipline.
  • 2-4 years of professional experience in furniture design, product development, FF&E or related design practice.
  • Experience coordinating manufacturers and external design partners.
  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Strong presentation, communication and organizational skills.
  • Experience within an international design or architecture practice preferred.

Are you ready to join a team of creative professionals working on transformational projects around the world? Take advantage of this exciting opportunity to build a better future with SOM.


Compensation for this role is based upon experience, qualifications, location, and education and typically ranges from $70,000 to $80,000.


For more about SOM:



Portfolios must be submitted for all design and project management positions (Architecture, Interiors, City Design, Graphics, etc). Applications without work samples will not be reviewed. Portfolios should be one PDF attachment, 10-20 pages, maximum 5 MB. Submit portfolios as part of your application in the section where the application asks you for your Resume or CV.

.

title: Software Test Engineer - Azurion Eye (Plymouth, MN)
description:
Job Title

Software Test Engineer - Azurion Eye (Plymouth, MN)

Job Description

The Software Test Engineer will be part of the software team within the Image Guided Therapy Devices (IGT-D) Software R&D group, based in Plymouth, MN. In this role, you will focus on the manual and automated testing of integration and machine-learning-enabled workflows for clinical imaging software applications for the Azurion Eye program. Additionally, you will ensure the software application interface meets requirements, successfully handles edge cases, and implements effective risk control measures.

What is the Azurion Eye program? It advances Philips’ strategy to embed AI into clinical workflows by combining clinical intelligence, computer vision, predictive analytics, and AI-powered orchestration. The platform helps clinicians make faster, better-informed decisions, improve procedural efficiency through intuitive tableside control, and enhance patient safety with precision imaging and reduced radiation exposure, including in-room 3D CT-like imaging for stroke care.

Your role:

  • Collaborate with the Product Owner and the software development team to ensure the requirements for software interfaces, integration and features are complete and testable. You will evaluate various Test Automation tools and frameworks suitable for testing the integration, interfaces of the IntraSight and Azurion platforms.
  • Create and document automated test scenarios, plans, and cases for functional, reliability, performance, safety and risk controls, translation, and other software testing. Establish traceability and coverage between requirements and automated test cases, and develop, dry-run, and review those cases alongside software development during Sprints and/or Product Increments (PIs).
  • Create or leverage test simulators to emulate hardware functionality and manage the virtual test infrastructure. Document test results, observations, and issues in accordance with regulatory requirements and internal quality management system standards, as well as perform regression testing and rerun tests to confirm resolved issues.

You are the right fit if:

  • You’ve acquired 2+ years of experience with Bachelor's working as a Software Test Automation Engineer, Verification Engineer or similar.
  • Your skills include testing enterprise software platforms and hospital systems such as PACS, RIS, and HIS; using test case management tools such as Jama, TestComplete, and Quality Center; applying test automation tools such as Postman, Tosca, TestComplete, and PyTest; scripting with Python and PowerShell; and working with regulatory standards such as IEC 62304, IEC 82304, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971.
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline.
  • You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.
  • You’re an excellent communicator who works effectively across matrixed organizations, comfortable partnering closely with key stakeholders, and global software development teams.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is an office role.

About Philips:

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody, everywhere, has access to the quality of healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

  • Learn more about our business.
  • Discover our rich and exciting history.
  • Learn more about our purpose.
  • Learn more about our culture.

The pay range for this position in Plymouth, Minnesota is $108,000 to $171,000.

The actual base pay offered may vary within the posted ranges depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.

In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives, may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here.

At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case.

Company relocation benefits will not be provided for this position. For this position, you must reside in or within commuting distance to Plymouth, Minnesota.

title: Senior Manufacturing Scientist
description:
Bring more to life.


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The Senior Manufacturing Scientist for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics is responsible for supporting the daily production needs of a Reagent protein purification manufacturing work cell. This includes investigation and resolution of assay failures during in-process/pre/post fill reagent testing, maintenance of bills of materials and material specification changes due to new material qualification or supplier changes, and updating/correcting SOPs in compliance with current quality system standards. There will be opportunities to tackle problems to keep reagents moving through the value stream to serve our customers with high-quality finished goods.

This position is an integral part of the Reagent Operations department located in Chaska, Minnesota, and will be on-site. At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time.

You will be a part of the Technical Operations team and report to the Senior Manager, Manufacturing Science, responsible for conducting investigations, document updates, design changes, troubleshooting, and more. If you thrive in a fast-paced and data-driven role and want to work to build a world-class manufacturing organization—read on!


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Provide technical expertise and direction in multiple Immunoassay manufacturing areas, primarily the purification manufacturing work cell
  • Lead multi-department teams to support/resolve non-conforming issues for existing products.
  • Assess manufacturing processes and systems and implement improvements aimed at performance, quality, and cost.
  • Communicate investigation status reports, proposals for further investigation, etc., via oral and written reports; Develop and implement changes to existing documentation in a timely manner.
  • Solve immunoassay testing and manufacturing issues as they arise.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Biochemistry, chemistry, or biology (or related field) Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of industry experience or Master’s degree with 3+ years of industry experience or Doctoral degree
  • Experience in a regulated industry preferred (e.g. FDA, ISO)
  • Strong technical understanding of biochemical/immunoassay processes and experience analyzing and interpreting data.
  • Subject matter expertise in protein purification techniques
  • In depth knowledge and expertise of chromatography methods (affinity, ion exchange, size exclusion) and analytical methods (HPLC, UPLC, IEP, IEF, SDS PAGE)

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 50 lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Project Management experience
  • Manufacturing of biologicals or pharmaceuticals
  • Validation/verification experience

Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

title: Director, International Growth Campaign Leader (R5851)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

The Director, International Growth Campaign Leader leads the internal operating system behind Shield AI international X-BAT pursuits. Regional, country and opportunity-focused Go-To-Market (GTM) leaders own their customers, their regional and in-country strategies, and their individual captures. This role owns the layer above them: the single, integrated view across regions, and the mechanisms that turn that view into faster decisions, earlier risk mitigation, and better-supported GTM leads.

Each GTM lead sees their own campaign clearly. No one else sees the whole international board. This role does. It connects individual pursuits to shared dependencies — U.S. Government approvals, foreign disclosure and export sequencing, engineering and product capacity, aircraft and test availability, indirect investment, partner and industrial strategy — and makes sure competing regional timelines and strategies are sequenced deliberately rather than reactively.

This is a pre-award enablement and integration role. It is explicitly not the primary customer interface, and it does not extend to the execution of customer-funded programs after award, though it may involve developing projections to better inform execution-supporting decision making. The GTM lead remains the face to the customer, the owner of the account plan, and the accountable capture lead for their country. This role makes those leads faster, better armed, and better supported.

What you'll do:

  • Own the global view. Build and maintain the integrated international campaign picture across all X-BAT regional and country pursuits: strategy status, critical path, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and campaign health in one authoritative picture.
  • Enable the GTM leads. Give regional and country GTM leads the templates, playbooks, data, competitive inputs, cost and schedule inputs, and cross-functional access they need to build and execute their capture plan. Your success is measured by their outcomes.
  • Synchronize across company functions. Ensure engineering, product, export, legal, contracts, finance, government relations, and business operations have common understanding of a single prioritized international campaign plan, so GTM leads are not individually negotiating for the same scarce resources.
  • Map the U.S. Government and approval critical path. Maintain the enterprise view of FMS, DCS, and hybrid pathway dependencies — foreign disclosure, exportability, releasability, technology security, and interagency approval sequencing — and translate them into country-level timeline implications the GTM leads can act on. Government Relations and the relevant functional owners lead those engagements; this role ensures they are planned early, sequenced correctly, and never discovered late. Understand and communicate the global GTM projections in ways that support enabling functions’ ability to anticipate and properly resource for future demand.
  • Surface conflicts between campaigns. Identify where two or more regional campaigns compete for the same aircraft, test window, engineering effort, approval bandwidth, or indirect dollar, and bring executive leadership a clear tradeoff and a recommendation.
  • Drive executive decision quality. Run the operating cadence — campaign reviews, gate reviews, risk registers, action tracking, and executive dashboards — so leadership receives timely, accurate, decision-ready information on overall international capture health in support of resource allocation. Steward indirect investment. Work with Finance and Business Operations to track campaign investment, indirect spend, and resource planning against campaign priorities and expected return.
  • Scale the discipline. Capture lessons learned across international efforts and convert them into repeatable tools, templates, metrics, and playbooks so each new campaign starts further ahead than the last.
  • Support a culture of accountability, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Decision rights and interfaces:

This role is accountable for: the integrated international campaign plan; the operating cadence and campaign-health reporting; identification and escalation of cross-campaign dependencies, conflicts, and risks; the consolidated U.S. Government approval and disclosure roadmap; and recommendations on investment prioritization and sequencing.

Regional, country and opportunity GTM leads are accountable for: customer relationships and engagement, in-country strategy, partner and industrial development, win strategy and price-to-win for their pursuit, proposal content, and the bid/no-bid recommendation for their opportunity.

Government Relations, Export, Legal, and Contracts are accountable for: interagency and embassy engagement, export authorizations, disclosure determinations, legal positions, and contracting terms.

Engineering and Product are accountable for: technical solution definition, configuration decisions, and performance commitments.

Strategy and Operations is responsible for enterprise, cross-product strategy, of which the products this role directly supports would be a part. Program Management is accountable for: execution of customer-funded programs after award.

This role will be complemented by a parallel position whose focus will be on integration across all U.S. customers, and with whom close collaboration will be required.

External customer engagement by this role is in support of, and at the invitation of, the responsible GTM lead.

Required qualifications:

  • 12+ years in international B2G capture management, program management, strategic operations, business operations, technical program management, or a comparable cross-functional leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success leading highly complex initiatives with multiple interdependent workstreams across engineering, business development, operations, finance, and executive leadership.
  • Working knowledge of international defense pursuit dependencies, including FMS, DCS, or hybrid acquisition pathways and the approval, disclosure, and exportability sequencing that governs them.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and to drive accountability across functions and geographies.
  • Strong executive communication: leadership briefings, dashboards, metrics, and decision-support materials that lead to decisions rather than discussion.
  • Deep operational rigor in integrated schedules, critical path, milestones, action tracking, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments with competing priorities across multiple time zones.
  • A service orientation toward the functional roles this position supports, and the judgment to know when to escalate versus resolve quietly.
  • Demonstrated alignment with Shield AI core values: Do What Honor Dictates, Live as a Servant Leader, Pursue Excellence.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required, and to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Department of War, aerospace, autonomy, robotics, aviation, or defense-technology organizations.
  • Experience within B2G business development, capture, proposal operations, strategic planning, or growth organizations running multiple concurrent international pursuits.
  • Familiarity with U.S. Government international engagement mechanisms such as foreign disclosure processes, security cooperation planning, embassy and country team coordination, or interagency advocacy.
  • Experience building executive dashboards, KPIs, operational scorecards, or portfolio health metrics.
  • Experience supporting executive staff, chief-of-staff organizations, Strategy and Operations teams, or enterprise PMOs.
  • Experience with tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, or The AI Work Platform for People & Agents | monday.com .
  • MBA or advanced degree; PMP, Agile, or Lean Six Sigma certification.

Success in this role:

  • Every regional campaign has an approved strategy, a critical-path schedule, and a mapped approval pathway that the GTM lead owns and uses.
  • GTM leads report that the role makes their campaigns easier to run, not heavier to report on.
  • U.S. Government, export, and disclosure dependencies are identified early enough to change the outcome rather than explain it.
  • Cross-campaign resource and timing conflicts reach leadership early enough for meaningful action, and as a decision with a recommendation.
  • Executive leadership can see, at any time, an accurate health picture of the international X-BAT portfolio and make investment calls with confidence.
  • Campaign mechanisms are reused across countries, and each new pursuit stands up measurably faster than the previous one.

7 years of experience in: Designing operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting frameworks using IT Managed services tools (including Genesys, Workday and ServiceNow), to support operational and business performance.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal AI Engineer based in Brazil.

This role leads the architecture and development of enterprise-scale AI orchestration and retrieval systems. You will define how LLMs connect with tools, data sources, APIs, and specialized agents. The position combines strategic technical leadership with hands-on engineering across agentic workflows and RAG systems. You will establish standards for MCP servers, tool exposure, retrieval, context management, evaluation, and observability. Working across teams, you will create reusable abstraction layers that enable product engineers to build effectively on top of AI capabilities. This is an opportunity to shape the technical foundations of a central AI platform while mentoring engineers and driving best practices.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and develop orchestration and abstraction layers connecting LLMs with tools, data, and specialized sub-agents.
  • Build and operate MCP servers while establishing standards for defining, exposing, and versioning tools.
  • Define tool-surface strategies, including the appropriate number of tools and APIs exposed to LLMs and how they remain coherent and discoverable.
  • Establish when to use specialized sub-agents versus direct tool exposure and develop corresponding multi-agent patterns.
  • Design and optimize RAG systems covering chunking, embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search, re-ranking, and context assembly.
  • Create abstraction layers that decouple product teams from underlying models, tools, and providers.
  • Develop routing, memory, and context-window management strategies for agentic workflows.

title: Agentic Architect
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

¿Eres una persona innovadora a la que le apasiona resolver problemas complejos?

¿Te entusiasma encontrar formas de conectar la tecnología con las necesidades del negocio? Si es así, tenemos una oportunidad emocionante para que te unas a nuestro equipo como Agentic Architect.


Como Agentic Architect en Kyndryl, tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con algunas de las empresas más innovadoras y dinámicas del mundo, ayudándolas a alcanzar sus objetivos empresariales mediante la implementación estratégica de tecnología.


Serás responsable de conectar las necesidades de negocio de nuestros clientes con su estrategia tecnológica (IT), utilizando diferentes modelos y perspectivas arquitectónicas para crear una visión clara de cómo satisfacer sus requisitos de una manera ágil, sostenible y flexible.

Para destacar en este puesto, necesitarás comprender las necesidades y limitaciones de nuestros clientes y aplicar tus conocimientos del sector y las mejores prácticas para desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas eficaces.

Además de tus capacidades técnicas, necesitarás ser una persona con excelentes habilidades de comunicación, capaz de influir en los clientes y transmitir el valor de nuestras soluciones gracias a tu conocimiento de tecnologías de vanguardia y a tu comprensión de su negocio e industria.



Who You Are

Misión

  • Diseñar harnesses de desarrollo agéntico (Claude Code y otros coding agents) que conviertan agentes en factorías de software gobernadas y auditables.
  • Arquitecturar aplicaciones agénticas multi-agente sobre stacks empresariales de cliente, de diseño a producción.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar harnesses: hooks, skills, sub-agentes, permisos, contexto, gates de calidad y trazabilidad.
  • Definir la cadena intent → spec → plan → diff y sus controles (evals, tests, revisión humana).
  • Arquitecturas multi-agente con LangGraph (estado, checkpointing, interrupts, orquestación) e integración vía MCP.
  • Estrategia de evaluación en LangSmith: golden datasets, evals como gates de pipeline, regresiones.
  • Observabilidad, coste y seguridad de agentes (prompt injection, guardrails, AI Act).
  • Aplicar el harness a migración: specs desde código legado y regeneración de aplicaciones.
  • Arquitecturas de referencia, ADRs, mentoría y soporte a preventa.

Imprescindibles

  • 8+ años en ingeniería/arquitectura de software, 2+ con sistemas LLM en producción.
  • Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI o similares) configurados y gobernados para equipos, no solo uso individual.
  • LangGraph/LangChain a nivel de arquitectura; Python avanzado.
  • MCP: diseño de servidores y modelo de permisos.
  • Evals y observabilidad LLM (LangSmith, Langfuse o equivalente).
  • APIs de modelos frontera (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Vertex) y patrones de tool-use.
  • Base de arquitectura empresarial: Azure/GCP, Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD.
  • Interlocución con CTOs y arquitectos de cliente; inglés profesional.

Deseables

  • Platform engineering / IDPs y agentes en pipelines existentes (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Otros frameworks agénticos (OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel).
  • Vector stores y retrieval; entornos regulados (banca, sanidad, público).


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Lead Engineer, Vulnerability & Exposure Management (f/m/d)
description:
Bring more to life.


At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, the Lead Engineer, Vulnerability & Exposure Management engineers the scanning, ingestion, normalization, prioritization, ticketing, reporting, and automation workflows for vulnerability and exposure data. Program strategy and prioritization framework are set by leadership and the Global Lead, VEM; the Lead Engineer owns the engineering implementation and works independently to build it, integrating with cloud, endpoint, app, and remediation teams that each own their own systems.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Engineer scan coverage, data ingestion/normalization, prioritization logic, ticketing, and reporting pipelines.
  • Build automation (Python/SQL/APIs) for prioritization, SLA logic, exception processes, and validation.
  • Contribute to the CTEM operating-model design owned by the Global Lead; implement and refine it.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • CrowdStrike CCFA, Tenable VM Specialist, Qualys VMDR, GIAC GSEC/GMON, or a cloud security certification.
  • 5+ years of experience in vulnerability management or security engineering
  • Hands-on experience engineering vulnerability/exposure tooling (such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, CrowdStrike FEM, or Defender), including scan coverage, authenticated scanning, and data normalization.
  • Experience building automation and integrations (such as Python, SQL, and REST APIs) across vulnerability, ticketing (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira), and cloud or endpoint data sources.
  • Experience applying risk-based prioritization beyond CVSS using threat intelligence such as EPSS and CISA KEV and asset context.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with attack surface management, cloud posture, or container/Kubernetes exposure.
  • Experience with patch/remediation orchestration tooling (such as BigFix, SCCM/MECM, or Red Hat Satellite).

title: AVP - Compliance and AI/ML
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To validate and approve models for specific usages both at inception and on a periodic basis, and of model changes, as well as conducting annual reviews.

Accountabilities

  • Validation of models for their intended use and scope, commensurate with the complexity and materiality of the models.
  • Approval or rejection of a model or usage based on assessment of the model’s conceptual soundness, performance under intended use and the clarity of the documentation of the model’s inherent risks, limitations and weaknesses.
  • Assessment of any compensating controls used to mitigate Model risk.
  • Documentation of validation findings and recommendations in clear and concise reports, providing actionable insights for model improvement.
  • Evaluation of the coherence of model interactions and quality of Large Model Framework aggregate results that generate output for regulatory submissions or management decision making and planning.
  • Design of the framework and methodology to measure and, where possible, quantify model risk, including the assessment of framework level uncertainty.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join Barclays as an AVP - Compliance & AI/ML, where you will provide independent review and investigate of models supporting key areas of the business. You will perform technical and data analysis, benchmarking, and challenger modelling across Compliance models, including Financial Crime, Transaction Monitoring, Anti-Money Laundering, and Market/Trade Surveillance. You will assess model performance, data quality, methodology, governance, controls, limitations, and assumptions while ensuring models meet internal standards and regulatory expectations. Working closely with model owners, developers, and senior stakeholders, you will deliver high-quality validation reports and contribute to the continued development of model risk management practices.

To be successful as an AVP - Compliance & AI/ML, you should have:

  • Experience in model validation and model risk management, including knowledge of regulatory requirements relating to model risk
  • Understanding of quantitative techniques used to develop and validate Compliance models, particularly Financial Crime, Transaction Monitoring, AML and Market/Trade Surveillance
  • Experience with statistical, scenario-based and rules-based models, including predictive modelling techniques
  • Experience developing or validating machine learning models using large datasets

Other highly valued skills include:

  • Knowledge of analytical tools and technologies such as Python, R, SAS, Spark, MLlib, Hadoop and/or AWS
  • Understanding of financial crime typologies, particularly transaction monitoring and market/trade surveillance
  • Ability to perform technical analysis, benchmarking and challenger model development, identifying model weaknesses, limitations and assumptions
  • Analytical, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to effectively task model owners and developers when required

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in Wilmington, DE.
