title: SPA Advisory, Associate Director
description:
Alternatively, Grant Thornton

At Grant Thornton we do things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. Providing audit, tax and advisory services, we empower clients through strategic insight, curiosity, and genuine partnership. And we empower our people with real opportunity, an inclusive culture and work life balance. A true alternative.

With over 5,000 people in the UK, and a presence in 150 global markets, we're on an ambitious journey, from great to exceptional, and we need the best people to help us achieve our potential. And with that comes the opportunity to help redefine what our industry looks like, and what you want from your career.

Job Description:


Do you have Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA) experience? Our market leading SPA team at Grant Thornton is hiring at all grades to continue our rapid growth! We work with corporates, private equity houses and other investors across a wide range of sectors, advising on the financial aspects of acquisitions and disposals, from completion mechanisms and price adjustments through to sale and purchase agreement (SPA) negotiations. We are seeking ADs with the technical and commercial skills who enjoy protecting value for clients undertaking acquisitions and disposals. Successful candidates should have transactions experience, a good understanding of completion mechanisms, enterprise to equity value bridges and the financial aspects of SPAs. Candidate will ideally have 3-5 years’ transaction and/or SPA advisory experience and be ACA (or equivalent) qualified.

A look into the role

As a SPA Associate Director within our team, you will:

· Take responsibility and ownership of the client relationship at the appropriate level in the client's organisation at board level.

· Consult effectively with specialists within the firm when faced with complex risk management.

· Oversee and manage letters of engagement internally and with the client.

· Develop solutions to complex technical issues.

· Interpret and analyse complex information, identifying business issues and applying technical knowledge appropriately.

· Oversee the preparation of deliverables to client, such as financial analysis, ensuring quality output is produced which is relevant to the transaction.

· Lead on completion mechanism matters, including net debt, working capital and other price adjustment calculations, ensuring analysis is robust and well supported.

· Review final drafts of our output.

· Manage all aspects of the transaction competently, including managing any junior team members involved on the project on technical aspects of the transaction.

· Set the fee estimate and oversees the drafting of the engagement letter.

· Lead the presentation of conclusions and recommendations to the client and discuss the implications and action points.

· Proactively seek out business development opportunities.

· Suggest innovative selling solutions whilst pro-actively identifying cross-selling opportunity.

· Review and participate in negotiations on the financial aspects of SPAs, including warranties, indemnities and disclosure letters, working closely with legal advisers.

· Lead, motivate and coach managers by inducting effectively, giving regular feedback and timely performance reviews.

· Prepare fee estimates and budgets for client assignments and manage client expectations about changes and overruns.

Knowing you’re right for us

Joining us as a SPA AD, the minimum criteria you’ll need is a professional qualification (ACA, ICAS, CA, ACCA or CIPFA) with post qualification transaction advisory experience (ideally 3-5 years, gained within a transaction services, corporate finance or SPA advisory environment), and to be confident managing a portfolio of SPA advisory engagements.

It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way:

· Some years experience in transactions/deals including experience of advising on financial aspects of SPAs

· Strong technical understanding of completion mechanisms, including locked box and completion accounts structures, and net debt and working capital adjustments.

· Experience reviewing and negotiating the financial aspects of SPAs, including warranties and indemnities.

· A level of business development experience, including converting sales opportunities and building long-term client relationships.

· Experience managing and developing junior team members across multiple, concurrent engagements.

· Strong report writing and communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial analysis clearly to clients and other stakeholders.

Knowing we’re right for you

The culture at Grant Thornton is what sets us apart, we’re known for our inclusive culture and creating environments where all our people can flourish. The things that set you apart, we value them, and this helps us all to perform at our best.

Our values are the unwavering principles that shape our daily behaviours and decisions, alongside our drive to do the right thing. We’re looking for people who align with our values and are purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind. You can learn more about our values in practice here.

It’s not just about our culture and values, in addition to a competitive salary and reward package, us you’ll also get:

Tailored development programmes and access to coaching

Flexible bank holidays – allowing you to celebrate the days that are important to you

Benefits including pension, life assurance and private medical, additional holiday purchasing and health benefits

Anytime benefits giving you access to shopping discounts, gym memberships, financial advice

And more. Visit our benefits section to read more.

How we work

We have a trust-based way of working, driven by responsible people who have the best interests of our firm and our clients at heart. Our how we work framework gives flexibility in where, how, and when we work to deliver the best results for our clients, whilst helping you keep a balance between work and life. Life is more than work, the things you do, and the people you’re with outside of work matter, that’s why we’re happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles. That is how it should be.

We’re looking for people who can help drive the business forward, who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.

Hurricane Mesa Test Facility (HMTF) is a unique R&D test site that validates ejection seat systems and subsystems using a supersonic rocket sled track. Testing spans sled‑track events with aircraft-representative bodies and anthropometric manikins from zero airspeed/altitude up to and beyond the speed of sound, along with a broad spectrum of subsystem and energetic component tests.

This role is a hands‑on Test Engineer responsible for supporting test setup, execution, and general technical operations across all onsite programs. The engineer will contribute to sled‑performance calculations, data analysis, high‑speed camera operation, and other tasks related to rocket‑sled and aircraft escape system testing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Work as part of an engineering team in developing, testing, and qualifying various aircraft escape systems and components.
  • Set up and operate high‑speed cameras (Ametek Phantom and others) to capture test events, including fixed‑position and tracking applications.
  • Support safe handling and setup of energetic propulsion devices such as HVAR rocket motors and small explosive initiators under guidance from senior staff.
  • Collaborate with engineers on building, modifying, and preparing test fixtures and test articles based on program requirements.
  • Perform data analysis on sled performance and complete predictive propulsion and braking calculations.

  • Hands‑on experience with technical equipment or instrumentation.
  • Experience with performing calculations and interpretation test data.

The Hardware Engineering Directorate is seeking a Principal Digital Hardware Engineer with digital electronics design and analysis skills to join our team.

We are looking for candidates willing to collaborate, innovate, and team with our engineers to generate and utilize today’s cutting-edge technology to design digital electronics circuits that implement missile guidance, video and digital signal processing. Our technology base includes high-speed digital electronics, configurable logic, and homogeneous / heterogeneous multiprocessor designs.


What You Will Do

The Effector Guidance Electronics Department designs digital electronic circuit cards and electronic units which are supported from proposal through transition to production. Our systems are subject to environments ranging from the frigid, sub-zero vacuum of space to the blistering heat of the desert floor, to the high pressures of the ocean depths.


The Principal Electrical Engineer is responsible for the design, analysis, simulation, test, and integration of digital electronic modules and/or CCAs for missile applications. The candidate should be experienced in all aspects of circuit card design including hardware designs with processors, FPGAs, memory, and industry interfaces, such as PCIe, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, and UART.


Qualifications You Must Have

  • Minimum of eight (8) years engineering digital circuit design experience
  • Experience in the development and design of electronic circuit designs, and/or multi-assembly system/unit design

Qualifications We Prefer

title: GenAI Tech Senior Lead
description:
GenAI Tech Senior Lead - SVP (Hybrid)


We are seeking a results-driven Generative AI practitioner with end-to-end experience for the execution and deployment of cutting-edge Generative AI and agentic AI solutions across our enterprise-wide Controls Technology platform. In this role, you will be responsible for translating AI strategy into tangible, production-ready capabilities that enhance operational efficiencies and drive business value. We're looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise in generative AI — including context engineering, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration — with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex technology projects. This role centers on architecting and delivering solutions built on pre-trained and hosted foundation models, not on training or fine-tuning models.


Key Responsibilities

  • GenAI Delivery Leadership: Execute the delivery roadmap for generative and agentic AI projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines. Manage the project lifecycle from ideation and scoping to deployment and post-launch support.
  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of AI engineers and specialists. Foster a culture of execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement to successfully deliver on the AI roadmap.
  • End-to-End Solution Delivery: Oversee the design, development, and deployment of robust, scalable, and production-ready GenAI and agentic applications. Ensure all solutions meet rigorous performance, security, and quality standards before and after deployment.
  • Agentic Solution Delivery: Drive the design and delivery of agentic workflows and multi-agent systems, establishing standards for agent harnesses, orchestration patterns, and reliable long-running agent execution across the platform.
  • Stakeholder & Program Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for GenAI delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations, communicate project progress, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure on-time and on-budget delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Data Mesh, Cloud Architecture, MLOps/LLMOps, and business unit teams to ensure the seamless integration and operationalization of GenAI and agentic solutions into our existing technology ecosystem.
  • Technical Excellence & Best Practices: Drive the adoption of best practices in software development (CI/CD), LLMOps, agent observability, and project management (Agile/Scrum) within the AI team to ensure efficient and repeatable delivery.
  • Governance & Ethical Deployment: Implement and enforce robust governance and ethical AI frameworks throughout the delivery process — including guardrails, agent isolation/sandboxing, and responsible AI practices — ensuring compliance with data privacy standards and corporate policies.

Required Technical Skills

  • Core Generative AI Concepts: Deep understanding of foundation models, LLMs, embeddings, tokenization, and context-window management. Fluent in applying pre-trained and hosted models to enterprise use cases.
  • Context Engineering: Expertise in advanced context engineering — context layering, chaining, compression, pruning/offloading, and memory management — to maximize reliability, provenance, and token efficiency in production.
  • Prompt Engineering: Adept at advanced prompt engineering techniques and best practices, with familiarity with frameworks that facilitate effective prompt design and management.
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Advanced knowledge of RAG techniques, including hybrid search, multi-vector retrieval, Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE), self-querying, query expansion, re-ranking, and relevance filtering.
  • Knowledge Graphs & Graph RAG: Experience designing and delivering knowledge graphs (e.g., using graph databases such as Neo4j or ArangoDB) and Graph RAG architectures to enable multi-hop reasoning, explainability, and traceable, grounded responses for high-value business domains.
  • Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Proven experience delivering agentic systems using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and comparable frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK), applying orchestration patterns such as supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and peer-to-peer.
  • Agent Harness & Interoperability: Strong grasp of harness engineering (governance, constraints, feedback loops, execution controls, agent isolation/sandboxing) and agent interoperability protocols — the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool/data access and the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for inter-agent collaboration.
  • Machine Learning Frameworks & Cloud Computing: Working knowledge of ML frameworks and extensive hands-on experience with AWS (or equivalent) services and infrastructure for AI/GenAI.

title: Product Manager, Fiat & FCM
description:
About the Role

This is a mission-critical product leadership role at the heart of Crypto.com's regulated trading business. As Product Manager, Fiat & FCM, you will own the end-to-end fiat product strategy for our Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) and regulated US trading platform — the money-movement infrastructure that lets retail, private, and institutional clients fund and withdraw from a CFTC/NFA-regulated trading environment instantly, compliantly, and reliably.

FCM is one of Crypto.com's top growth priorities, and it's your anchor. But the mandate is broader: you'll own the banking-rail strategy that scales this model across markets and currencies, and over time, extends to Crypto.com's other business lines, defining which rails we use, which banks we partner with, how customer funds are segregated and settled, and how money moves in and out. You'll carry direct accountability for Total Funds Flow, acceptance rates, settlement speed, and cost-per-transaction across the platform.

Our team is globally distributed across APAC, EU, and US time zones, so you'll need to be comfortable working across time zones and communicate effectively with globally distributed teams.

Responsibilities

  • FCM Funding & Regulated Fund Handling Own the fiat funding and withdrawal experience for the FCM platform, including customer fund segregation, margin funding flows, and the operational data behind daily segregation computation and regulatory reporting.
  • Payment Rails Select and integrate rails based on speed, reversibility, and cost — ACH, FedWire, FedNow/RTP in the US, and SEPA / SEPA Instant / FPS and other schemes as the platform grows across markets and currencies.
  • Strategic Bank Partnerships Lead assessments, commercial negotiations, and technical integrations for direct bank relationships that can support a regulated trading entity — securing preferential rates, dedicated service levels, segregated-account structures, and custom solutions. Includes exposure to specialized charters (e.g. SPDI) where relevant.
  • Global Banking Network Build and optimize payment infrastructure across markets, ensuring maximum rail coverage and uptime for fiat access — extending the FCM funding model to additional geographies over time.
  • Speed & Latency Select and integrate payment rails based on transaction-speed requirements (T+0 vs T+1) to support instant trading activity and margin calls.
  • Liquidity & Settlement Structure banking partnerships to maintain near-zero-downtime liquidity for mass user pay-outs and high-frequency trading settlement.
  • Acceptance Rate Optimization Drive improvements in pay-in acceptance across card and bank-transfer channels by optimizing processor relationships, fraud rules, and compliance logic.
  • Payment Orchestration & Routing Design and own the logic for a dynamic routing engine that selects the optimal rail in real time based on user segment, jurisdiction, currency, speed, and risk profile.
  • Institutional On-Ramp Build compliant, scalable fiat solutions for institutional trading clients — including segregated bank accounts, high-value wire processing, and bulk pay-out APIs.

Requirements

  • Direct experience with a CFTC/NFA-regulated FCM, futures broker, or regulated trading platform — including familiarity with customer fund segregation, margin funding, and regulatory fund-handling obligations.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of payment rails across multiple markets — US (ACH, FedWire, FedNow/RTP) and ideally EU (SEPA, SEPA Instant) — including reversibility, settlement timing, and their trade-offs for a regulated trading business.
  • Experience with direct bank integrations (not just white-label PSPs) and commercial partnership negotiation; exposure to specialized banking charters (e.g. SPDI) a strong plus.
  • 7–10+ years of product leadership, with at least 7 focused on payment infrastructure, core banking, or regulated trading/brokerage products.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling payment rails in a high-volume, real-time environment.
  • Track record of leading payment orchestration and dynamic routing logic in production.
  • Experience building fiat solutions for institutional clients (segregated accounts, wire processing, bulk APIs).
  • Technical acumen across complex API products, data flows, and payment-protocol integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with core banking platforms and/or payment-scheme integrations (ACH, FedWire, SEPA, SWIFT, FPS, etc.).
  • Able to work across APAC, EU, and US time zones and communicate effectively with globally distributed teams.
  • Strong people management — you develop and hold a high bar for your team.
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, legal, compliance, finance, and senior leadership.
Life @
Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Empower employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.

One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet.

Are you ready to kickstart your future with us?

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We are looking to add a Systems Engineer II to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased arrays for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.

In this position, you will be responsible for leading the systems engineering activities required to define, develop, integrate, verify, and support complex aerospace systems throughout the product lifecycle. This role translates mission objectives, customer requirements, and system architecture into technical solutions that enable successful system integration and mission execution.

Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, the Senior Systems Engineer collaborates with software, hardware, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, integration and test, mission operations, and program management teams to ensure systems meet technical, operational, cost, and schedule objectives. This role provides technical leadership from concept development through design, integration, verification, launch, and operational support while contributing to technical decision-making and risk management.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop system verification and validation strategies, including verification methods (test, analysis, demonstration, and inspection), acceptance criteria, and verification levels aligned with program requirements.
  • Define verification configurations, including hardware, software, firmware, and test environments required to support verification activities.
  • Develop and maintain verification documentation, verification cross-reference matrices (VCRM), requirements traceability matrices, and verification evidence packages.
  • Partner with Integration & Test teams to plan, coordinate, and support system integration and verification activities.
  • Evaluate test results, resolve technical discrepancies, and support corrective actions to ensure compliance with system requirements.
  • Support technical planning, Program Increment (PI) planning, staffing assessments, and engineering execution activities.
  • Prioritize systems engineering activities to meet technical, cost, schedule, and program milestones.
  • Participate in technical reviews, design reviews, customer meetings, and engineering milestone activities.
  • Mentor junior engineers on systems engineering best practices, requirements development, traceability, verification, and technical documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, systems engineering rigor, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams to support successful program execution.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience with an emphasis on space-based communication payloads.
  • Strong knowledge of systems engineering principles and the systems development lifecycle.
  • Experience developing, managing, and verifying system and subsystem requirements.
  • Knowledge of systems architecture, interface management, systems integration, and configuration management.
  • Understanding verification, validation, and systems integration processes.
  • Ability to interpret customer requirements, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), and technical specifications to develop engineering solutions.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Familiarity with spacecraft mission planning, launch support, and on-orbit operations.
  • Experience supporting spacecraft system integration, mission readiness, and operational activities.
  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated engineering programs.

title: Senior Communications Coordinator
description:
Hoboken Grace is a diverse and growing community church seeking to love and serve our city as we celebrate everything God has done for us. As we have grown, so have our opportunities. Every employee is an important part of the team.

JOB POSITION Sr. Communications Coordinator

SUPERVISOR Communications Director

LOCATION Hoboken, NJ


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must have communications and/or marketing experience
  • Must have project management experience and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
  • Must be highly creative, with the ability to generate fresh ideas and translate them into engaging content across multiple platforms
  • Must have experience creating social media content, including developing concepts, capturing content, writing copy, and adapting content for different platforms
  • Must have experience with current communications and social media trends, digital advertising, media pitching, and analytics
  • Must have excellent attention to detail, organization, multi-tasking, and project planning skills
  • Must have a strong understanding of brand consistency and the ability to maintain a cohesive voice and visual presence across platforms
  • A degree in communications, marketing, or a related field is preferred
  • Past experience working with marketers, photographers, videographers, graphic designers, and project managers is preferred
  • Past experience working with unpaid volunteers and staff is preferred
  • Must be available on Sundays to support communications needs and perform quality assurance across Sunday content, digital platforms, and communication channels


JOB DESCRIPTION

The main responsibility of the Communications Department is to ensure that information flows seamlessly throughout every level of the organization as well as to external audiences. This position helps foster and grow the Hoboken Grace brand, creates engaging and creative content, and maintains communication rhythms that help various audiences know when to expect and where to find information.


The Sr. Communications Coordinator plays an active role in bringing the Hoboken Grace story to life through social media and other communication channels. This includes generating creative ideas, capturing and creating content, identifying stories worth telling, and ensuring content is engaging, timely, accurate, and aligned with the Hoboken Grace brand.


This position also helps ensure that people are engaging with and responding to church content and, when appropriate, using various channels to communicate back to the church (email, social media, Slack, etc.). Keys to this position include creativity, constant evaluation and simplification of communications schedules and platforms, recruiting multiple voices and thought leaders, and effectively using tools such as analytics, SEO, marketing platforms, Mailchimp, Planning Center, Subsplash, Asana, and other emerging communications tools.


The ultimate mission of the Communications Department is for Hoboken Grace to communicate how our church loves and serves our city, to celebrate God at every level, and to let the city know what He is doing in and through our church.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Create, capture, and develop engaging social media content that tells the story of Hoboken Grace and reflects the church's brand, voice, and mission
  • Generate creative concepts and new approaches for communicating events, stories, initiatives, and key messages across digital platforms
  • Stay current on social media, content, and communications trends and identify opportunities to incorporate relevant trends into Hoboken Grace's content strategy
  • Write and develop copy for social media, email, web, app, and other communication channels
  • Coordinate with photographers, videographers, graphic designers, staff, and other contributors to execute communications projects and content
  • Maintain consistency and quality across communications platforms, ensuring information is accurate, timely, and aligned
  • Be available on Sundays to perform quality assurance across Sunday communications, content, and platforms, identifying and addressing errors or issues as needed
  • Continuously analyze and update communications platforms and systems to improve effectiveness and simplify communication
  • Review engagement and analytics to understand how audiences are interacting with content and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Identify and help capture stories happening throughout Hoboken Grace
  • Pitch journalists and other forms of media to help capture and share our story
  • Support additional communications-related projects and responsibilities as assigned
  • Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice


REQUIREMENTS

  • A commitment to the Hoboken Grace mission as well as an understanding of and willingness to serve within the values of Hoboken Grace
  • A creative mindset and a willingness to continually bring new ideas, concepts, and solutions to the Communications Department
  • Strong initiative, follow-through, and the ability to identify needs and opportunities without always requiring direction
  • Drive, a humble heart, and emotional intelligence are key attributes to success in this position
  • Ability to receive feedback, collaborate with a team, and adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment

title: ML Infrastructure Engineer
description:
For a century, the answer to “what’s in the pipe right now” was a grab sample to a lab with results back hours later. We answer it every second.

Laminar is building human-centric self-driving factories: the ones made of stainless steel pipes and reactors, that make what the world eats, uses, and wears. Proprietary inline sensors read the chemistry in the pipe. Foundation models grounded in physics and chemistry reason about how close the process is to its target. Process control software acts on the answer through the plant’s automation system in real time. Laminar Insights shows what happened, why, and what it saved.

A Laminar line uses about 20% less water and 20% fewer chemicals and runs 15% faster, with quality protected. Productivity and sustainability improve together. We run across six continents at manufacturers like Coca-Cola, Unilever, and AB InBev, backed by tier-1 investors in Physical AI.

We’re a polymathic team of 50 in Somerville: hardware and software engineers, chemists, AI researchers, factory operators, and go-to-market wizards under one roof. Nobody here is waiting to be asked what to do. You’ll see the problem, propose the fix, and own the outcome. We believe in autonomy, ownership, and demanding excellence, and we hold each other to it. If that’s how you want to spend your time, come build the self-driving factory with us.


As our company grows and scales, we are excited for a ML Infrastructure Engineer to join the team! We are looking for a thoughtful and hard-working infrastructure engineer who wants to play an integral role in bringing AI to fluid & process manufacturing. As a ML Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the development of infrastructure and tooling that helps ML researchers train, evaluate, and deploy models at scale. Your work will directly power the vertical and horizontal scalability of Laminar’s ML models across domains including (bot not limited to): CIP (clean-in-place), product changeovers, material identification, product filtration, and emerging use-cases.

You will interface with ML researchers and data engineers to build infrastructure that allows researchers to frictionlessly train models on large-scale data, evaluate them on unseen data, and deploy champion models to run on the factory floor across edge devices. Your tooling will be fundamental to making our research-to-production ML pipeline faster and more hands-free, ensuring a seamless experience for researchers. Your work will be instrumental to hyper-scaling Laminar’s solutions and deepening our competitive moat by empowering researchers to deliver state-of-the-art technological advancements.

What You Will Do

  • Develop computer orchestration tooling for researchers to seamlessly launch modeling jobs on large-scale data – training, fine-tuning, inference.

  • Design model testing environments that automatically evaluate model performance without a human in the loop through semi-supervised metrics and process-aware priors.

  • Build model registries and automated deployment pipelines that support large-scale model tracking, versioning, and deployment on edge devices.

  • Develop monitoring tools for deployed models: detect model drift or anomalies, then trigger continuous training (CT) pipelines as needed.

  • Work with ML researchers, ML developers to design systems that meet their needs; work with software engineers to design systems that interact gracefully with existing infrastructure.

  • Build for our unique use-cases and problems – not for the average problem.

About You

  • Highly experienced using cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks) to train and evaluate ML models on large-scale data.

  • Experienced using off-the-shelf tools (MLflow, wandb) for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management (versioning, artifact registry, deployment, monitoring).

  • Highly experienced with Python and relevant SDKs (boto3, databricks-sdk, mlflow); familiar with modern ML frameworks (jax, pytorch).

  • Familiar accessing data through SQL, Databricks/Apache Spark, and raw parquet formats.

  • An engineer who thrives on building easy-to-use tools that researchers love to use.

  • Highly detail-oriented: you understand the nuances in our workflows and respect the challenges that come with large-scale ML training and deployment to edge devices.

  • Open-minded and independent thinker – well-versed in building tailor-made solutions that address real pain points.

  • An executor who can both independently complete technical project objectives and provide domain expertise to guide engineering design decisions.

Preferred (if any)

  • Chemical engineering, process engineering, or manufacturing domain knowledge (highly valued).

  • Past experience working with spectral data, time-series data, or sensor data.

  • Experience building or evaluating custom ML models.

  • Experience building real products and practicing user-centric design.

Benefits

  • Direct impact on product and culture.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability, Transportation benefit, Health and Wellness benefit, and more.
  • 401k plan with employer matching
  • Equity
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and professional development.
  • Access to Greentown Labs' extensive network of cleantech startups.

Learn How We Think

  • Learn about our startup journey: Our Journey
  • How we're combating climate change: AI-Powered Climate Tech

Why You'll Love it Here

  • A front-row seat at Greentown Labs, North America's largest cleantech innovation hub, in a Somerville neighborhood ranked one of the coolest in the world

  • Real recognition: 2026 World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, Gold 2026 Edison Award, Unilever Startup of the Year, Innovator Awards by both Coca-Cola and ABInBev, and more

  • A team that celebrates together from rooftop lunches, ping pong matches, Lunch & Learns, and regular team events

  • Competitive salary, equity, and a 401(k) with company match

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus short- and long-term disability and life insurance

  • Flexible time off and 12 company-paid holidays

  • A conference and learning budget to keep growing your craft

  • Greentown Labs membership and a transportation benefit for your commute


Our Interview Process
1. Phone screen with Laminar Head of Ops or Recruiter (15-20 minutes)
2. Intro call with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)
3. On-site interview, including short tour of GTL, overview of tech, and interview/presentation with the Hiring Manager and a few team members. Depending on the role, a skills exercise that should take no longer than an hour to prep, would be sent ahead of time. We record your skills exercise to share with any team members who could not join the interview and/or with Founder's ahead of their Founder's Interview. If you are not local, we can conduct this virtually.
4. Finalists for Full-Time positions will have a Founder’s Interview in-person
Final steps:
Two professional references are requested, ideally one from your current organization and one who served as your Manager
If an Offer Letter is extended, a Background check is conducted

Laminar (formerly H2Ok) is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. So, to the women and nonbinary folks out there feeling unsure if you're a perfect fit, we strongly encourage you to apply! If you're ready to play a key role in scaling a game-changing company that’s transforming the industrial sector and advancing sustainability, we want to hear from you!

title: Supplier Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title

Supplier Quality Specialist

Job Description

Supplier Quality Specialist

The Supplier Quality Specialist supports supplier quality management activities, including ASL administration, supplier performance monitoring, SCARs, and Supplier Quality Agreements. Working cross-functionally, this role helps maintain supplier data, track performance, and support compliance with quality and regulatory requirements

Your role:

· Manage supplier qualification and lifecycle activities, including supplier onboarding, Approved Supplier List (ASL) maintenance, qualification records, supplier changes, periodic reviews, and Supplier Quality Agreement administration. Ensure all supplier documentation is accurate, complete, current, and maintained within applicable quality systems.

· Monitor supplier performance and quality compliance by collecting, analyzing, and reporting supplier quality, delivery, and compliance metrics. Identify performance trends, communicate risks, and escalate issues to appropriate stakeholders to support proactive supplier management.

· Coordinate supplier quality issue resolution activities, including Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), investigations, and follow-up actions. Track timelines, maintain records, and support closure of supplier-related quality concerns in collaboration with internal and external partners.

· Support and continuously improve supplier quality processes, including supplier selection and qualification, ASL management, performance monitoring, SCARs, and Supplier Quality Agreements. Maintain procedures, work instructions, templates, and forms while assisting with implementation of process enhancements that improve compliance, efficiency, and effectiveness.

title: Faculty position, Neuronal Cell Biology and Cryo-ET/vEM
description:
We seek an investigator who will establish an independent, multidisciplinary research program addressing fundamental questions in neuronal cell biology through the integration of mechanistic approaches with advanced structural and cellular imaging. Areas of particular interest include the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying synaptogenesis and synaptic transmission, polarized trafficking and organelle dynamics in neurons, neuronal genome organization, and other aspects of neuronal architecture and function that can be uniquely interrogated through cryo-ET and vEM. Investigators developing new cryo-ET, vEM, correlative imaging, or quantitative image-analysis approaches for neuronal cell biology are also strongly encouraged to apply.

Department of Developmental Neurobiology

Center of Excellence for Structural Cell Biology and Neuronal Cell Biology Division
St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital

The Center of Excellence for Structural Cell Biology (CoE-SCB) and the Division of Neuronal Cell Biology in the Department of Developmental Neurobiology at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital invites applications from exceptional and creative scientists for a faculty position focused on neuronal cell biology and the application and development of cryogenic electron tomography (cryo-ET) and volume electron microscopy (vEM). The successful candidate will join the CoE-SCB and the Division of Neuronal Cell Biology, holding a faculty appointment in the Department of Developmental Neurobiology, creating a close scientific interface between these highly collaborative research environments.

We seek an investigator who will establish an independent, multidisciplinary research program addressing fundamental questions in neuronal cell biology through the integration of mechanistic approaches with advanced structural and cellular imaging. Areas of particular interest include the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying synaptogenesis and synaptic transmission, polarized trafficking and organelle dynamics in neurons, neuronal genome organization, and other aspects of neuronal architecture and function that can be uniquely interrogated through cryo-ET and vEM. Investigators developing new cryo-ET, vEM, correlative imaging, or quantitative image-analysis approaches for neuronal cell biology are also strongly encouraged to apply.

This recruitment represents a joint strategic effort between the CoE-SCB and the Division of Neuronal Cell Biology within the Department of Developmental Neurobiology to establish a research program that bridges molecular, organellar, and cellular scales. The CoE-SCB provides an integrated environment for structural cell biology, bringing together expertise in cryo-EM, cryo-ET, cryogenic volume imaging, correlative microscopy, and computational image analysis. The Center works closely with investigators across St. Jude as well as external academic and industry partners to develop and deploy emerging technologies for understanding biological mechanisms directly within cells and tissues.

The Department of Developmental Neurobiology provides an outstanding complementary environment for investigating neuronal development, organization, and function. Investigators have access to specialized resources that include human stem-cell systems, advanced live-cell and super-resolution imaging, Lattice Light Sheet microscopy, Meso-SPIM instrumentation, and sophisticated image processing and analysis. Together, the capabilities of the Division of Neuronal Cell Biology within the Department of Developmental Neurobiology and the CoE-SCB provide an exceptional opportunity to connect dynamic cellular processes with molecular and ultrastructural organization across an unusually broad range of spatial and temporal scales.

We are particularly interested in early-career investigators who are excited by the opportunity to build an ambitious research program at the interface of neuronal cell biology and structural cell biology and to contribute intellectually and technologically to the growing cryo-ET and vEM community at St. Jude.

St. Jude provides highly competitive recruitment packages, including substantial startup funding, equipment, laboratory space, personnel support, and continued institutional support beyond the startup period. The Department of Developmental Neurobiology and the CoE-SCB are housed within St. Jude’s 625,000-square-foot Advanced Research Center, designed specifically to support interdisciplinary research and cutting-edge technologies.

Faculty appointments at the Assistant or Associate Member level may be considered.

Successful applicants should hold a PhD and/or MD degree, have at least three years of relevant postgraduate experience, and demonstrate a strong record of scientific productivity and the potential to develop an innovative, independent research program.

To apply:

Interested applicants should submit a curriculum vitae, a 2–3 page statement of research interests, and the names of three references directly via the online application.

For more information:

DNBFacultySearch@stjude.org

Center of Excellence for Structural Cell Biology
Neuronal Cell Biology Division, Department of Developmental Neurobiology
St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital

title: Regional Pricing Coordinator
description:
Position Purpose:

The Regional Pricing Coordinator is responsible for maintaining pricing for our branch locations. The Regional Pricing Coordinator will also use analytics and optimizing pricing strategies to enhance profitability. This role demands leveraging advanced Excel skills to perform comprehensive sales and item analysis, alongside maintaining and updating the pricing database to support critical pricing functions. The successful candidate will possess exceptional communication skills to effectively liaise with all levels of management, ensuring seamless implementation of daily and quarterly pricing adjustments to drive business growth.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and management at all levels to implement timely pricing adjustments, enhancing operational efficiency and profitability.

  • Maintain and diligently update the pricing database, ensuring accuracy in pricing to support decision-making processes while ensuring SOX compliant audit trails

  • Coordinate supplier cost changes into appropriate price changes with field teams

  • Apply analytical skills to identify market opportunities and risks, driving continuous improvement in pricing strategies and financial performance.

  • Serve as a pivotal communication link between field team members and management, providing insights and recommendations based on data-driven analyses.

  • Utilize advanced Excel skills to conduct comprehensive sales and item analyses, ensuring effective price and margin optimization across the region.

  • Lead pricing reviews and administer strategic price changes, closely aligning with organizational objectives and market trends.

  • Embrace a service-oriented approach, demonstrating flexibility and technical proficiency in tools such as Agility, OutSystems, Power Bi, to adapt to dynamic market conditions effectively.

Direct Manager Direct Reports:

  • Reports to: The Regional Pricing Coordinator reports directly to the Regional Pricing Manager.

  • Direct Reports: This position does not have any direct reports.


Travel Requirements:

The Regional Pricing Coordinator required to travel up to 25% of the time to regional offices and client locations to support pricing strategy implementation. Regional Pricing Coordinators are encouraged to visit branch locations at lead once a quarter.

Physical Requirements:

The role of Regional Pricing Coordinator primarily involves work in a standard office environment. The position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while using a computer, including frequent use of a keyboard, mouse, and related hardware. The individual must have the capacity to communicate clearly in both written and verbal forms and engage in regular meetings with team members and management, which may include video conferencing. Initially, no specific physical demands exceed normal office-based activity levels. However, SRS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job effectively.


Working Conditions:

The Regional Pricing Coordinator position at the Company offers a hybrid work environment, blending both in-office commitments and remote work flexibility with most work being remote. This arrangement is designed to support a balance between collaborative engagement when necessary and independent productivity. The role is situated in a dynamic and fast-paced setting, where professionals are expected to operate efficiently under deadlines and contribute to timely decision-making processes. Tasked with significant responsibilities in price and margin activities, individuals in this position must exhibit adaptability and a proactive approach, as priorities can shift based on market demands and organizational objectives. This structure underscores the importance of self-motivation and effective communication across all levels of the company to ensure the accurate and timely execution of pricing strategies.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Finance, Statistics, Pricing, or a closely related field preferred. Equivalent professional experience in Excel and analysis may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including but not limited to VLOOKUPs, complex formulas, shortcut keys, and data entry.

  • Experience with Power Bi (or similar analytics platform), with a preference for those familiar with Agility or similar platforms.

  • Prior experience in a corporate setting, with a focus on wholesale, distribution, or business-to-business (B2B) environments preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience in pricing, sales, and item analysis, with a history of contributing to price and margin optimization.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a capability to effectively interact with field team members and management at all levels.

  • Strong analytical mindset with a service-oriented attitude.

  • Proven ability to work independently while being adaptive and flexible in response to dynamic business needs.

  • Must be technically savvy and possess a personable disposition.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Analytical Proficiency: Demonstrated capability in leveraging analytical tools and methodologies to enhance pricing strategies and drive data-driven decision-making processes.

  • Pricing Experience: Previous pricing experience that demonstrates a robust proficiency and commitment to excellence in pricing strategy.

  • Industry Exposure: Experience in a similar capacity within roofing, construction, or similar industries will be highly regarded, contributing to a more nuanced understanding of the market dynamics relevant to SRS.

  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in utilizing systems beyond Agility for comprehensive data management and strategic pricing automation, ensuring seamless integration and optimization of pricing functionalities.

  • Financial Acumen: Strong foundational understanding of financial principles, ability to read an income statement, and economic trends to inform pricing strategies that align with the organization’s fiscal goals.

  • Project Management Skills: Proven effectiveness in managing cross-functional projects with attention to detail, ensuring timely and successful project delivery in alignment with corporate objectives.

  • Advanced Excel Skills: Expertise in more complex Excel functionalities, such as data modeling, vlookup, and shortcut keys, will be a significant advantage, supporting sophisticated data analysis and reporting requirements.

  • Change Management Experience: Familiarity with facilitating organizational change regarding pricing structures or related initiatives, highlighting the ability to advocate and implement pricing reforms successfully.

  • Innovation and Initiative: A track record of initiating innovative pricing approaches and problem-solving that have resulted in measurable performance improvements at the regional or organizational level.

Minimum Education:

Highschool Diploma/GED or an Associate degree in Mathematics, Finance, Statistics, Pricing, or a related field. However, significant professional experience in Excel and data analysis may be considered as equivalent to formal educational qualifications.


Preferred Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field.


Minimum Years Of Work Experience:

For consideration as a Regional Pricing Coordinator, candidates must have at least 2 years of relevant work experience in pricing or a related field. This experience should encompass the use of advanced Excel skills for data analysis, database management, and adaptation to dynamic pricing strategies in a corporate setting.

Competencies:

  • Analytical Skills: Capable of conducting detailed sales and item analysis for price and margin optimization. Demonstrating proficiency in data mining and financial analysis to support pricing strategies.

  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Excel, including VLOOKUPs, formulas, and shortcut keys, to effectively manage and manipulate pricing data. Technically-savvy with systems such as Agility, for maintaining and updating the database.

  • Communication Skills: Exhibiting excellent verbal and written communication abilities to articulate pricing changes and strategies to field team members and management effectively.

  • Attention to Detail: Ability to manage daily pricing changes accurately, ensuring precision in data entry and validation for reliable analysis and reporting.

  • Organizational Skills: Demonstrated capacity to manage multiple tasks related to pricing, and pricing analysis, maintaining a structured approach to prioritize tasks efficiently.

  • Financial Acumen: In-depth understanding of finance principles, contributing to informed decision-making in sales reporting, financial analysis, and pricing initiatives.

  • Problem-Solving Ability: Adept at identifying and resolving issues creatively to meet pricing goals and improve profitability, leveraging analytical insights and technical tools.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Personable and flexible, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment, bringing a service-oriented attitude to interactions with colleagues and stakeholders.

description:

Posted Job Title

Research Specialist B/C

Job Profile Title

Research Specialist B

Job Description Summary

The position will support the advancement of new therapeutics toward the clinic and contribute to the scientific work published from the lab. Its focus will be testing new engineered T cells and evaluating their functional activity, as a single agent or in combination, to enhance therapeutic T cell performance, particularly within tumor microenvironments. Both positions requires solid immunological laboratory skills, including CAR T cell manufacturing, flow cytometry, ELISA, and other in vitro assays, as well as experience with in vivo mouse studies, contributing to efforts to enhance the therapeutic index of these therapies and understand their resulting impacts within the tumor microenvironment.
The primary function of this Research Specialist B position is to conduct in vitro and in vivo mouse studies, and assist with day-to-day operation of the research bench, all within the BRITE (Shobaki) Lab under the direction of Nour Shobaki. The purpose of this position is to support mouse studies by generating and characterizing engineered immune therapeutics, growing and developing tumor cells, performing injections, monitoring animal health, weight, and therapeutic responses, and collecting datasets from the study (tumor growth, therapeutic engraftment, histology, ex vivo assays). This position also documents and organizes experimental data and contributes to the preparation of presentations and research publications, under the guidance of the Principal Investigator.

The primary function of this Research Specialist C position is to independently design, troubleshoot, and carry out in vitro and in vivo mouse studies, maintain the animal colony, and manage day-to-day operation of the research bench, all within the BRITE (Shobaki) Lab under the direction of Nour Shobaki. The purpose of this position is to establish mouse studies by generating and characterizing engineered immune therapeutics, growing and developing tumor cells, performing injections, monitoring animal health, weight, and therapeutic responses, and collecting datasets from the study (tumor growth, therapeutic engraftment, histology, ex vivo assays). This position also generates and organizes the experimental data needed to support grant applications and IND-enabling studies, and contributes written sections to progress reports and manuscripts, with final authorship and submission led by the Principal Investigator.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities Research Specialist B

  • Conduct in vitro immunological functional assays, including CAR T cell manufacturing, flow cytometry, and ELISA, following established protocols; troubleshoot experimental issues as they arise

  • Conduct in vivo mouse studies, executing established protocols under the direction of the PI

  • Prepare tumor cells and engineered immune therapies for in vivo experiments, documenting their characteristics and performing assays to assess functional performance

  • Monitor and collect datasets associated with animal studies, including health monitoring and weights, tumor growth (caliper, bioimaging), bleeds, and necropsies. Perform IV, IT, IP, and SC injections of tumor cells and therapeutics.

  • Prepare tissues at necropsy by fixing and isolating cells for functional and flow cytometric analysis, IHC, and spatial transcriptomic studies.

  • Document experimental data, perform data analysis, and contribute to the preparation of presentations and research publications under the guidance of the Principal Investigator.

  • Participate in lab management and support lab set-up and operations, including ordering, organizing, and maintaining reagents, equipment, and protocols

  • Characterize transgenic mice and maintain colony.

  • Train and provide guidance to other lab members as needed.

Job Responsibilities Research Specialist C

  • Independently design, troubleshoot, and perform in vitro immunological functional assays, including CAR T cell manufacturing, flow cytometry, and ELISA; contribute to development of new methods using state-of-the-art techniques.

  • Independently design, troubleshoot, and execute in vivo mouse studies using established protocols, and contribute to development of new protocols under the direction of the lab supervisor

  • Modify and prepare tumor cells and engineered immune therapies for in vivo mouse experiments, documenting their characteristics and performing assays defining functional performance.

  • Monitor and collect datasets associated with animal studies, including health monitoring and weights, tumor growth (caliper, bioimaging), bleeds, and necropsies. Perform IV, IT, IP, and SC injections of tumor cells and therapeutics

  • Prepare tissues at necropsy by fixing and isolating cells for functional and flow cytometric analysis, IHC, and spatial transcriptomic studies.

  • Document experimental data, perform data analysis, generate and organize the data needed to support grant applications and IND-enabling studies, and write sections of manuscripts and progress reports describing research results.

  • Provide scientific and technical guidance and mentorship to other lab members and trainees, contributing to research team performance.

  • Manage day-to-day research bench operations, including maintaining general lab supplies and reagent inventory, equipment upkeep, and protocol organization

  • Characterize transgenic mice and maintain colony.

Position is funded for one year with the possibility of being extended.

Qualifications

Required:

Research Specialist B:

  • Bachelor's degree in Immunology, Cell Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field, with 1–2 years of relevant research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Hands-on experience with in vitro immunological assays, including flow cytometry, ELISA, and cell culture
  • Exposure to in vivo mouse models, including tumor inoculation, therapeutic administration, or monitoring
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills

Research Specialist C:

  • Bachelor's degree in Immunology, Cell Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field, with 3–5 years of relevant research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Hands-on experience with in vitro immunological assays, including flow cytometry, ELISA, cell culture, and co-culture killing assays
  • Experience with in vivo mouse models, including tumor inoculation, therapeutic administration, and monitoring
  • Experience with immunotherapy
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills

Preferred:

  • Experience with CAR T cells or cell-based immunotherapies
  • Experience with co-culture killing assays
  • Experience with tissue processing techniques, including IHC and spatial transcriptomics
  • Experience with bioimaging for tumor growth assessment
  • Familiarity with characterizing transgenic mice or maintaining mouse colonies, including immunodeficient strains (e.g., NSG)
  • Prior contribution to research presentations or publications
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics approaches for spatial transcriptomics or other high-dimensional datasets
  • Familiarity with microbiology

Risk Management

Job Description:

The Model Validation (MV) group is a centralized model risk management function within the Bank. The MV team is responsible for the vetting and approval of complex mathematical and statistical models used in credit lending, business operations, and stress testing. By ensuring an objective and independent evaluation of models, the model validation function is critical to the effective measurement and management of risk across the TD Bank Group.

Model validators perform validation of all models deemed in-scope by the bank-wide Model Risk Policy. These models are used in the Bank for a variety of purposes, including scoring credit risk (acquisitions and account management) and Economic and Regulatory Capital (e.g. Probability of Default, Exposure at Default, Loss Given Default), conducting stress testing, detecting fraud behaviors, and marketing retail products. The focus of this role is on validating models used in credit risk scoring and regulatory stress testing exercises, which may use traditional statistical methodologies as well as machine learning approaches. Validation of models involves testing models' performance and conceptual soundness, developing independent benchmark models, preparing detailed reports summarizing the validation and its outcome, and maintaining productive working relationships with internal model development groups and external vendors who have developed customized models for TD.

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.



Job Summary
The Manufacturing Engineering Manager will lead a team of manufacturing engineers, overseeing the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes within SYNNEX Corporation. This role focuses on optimizing production efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

Job Responsibilities
* Lead and mentor a team of manufacturing engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
* Develop, implement, and maintain robust manufacturing processes for new and existing products, ensuring scalability and adherence to quality standards.
* Drive process optimization initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) to enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and improve product quality.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Supply Chain, Quality, and Production teams to ensure seamless product introduction and successful manufacturing operations.
* Manage manufacturing engineering projects, including scope definition, resource allocation, budget control, and timeline management.
* Identify and evaluate new manufacturing technologies, equipment, and materials to improve production capabilities and competitive advantage.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for manufacturing processes, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant safety regulations, quality standards (e.g., ISO), and environmental policies.
* Provide technical support and expertise to production teams, troubleshooting manufacturing issues and implementing long-term solutions.
* Prepare and present reports on manufacturing performance, project status, and improvement initiatives to senior management.

Job Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. Master's degree preferred.
* 7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Proven track record of successfully leading and developing manufacturing engineering teams.
* Strong knowledge of various manufacturing processes, including assembly, test, and automation.
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies. Certification (e.g., Green Belt, Black Belt) is a plus.
* Proficient in using CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD) and other engineering tools.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is highly desirable.
* Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Exceptional communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic manufacturing environment.

title: Early Career Consult Program - Associate AI Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Your role

The Associate AI Engineer is an entry-level technical role supporting the design, development, deployment, and optimization of artificial intelligence, machine learning, analytics, and data-driven solutions. Working alongside experienced AI Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders, you will develop foundational skills in modern AI technologies, cloud platforms, software engineering, data engineering, analytics, and responsible AI practices.


Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next.

This role offers two areas of specialization within a common AI Engineering career framework:

AI Engineering Path

Build, test, and deploy AI-powered applications, generative AI solutions, intelligent agents, and machine learning capabilities that help solve business challenges and improve user experiences.

Data Engineering & Analytics Path

Prepare, manage, and optimize the data foundations that power AI, machine learning, analytics, and business intelligence solutions.

Candidates may begin in one focus area but will gain exposure to both disciplines as they develop their careers.


What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities (All Associates)

  • Collaborate with technical teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and support AI-enabled business outcomes.
  • Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of AI and data solutions.
  • Participate in agile development practices, code reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Document technical solutions, data sources, workflows, assumptions, and operational procedures.
  • Apply security, governance, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI standards in all work.
  • Build expertise in modern cloud, AI, and data technologies through hands-on learning and project experience.

AI Engineering Focus

  • Support the development of AI, machine learning, and generative AI applications.
  • Assist in building intelligent agents, conversational experiences, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Develop and maintain application components, APIs, integrations, and automation capabilities.
  • Help evaluate model performance, response quality, scalability, and user experience.
  • Participate in testing, monitoring, and optimization of AI solutions.
  • Learn modern AI frameworks, cloud AI services, and software engineering practices.

Data Engineering & Analytics Focus

  • Collect, cleanse, transform, validate, and prepare structured and unstructured data for AI and analytics solutions.
  • Use SQL, Python, and approved platform tools to query, manipulate, and analyze data.
  • Assist with exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, insights, and data quality issues.
  • Support the creation of data workflows, reusable scripts, data pipelines, and data preparation processes.
  • Help prepare training data, features, and evaluation datasets for machine learning and AI initiatives.
  • Contribute to data governance, quality, lineage, and operational excellence practices.

Common Skills

  • Python programming
  • Cloud platform fundamentals
  • Technical documentation
  • Collaboration and communication
  • Responsible AI and technology governance

  • AI application development
  • Intelligent agents and automation
  • Prompt engineering and AI solution testing
  • APIs and system integration
  • Machine learning concepts

  • SQL and data querying
  • Data preparation and transformation
  • Data quality and validation
  • Exploratory data analysis
  • Data pipelines and workflows

title: Senior Team Lead, Vehicle Technicians
description:
As the Senior Team Lead, Fleet Support for Base Operations, you will serve as both the technical player-coach and the strategic operational owner responsible for executing daily vehicle maintenance while evolving the backbone of Zoox’s Base Operations. You will combine hands-on diagnostic and repair responsibilities with high-level shop execution, directing technicians and ensuring the holistic readiness, safety, and strategic deployment of our Robotaxi fleet.

Acting as a people leader and change driver, you will champion operational excellence, scale-readiness, and standardization across the workshop network. You will be accountable for implementing and improving Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), enforcing EH&S and 5S standards, and fostering a culture of urgency and continuous improvement. Serving as the vital link between operations management and the shop floor, you will work closely with Fleet Support Specialists, Engineering, Facilities, and Operations Leadership. You will translate management's high-level objectives into practical, daily instructions for technicians, while simultaneously elevating floor-level constraints, technical blockers, and resource needs back to leadership

Shift: 1st Shift, Monday - Friday, 9am - 6pm

In this role, you will:

  • Manage the full team lifecycle, including workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, and performance management, to build high-performing teams rooted in safety and quality.
  • Coach and develop technicians and leads by establishing clear expectations, providing consistent feedback, and creating succession plans to support organizational scaling.
  • Own the development and enforcement of SOPs across all workflows (inspections, maintenance, upgrades), ensuring documentation is audited and aligned with real-world execution.
  • Drive operational excellence by utilizing data, root cause analysis, and standard work methodologies to improve throughput, vehicle uptime, and process repeatability.
  • Ensure operational readiness by verifying that tools, equipment, parts, and facilities are standardized, maintained, and fully available to meet operational demand.
  • Champion EHS & 5S standards, maintaining a clean, organized, and compliant work environment while embedding safety into daily behaviors and decision-making.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, leading corrective and preventive actions to address safety concerns, near misses, and process gaps.
  • Define and track critical KPIs related to fleet readiness, quality, and downtime, using data insights to drive accountability and prevent systemic failures.
  • Partner with Engineering, Test, and Facilities teams to align on operational execution with company roadmaps, testing milestones, and evolving requirements.
  • Lead strategic scaling initiatives, translating high-level goals into practical plans for increased fleet size, new platforms, and expanded facility operations.
  • Serve as the primary technical escalation point, overseeing complex maintenance and configuration changes to ensure strict adherence to quality standards.
  • Provide data-backed communication to leadership and stakeholders regarding operational risks, constraints, and trade-offs to support agile decision-making.
  • Work alongside local leadership to align on location needs, goals, and handle escalated situations

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on automotive technician experience.
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience. Experience leading teams in technical, automotive, or high-volume service environments.
  • Proven experience implementing and improving SOPs, standard work, and operational processes in complex technical environments, with demonstrated success leading high-output teams.
  • Strong understanding of EH&S compliance, safety programs, and 5S methodologies.
  • Extensive knowledge of automotive systems, diagnostic methods, parts, and tools.
  • High proficiency in CAN/LIN architecture, wiring diagrams, and soldering.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, drive initiatives to completion, and operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally and nationally (50%+), with a clean driving record.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree
  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, or a similar safety-critical industry
  • Experience working in R&D, testing, or pre-production environments, including engineering labs or prototype operations.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience supporting scaling operations, new site launches, or fleet expansion initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of EV architectures and high-voltage systems.
  • Experience utilizing specialized test equipment (NVH, vehicle dynamics, thermal, durability).
  • Technical trade school certificate or Associate Degree in automotive repair.

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

  • Participate in the recruitment of new volunteers

title: ASIA SSC IT Network Engineer
description:
Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Network Infrastructure

  • Implement, configure, maintain, and support LAN and wireless network environments.

  • Manage and support Cisco routers, switches, and related network infrastructure.

  • Manage and support HPE Aruba wireless and network infrastructure.

  • Configure and maintain FortiGate firewalls and related security infrastructure.

  • Support network connectivity between production sites, offices, servers, and other infrastructure.

  • Support VLAN, routing, switching, and network segmentation activities.

  • Perform network capacity and performance assessments when required.

2. Network Monitoring and Operations

  • Monitor network infrastructure performance, availability, bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, and connectivity using Valeo monitoring tools such as MoVI.

  • Proactively investigate monitoring alerts and network abnormalities.

  • Conduct regular network health checks .

  • Identify potential network issues before they impact business operations.

  • Maintain high network availability and reliability.

  • Perform daily network operational tasks and ensure timely resolution of issues.

3. Incident Management and Troubleshooting

  • Respond to network incidents according to defined SLA and operational procedures.

  • Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, and performance-related issues.

  • Analyze network logs, monitoring information, packet captures, and device diagnostic information.

  • Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major or recurring network incidents.

  • Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.

  • Escalate complex technical issues to internal teams or network equipment vendors when required.

4. Firewall and Network Security

  • Configure and maintain FortiGate firewall policies, NAT, routing, and security settings.

  • Manage and support IPSec and SSL VPN connectivity.

  • Support network segmentation and access-control requirements.

  • Review firewall rules and identify unnecessary, obsolete, or overly permissive rules.

  • Support security-related investigations and remediation activities.

  • Work with cybersecurity teams to address network security vulnerabilities and incidents.

  • Support endpoint/network security technologies such as Windows Defender and Trellix where required.

5. Change Management

  • Plan and execute network changes in accordance with Valeo Change Management procedures.

  • Prepare implementation plans, test plans, validation procedures, and rollback plans.

  • Perform network changes during approved maintenance windows.

  • Conduct post-change validation and confirm service availability.

  • Ensure all network changes are properly documented.

  • Minimize business and production impact during network maintenance activities.

6. Documentation

  • Maintain up-to-date network diagrams and infrastructure documentation.

  • Maintain IP address, VLAN, subnet, routing, firewall, and network device information.

  • Document network configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting procedures.

  • Update documentation following network changes, upgrades, or infrastructure modifications.

  • Create and maintain Knowledge Base articles and operational guides.
