About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

title: Revenue Officer
location: NSW - Sydney, CBD, Inner West and Eastern Suburbs
description:
Job Description:

Lead accurate and timely health fund billing that supports exceptional patient care across one of Australia's largest not-for-profit health and aged care organisations.


  • Play a critical role in healthcare revenue management: Ensure accurate patient billing, claims processing and debt management in accordance with Health Fund contracts, Medicare requirements and legislative obligations.
  • Be a trusted billing and revenue specialist: Partner with Health Funds, Patient Administration Services and clinical teams to maintain billing accuracy, resolve enquiries and optimise revenue outcomes.
  • Make a meaningful impact: Support sustainable healthcare delivery by ensuring the integrity of revenue processes that enable St Vincent's Health Australia to continue providing compassionate care to communities across Australia.



About St Vincent's Health Australia

At St Vincent's Health Australia (SVHA), we are shaping a future health and aged care system that supports people with life-changing care, wherever and whoever they are.


Founded by the Sisters of Charity in 1857, St Vincent's is one of Australia's leading not-for-profit health and aged care organisations. Our 30,000 dedicated people provide compassionate care through public and private hospitals, aged care residences, virtual care and services delivered at home across New South Wales, Queensland and Victoria.


Our vision is for every person to receive excellent and compassionate care through a better and fairer health and aged care system. Together, we are focused on enhancing our impact, connecting care and transforming the system.

Our work is grounded in our values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence.


About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Revenue Officer to join our Private Division Revenue & Billing Team.

Reporting to the Revenue Manager, this role plays a pivotal part in ensuring the accurate, compliant and timely billing of private patient accounts and management of health fund receivables across the Private Division.

As a Revenue Officer, you will be responsible for preparing and submitting health fund claims, managing aged debt, reconciling payments, resolving billing enquiries and ensuring compliance with Health Fund contractual requirements and Medicare rules.

You will work closely with Health Funds, Patient Administration Services, Theatre Staff, Clinical teams and broader revenue stakeholders to ensure billing accuracy and support continuous improvement across revenue processes.


This opportunity is available across Victoria, New South Wales and Queensland within SVHA's Private Division.


Your Key Responsibilities

As the Revenue Officer, you will:

  • Produce accurate and timely patient accounts in accordance with Health Fund contract business rules and Medicare requirements.
  • Ensure all claim forms, certifications and supporting documentation are completed and submitted in compliance with legislative and contractual obligations.
  • Accurately enter MBS item numbers and prostheses rebate codes.
  • Review theatre activity, coding and supporting documentation prior to billing.
  • Follow up missing item numbers, certificates and supporting information required for claim submission.
  • Act as a key point of contact for revenue-related enquiries from staff, patients and Health Funds.
  • Liaise with Health Funds regarding outstanding claims, payment issues and billing queries.
  • Manage aged debt and debtor balances in accordance with departmental KPIs and contractual agreements.
  • Perform bank reconciliations and ensure timely receipting of payments and remittances.
  • Process account adjustments and debt write-offs within approved delegations.
  • Support escalation of outstanding accounts and debt collection processes as required.
  • Collaborate with Doctors' rooms regarding MBS items, theatre billing requirements and certification documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements, billing quality enhancements and staff education.
  • Contribute to standardisation of billing practices and claim documentation across the Private Division.
  • Assist with ongoing compliance activities relating to healthcare legislation, health fund contractual requirements and organisational policies.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Participate in ongoing education and training to remain current with Health Fund billing requirements and industry updates.



About You

You are a detail-oriented revenue professional with experience in healthcare billing, or revenue management.

You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy, compliance and customer service are critical. You are confident managing competing priorities, resolving billing issues and building positive relationships with stakeholders.


You bring a collaborative approach, strong attention to detail and a commitment to supporting high-quality healthcare services through effective revenue management practices.

You Will Bring

  • Previous experience in a Billing within a private healthcare setting.
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting Health Fund contracts and applying billing rules.
  • Experience using Patient Administration Systems within a healthcare environment.
  • Working knowledge and understanding of medical terminology.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience managing aged debt and debt collection activities.
  • Ability to prioritise work effectively and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • High-level computer and administrative skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously while contributing positively within a team environment.
  • A proactive, adaptable and customer-focused approach to work.

Highly Regarded

  • Previous Health Fund or Hospital experience.
  • Knowledge of the private health insurance industry.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare billing requirements and rules.
  • Understanding of relevant healthcare legislation and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience working in a complex healthcare or hospital environment.
  • Strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.



Why Join St Vincent's?

  • Join a purpose-driven organisation
    Support healthcare services that improve the lives of patients, residents and communities across Australia.
  • Make a direct impact on healthcare operations
    Contribute to the financial sustainability and effectiveness of one of Australia's largest not-for-profit healthcare providers.
  • Develop your healthcare revenue expertise
    Gain exposure to Health Fund billing, Medicare requirements, revenue optimisation and private hospital funding models.
  • Work with experienced healthcare professionals
    Collaborate with revenue specialists, Health Information Services, clinical teams and Health Fund representatives.
  • Flexible and values-driven culture
    Join a supportive and inclusive environment committed to continuous improvement and professional growth.
  • Excellent benefits
    Access a range of benefits designed to support your financial wellbeing, professional growth and work-life balance, including salary packaging to increase your take-home pay, ongoing learning and development opportunities, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) support, Fitness Passport access and a supportive, values-driven workplace culture.



Apply Now

Join St Vincent's Health Australia and help deliver accurate, compliant and efficient revenue management processes that support exceptional patient care across Australia.



Applications may close before the advertised closing date.



Important Information

Employment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, including identification, right-to-work, reference and nationally coordinated criminal history checks. The successful applicant must also comply with applicable St Vincent's Health Australia screening and immunisation requirements.



St Vincent's Health Australia welcomes people from all backgrounds and beliefs. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to contribute their unique experiences.

title: Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
description:
Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
About Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions
Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions is a fast-growing defense technology company headquartered in the Tampa Bay area, Florida. Founded by U.S. and U.K. veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real-world employment of unmanned systems.
Role Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented Junior Electrical Engineering Technician to join our electrical integration team. In this role, you will build, integrate, and test wire harnesses, low-voltage electrical systems, and autonomy components for marine applications. You will work directly with the lead electrical engineer on marine power distribution, wire sizing, network topologies, and sensitive electronics, ensuring high-quality standards for marine durability and operational reliability.
Key Responsibilities
Harness & Cable Fabrication: Build, break out, route, and terminate low-voltage wire harnesses and custom cable assemblies.
Hardware & Systems Integration: Mount and wire autonomy hardware, sensors, marine communications equipment, Ethernet switches, and CAN bus networks.
Physical Installation: Route cabling neatly through tight marine spaces, bulkheads, and conduits, ensuring proper strain relief, bend radius, and chafe protection.
Testing & Verification: Conduct continuity, pinout, voltage, and ground checks; assist engineering with troubleshooting electrical and wiring faults.
Component Assembly: Perform precision hand soldering, weather-sealing, heat shrinking, and lug crimping.
Required Qualifications
Hands-on Experience: 2+ years of electrical assembly, wire harness building, or technician experience (marine, automotive, robotics, or industrial context preferred).
Electrical Diagnostics: Experience using Digital Multimeters (DMM), bench power supplies, and signal test equipment for troubleshooting and pinout validation.
Tools & Assembly Techniques: Proficiency in precision hand soldering, heat shrinking, weather-sealing, and operating manual/hydraulic crimpers for heavy-gauge lugs.
Power Systems: Practical familiarity working with 12–48VDC and 120VAC electrical systems.
Schematics & Diagrams: Ability to accurately read and interpret electrical schematics, pinout tables, and wiring diagrams
Preferred Experience
2–3 years of experience in marine electrical systems, unmanned surface vessels (USVs), or vehicle prototyping.
Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automotive, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Familiarity with CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANalyzer, Kvaser, Peak PCAN, Vehicle Spy).
ABYC (American Boat and Yacht Council) Electrical Certification.
Work Environment
Primarily onsite at Marcurius facilities in Clearwater, Florida, with direct work in workshops, vessels, docks, and field-testing environments. The role supports prototype development, electrical integration, and sea-trial preparation in a fast-paced setting with changing priorities and close cooperation across engineering, software, operations, and test teams.
Why Marcurius
Marcurius is a people-first, execution-focused organization assembling a small, high-impact team of engineers and operators. This role offers the opportunity to design and field electrical systems that directly enable real-world maritime missions and help build the technical foundation of a next-generation unmanned systems company.

title: EXECUTIVE, FINANCE
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Role Summary

The Executive, Finance is responsible for supporting the accounting and treasury functions by preparing and submitting financial reports, ensuring the accuracy of accounts payable/receivable, managing banking and treasury operations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role requires attention to detail, a strong understanding of financial reporting, and effective coordination with various stakeholders.

Key Outcomes

  • Timely Financial Reporting – Ensures the accurate and timely preparation of financial reports for the company or business unit.

  • Account Reconciliation – Ensures timely reconciliation of accounts payable, receivable, and bank transactions.

  • Operational Efficiency – Manages payment processing, petty cash disbursements, and banking operations efficiently.

  • Compliance with Policies – Adheres to internal policies and procedures, including tax compliance.

  • Support in Financial Closing – Assists in preparing closing reports and other month-end activities.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Handling Account Payables and Receivables

  • Ensure timely processing and update of accounts payable and receivable in line with company policies, tax legislation, and internal procedures.
  • Process unpaid bills, contractor claims, and other transactions related to accounts payable.
  • Review and update journal entries, debit/credit notes, and ensure timely reconciliation of A/R and A/P against the General Ledger (GL).

Banking Updates

  • Review and reconcile collections and related treasury functions to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Process payments and petty cash disbursements promptly, ensuring accuracy and adherence to company policies.
  • Monitor cash flow movements and ensure that sufficient funds are available for operations by managing transfers between accounts.

Prepare Account Closing Reports

  • Summarize monthly financial status by preparing detailed income statements and financial position reports.
  • Assist in the preparation of Cash Flow Reports and Group Reporting (GRP) within the required timeframes.
  • Prepare fixed asset schedules, debtor reports, and creditor reports for monthly account closings.

Prepare Accounts Reconciliation and Journals

  • Prepare and monitor Bank Reconciliation within the agreed timeline after receiving the bank statement.
  • Monitor daily cash flow movements and fund transfers to ensure sufficient funds for operations.
  • Perform creditor and debtor reconciliations on time and ensure all discrepancies are resolved promptly.

Assist in performing journal entries for monthly account closing processes.

  • Administration Related Matters / Ad-hoc Assignments
  • Perform general administrative duties such as managing mail, dispatching documents, and managing office stationery and filing systems.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties and other tasks assigned by the Head of Department (HOD) or immediate superior.

Core Competencies & Technical Expertise

1️. Technical Competencies

  • Financial Reporting & Compliance – Knowledge of financial reporting standards and the ability to ensure accurate submissions.
  • Accounts Payable & Receivable Management – Understanding of AP/AR processes and effective reconciliation practices.
  • Cash Flow & Banking – Ability to monitor and manage cash flow and oversee banking transactions.
  • Tax Compliance – Familiarity with tax requirements and internal procedures for compliance.
  • Accounting Systems & Software – Proficiency in accounting systems and spreadsheets for reconciliation and reporting.

2️. Team Collaboration

  • Task Prioritization – Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a timely and organized manner.
  • Team Collaboration – Works well within a team and coordinates with other departments for financial operations.
  • Process Improvement – Suggests improvements for operational efficiency and financial processes.

3️. Mindset & Behaviours

  • Attention to Detail – Ensures accuracy in financial data processing and reporting.
  • Accountability – Takes responsibility for assigned tasks and ensures that procedures are followed correctly.
  • Proactive Attitude – Anticipates potential issues and takes necessary action to prevent delays or discrepancies.

4️. Tools & Methodologies

  • Microsoft Excel – Strong skills in Excel for data analysis, reporting, and reconciliation.
  • Accounting Software – Familiarity with accounting systems and ERP tools used for financial reporting and reconciliation.
  • Banking and Payment Platforms – Experience with banking platforms for payment processing and monitoring transactions.

Qualifications & Experience

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.

Experience Requirements

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in a similar role within finance or accounting.
  • Familiarity with tax legislation, accounts reconciliation, and financial reporting is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of cash flow management and banking operations is an advantage.

title: Researcher/ Senior Researcher - Durbin Laboratory
description:
Join our Team!

The Durbin Laboratory within the Department of Oncology is seeking a highly motivated Researcher or Senior Researcher to join our team for a two-year position focused on the epigenetic regulation of transcription in cancer. This is an exciting opportunity for a talented scientist who is passionate about biomedical research and eager to contribute to groundbreaking discoveries in pediatric cancer biology.



In this role, you will utilize state-of-the-art approaches in murine modeling, molecular biology, cell biology, and functional genomics to investigate the transcriptional and chromatin-based mechanisms that drive aggressive cancers. Working within a highly collaborative research environment, you will help develop and characterize in vivo models of human disease while contributing to innovative therapeutic discovery efforts.


About the Durbin Laboratory

The Durbin lab is interested in a broad, “multi-omics” approach to the epigenetically-coded processes that drive pediatric cancer. The primary research focus of the Durbin laboratory involves studying epigenetic determinants of gene regulation and transcriptional regulatory complexes in pediatric solid tumors to identify synergistic ways to target cancer cell growth. We use functional genomics, chemical biology and epigenomics to identify and characterize these dominant transcriptional regulatory complexes, their co-activators and co-repressors to define mechanistically-based strategies for pediatric solid tumor therapy.


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in a biological or related scientific discipline.
  • Prior experience with genetic and/or xenograft rodent models of cancer is highly preferred
  • Hands-on experience working with genetic and/or xenograft rodent models of cancer.
  • Strong interest in cancer biology, epigenetics, and biomedical research.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in molecular biology techniques, including: western blotting, molecular cloning, and functional genomics technique.

Job Responsibilities:


  • Performs laboratory experiments independently using established techniques/protocols.
  • Sets up protocols, trouble shoots experiments using new or modified laboratory techniques.
  • Accurately records experimental procedures and data.
  • Prepares and reports results/ data leading to posters, presentations or publications
  • May provide guidance to entry-level employees.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned in order to meet the goals of the department and institution
  • Maintains regular and predictable attendance



Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant scientific area is required.

Senior Researcher Minimum Experience:

  • Two (2) years of relevant, post-degree work experience is required.
  • No experience is required with a Master's degree.

Researcher Minimum Experience:

  • No experience required



Why Join Us?

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research aimed at understanding and treating pediatric cancer. You will work alongside leading scientists, gain exposure to advanced technologies, and play a meaningful role in discoveries that have the potential to improve outcomes for children with cancer.


Compensation

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $60,320 - $105,040 per year for the role of Researcher/ Senior Researcher - Durbin Laboratory.

title: Product, Brand & Media Director
description:
As Product, Brand & Media Director, you will serve as the strategic architect and operational engine behind our growth, brand dominance, and go-to-market expansion. Reporting directly to the CMO, this high-impact position bridges visionary brand strategy with hands-on commercial and operational execution across diverse customer segments, from retail DIY and specialized trade contractors to large-scale B2B enterprise clients.

You will own the full strategic lifecycle: leading product portfolio innovation, refining complex pricing architectures, optimizing media investment portfolios, and directing integrated omnichannel campaigns. If you thrive at the intersection of data-driven strategy, operational speed, and cross-functional leadership (partnering seamlessly with Sales, Operations, R&D, and Supply Chain), this role offers the platform to drive top- and bottom-line transformation.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Business & Commercial Strategy: Achieve overall growth, profitability, and customer acquisition by leading short- and long-term product, brand, and media strategies across all distribution channels. You will analyze market trends to uncover expansion opportunities and partnering with teams—such as Data Intelligence and concessionary networks—to improve route-to-market execution.

  • Product Portfolio & Innovation Management: Direct the full lifecycle of the product line by identifying opportunities for portfolio optimization, line extensions, and new tech- or sustainability-focused offerings. By collaborating with Science & Technology and Operations teams, ensure products remain relevant, and profitable from launch to eventual repositioning or retirement.

  • Brand Strategy & Management: Define and protect our brand architecture, visual identity, and positioning through an understanding of consumer journeys and category dynamics. To boost brand awareness, consideration, and loyalty, oversee the production of marketing assets and guidelines while measuring brand performance to refine ongoing strategy.

  • Media, Communication & Customer Engagement: Plan and implement integrated omnichannel campaigns across traditional (ATL/BTL), digital, PR, and experiential marketing channels to build consumer connections. Responsibilities include setting tailored audience segmentation strategies, managing media agency performance, and optimizing budgets to maximize campaign Return on investment.

  • Pricing, Promotions and Revenue Growth: Create strategic pricing models and promotional campaigns that maximize seasonal demand while balancing profitability with market share goals. By evaluating promotional effectiveness alongside commercial and financial teams, ensure all revenue-generating activities directly align with overarching our priorities.

  • Market Intelligence & Analytics: Lead the collection and analysis of market, consumer, and competitor data, translating raw insights into applicable our decisions. Establish measurements dashboards to measure overall marketing effectiveness, innovation performance, and media spend efficiency.

  • Budget & Financial Management: Oversee annual marketing, media, innovation, and promotional budgets to ensure resources are deployed toward financial targets. Partner with Finance on forecasting, and reporting to maintain strict financial accountability and maximize return on marketing investments.

  • Leadership & Team Development: Lead, coach, and inspire diverse teams across marketing, brand, product, and media disciplines by setting clear performance goals and promoting a creative culture. Additionally, manage strategic supplier and agency partnerships while supporting ongoing talent acquisition, coaching, and succession planning.

Qualifications:

• 15+ years of progressive experience in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Management, or Commercial Leadership, including experience leading large, multifunctional teams.


• Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.


• Demonstrated track record in brand building, progress, and media planning across multiple channels, customer segments, and geographic markets.


• Fluent in English

title: FT Outbound Freight Handler
description:
As a FT Outbound Freight Handler, you will load and unload freight onto and off of equipment, as well as assist in the recouping of damaged freight.

Prepare, sweep, inspect and cleans trailer(s) before loading freight. Use safe lifting techniques to properly load and unload freight. Select and use proper freight handling equipment to load and unload freight. Such equipment may include forklifts with appropriate hardware, hand trucks, drum trucks, pallet jacks, rollers, and any other available equipment to move, load, arrange, rearrange, and unload freight. Weigh and dimension shipments to ensure proper classification, freight rating, and safe handling. Plan cube utilization and proper weight distribution when loading freight. Count and inspect the condition of freight, documenting any shortages or damage. Review freight bills for special instructions. Check manifests for existing exceptions and check the label and the destination code on manifests against freight bills. Check for special instructions, weight distributions on headloads, and check headloads against the freight bills when loading freight. Verify the hazardous material product description, determine any discrepancies in the paperwork, and verify proper placarding when loading hazardous material. Properly block and brace freight to prevent shifting during transport.

For this role, we prefer you have a High School Diploma or GED. You must have the ability to satisfactorily pass a background check and an alcohol and drug test. We would prefer for you to have prior experience as a Forklift Operator, Dock or Warehouse Worker, or Material Handler. We would also prefer you to have previously held a Forklift Certification. title: Digital Delivery Manager
description:
Digital Delivery Manager - Digital Retail/Insurance

Looking to join a great digital team, with interesting projects, in a company that genuinely cares about its people and sustainability?


At Storebrand Digital our driving force is to help make “a future to look forward to”. Creating great digital solutions for our customers and business units is a key part of that. Our Digital Insurance team is a strongly skilled team making solutions combining systems we build and systems we buy. We are on a growth journey and we are now strengthening our team with this key role. Your work will have a direct impact on many thousands of customers every single day. We are looking for a motivated and highly skilled person who wants to go the extra mile, has drive to get things done and is dedicated to their profession.



About the role

Our Digital Delivery Mangers are technical leaders in our digital insurance team - is all about getting things done, making sure that the teams are delivering with both the right focus, speed and quality.

In this role, you will work closely with our Claims area to shape and deliver customer-friendly digital solutions that make claims handling simpler, faster and automated for our customers, while also giving claims handlers better tools and support in their everyday work. You will be involved in initiatives across the claims value chain, from customer-facing services to core operational processes, automatisn and integrations with both internal and external systems.

  • Support Area Product Manager in defining realistic digital service & product roadmaps
  • Personell leader for developers and tech lead
  • Be the champion of getting things done and into production – make great work happen and getting digital solutions delivered
  • Have the overview of status of what is happening across the developer teams and projects
  • Manage dependencies and risks – identifying and removing roadblocks
  • Strong technical understanding (ideally you will have been a developer or architect earlier in your career)
  • Support collaborative planning processes
  • Deliver and maintain digital services using Continuous Delivery
  • Ensure that delivery process is aligned with the Storebrand Software Delivery Lifecycle and Service Management processes
  • Experience from P&C insurance is an advantage, and experience from claims handling, claims processes or digital claims solutions is particularly relevant for this role.
  • Fluent in Norwegian & English


Personal Qualities We Look For

  • You are motivated and ready for a challenge
  • You are comfortable leading teams
  • You make decisions and set direction
  • You actively take responsibility
  • You are a good communicator – both with colleagues and senior stakeholders
  • You can work collaboratively and enjoy being part of a team
  • You are self-driven and curious
  • You are eager to show your strengths and contribute to the overall goals
  • You are interested in learning beyond your profession, apply new technologies and getting to know our internal business partners



Why choose Storebrand?

At Storebrand, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, have your voice heard, and grow within a group that offers a wide range of career opportunities. We take pride in our culture, our drive, and the shared direction that guides everything we do: a future to look forward to.

We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds make us stronger, and we actively foster an inclusive and diverse workplace. Our efforts are being recognized: in 2025, Equileap ranked Storebrand as the number one company in Norway and among the top three companies globally for gender equality. In 2026, we were also named an ODA Champion.

As future optimists, we take a long-term view and invest in solutions that create lasting value for both our business and society. This is one of the reasons why we are one of only two Norwegian companies included in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index.

At our headquarters in Lysaker, you will work in a modern office with excellent public transport connections, secure bicycle parking, and changing facilities. We offer comprehensive health insurance, access to an on-site chiropractor and physiotherapist, and excellent fitness facilities in the Storebrand Arena. In addition, you will benefit from a highly competitive pension scheme, attractive insurance plans, and subsidized mortgage rates.


Questions? Contact Marius Gundersen (marius.gundersen@storebrand.no)


We review applications continuously




Å søke jobb i Storebrand skal være enkelt. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive et søknadsbrev. Vi ønsker kun din CV og svar på noen få spørsmål i søknadsprosessen.


Vi tror på at mangfold styrker oss, og ønsker alle kvalifiserte søkere uansett bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen. Trenger du tilpasninger i søknadsprosessen? Ikke nøl med å gi oss beskjed – slik at vi sammen kan finne en løsning som fungerer for deg.


Storebrand samarbeider med Semac for bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen. I forbindelse med bakgrunnssjekk må politiattest fremlegges for stillinger som krever autorisasjon og/eller godkjenning av egnethet.

description:

Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

Responsibilities:
  • Coordinate the development of content and training strategies that allow the continuous updating and consolidation of the educational offer through the promotion of the financial and economic culture between the different segments of the population.
  • Coordinate the design and implementation of the educational strategies of the area for the promotion of the financial and economic culture.
  • Coordinate the detection of needs, the design and implementation, as well as the social and educational approach to update and innovate the educational offer, according to the different segments of the population.

  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

Education:

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

Objetivo del puesto

Apoyar el desarrollo, implementación y seguimiento de la estrategia ASG (Ambiental, Social y Gobernanza) de Banamex, impulsando la integración de criterios ASG en las operaciones, productos, procesos y cultura organizacional del banco. Contribuir a la ejecución de iniciativas de sostenibilidad, la elaboración de análisis y reportes ASG, la vinculación con grupos de interés y el cumplimiento de compromisos nacionales e internacionales, así como a la identificación, evaluación y gestión de riesgos y oportunidades ambientales, sociales y climáticos que impactan al negocio.


Principales responsabilidades

  • Participar en el desarrollo, actualización e implementación de lineamientos, metodologías y políticas relacionadas con sostenibilidad, finanzas responsables y criterios ASG.

  • Apoyar la identificación, evaluación y seguimiento de riesgos y oportunidades ASG asociados a las operaciones de crédito e inversión, incluyendo riesgos ambientales, sociales y climáticos.

  • Recopilar, analizar y validar información para la elaboración de reportes corporativos.

  • Apoyar el desarrollo, mantenimiento y seguimiento de indicadores, métricas y herramientas de medición del desempeño ASG.

  • Realizar análisis comparativos (benchmarking) y evaluaciones de desempeño frente a estándares, marcos de referencia y mejores prácticas nacionales e internacionales en materia de sostenibilidad.

  • Coordinar y dar seguimiento a la difusión y realización de talleres de los Índices de Estados y Ciudades Sostenibles en los diferentes estados del país.

  • Colaborar con las distintas áreas del banco para identificar necesidades y desarrollar soluciones que fortalezcan la integración de criterios ASG en los procesos y operaciones.

  • Coordinar la planeación, organización y ejecución de eventos e iniciativas estratégicas del área, incluyendo la gestión de participantes, contenidos, logística y comunicación.

  • Elaborar materiales, presentaciones, contenidos y comunicaciones institucionales relacionadas con la estrategia y los proyectos del área.

  • Diseñar e implementar programas de capacitación y sensibilización dirigidos a colaboradores sobre sostenibilidad, criterios ASG y riesgos ambientales, sociales y climáticos.

  • Dar seguimiento al cumplimiento de compromisos, iniciativas y marcos de referencia nacionales e internacionales relacionados con sostenibilidad y finanzas responsables (PRB, PRI, ODS, TCFD, entre otros).

  • Dar seguimiento a los grupos de trabajo relacionados con sostenibilidad.



Requisitos:

  • Escolaridad: Licenciatura en: Ingeniería Ambiental, Ingeniería Industrial, Desarrollo Sustentable, Finanzas, Economía, Administración o carreras afines. (Necesario concluida).

  • Se valorarán estudios de posgrado o certificaciones relacionadas con ASG, sostenibilidad, riesgos ambientales, sociales y climáticos o finanzas sostenibles.

  • Experiencia de 4 años a 7 años de experiencia en alguna de las siguientes áreas: Temas Ambientales, Sociales y de Gobierno Corporativo ,Gestión de Riesgos ambientales, sociales y climáticos, Principios de Banca Responsable (PRB),Principios de Inversión Responsable (PRI),Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible (ODS) y Regulaciones y tendencias globales relacionadas con sostenibilidad y finanzas responsables.Preferentemente en empresas privadas, sector financiero, instituciones multinacionales, o consultoría en sostenibilidad.

  • Manejo de Office Avanzado y Power BI (deseable) y análisis de bases de datos.

  • Inglés intermedio alto.

  • Competencias: Capacidad analítica, Comunicación efectiva ,Gestión de relaciones con grupos de interés, Planeación y organización, Atención al detalle, Trabajo colaborativo, Capacidad para gestionar múltiples iniciativas simultáneamente.

At TD Canada Trust, we are the frontline of TD Bank. At the branch, we understand customer needs and identify opportunities to promote products and services to refer customers to the appropriate team member or internal Bank partner, while ensuring a positive customer experience.


Join TD Canada Trust and Think like a customer, Act like an Owner, Innovate with purpose and Execute with Speed and Impact.


Job Description:

Can you bring your charming self to work and make customer interactions delightful one? Can you process financial transactions accurately and get a sense of achievement by providing excellent customer experience? If so then, take the next step to your future today and apply for the position of a Customer Experience Associate. We are expecting an all-around champion who can understand customer needs and advise best suited banking solutions for a positive customer experience.


In this role, you will:

  • Process financial transactions like deposits, withdrawals, and bill payments as per standardized operating procedures, industry regulations and TD's Code of Conduct and Ethics.
  • Understand and determine customer needs to recommend solutions specific to those needs while exercising discretion in confidential matter.
  • Respond and resolve customers' concerns using standard procedures and escalating non-standard activities, as necessary.
  • Achieve assigned goals and business objectives by promoting banking solutions and completing business processes in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Connect personally with customers to advise them appropriately and clearly on banking solutions and processes.
  • Help build a positive, diverse and equitable work environment by promoting team effectiveness as well as participating in personal performance development.

title: Custom Engineering Lead System Designer
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.

At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


Just nu söker vi en Lead System Designer (LSD) till vår site i Umeå


Som Lead System Designer har du det övergripande designansvaret i kundanpassade projekt och fungerar som den tekniska länken mellan kund, projektteam och verksamhet. Du ansvarar för att säkerställa att kundkrav omsätts till genomtänkta tekniska lösningar som uppfyller såväl funktionella som regulatoriska krav.


I rollen arbetar du nära mekanikkonstruktörer, automationsingenjörer, projektledare, tillverkning, kvalitet och externa kunder. Du driver tekniska frågor genom projektets alla faser, från kravinsamling och design till verifiering och slutleverans.


Du kommer även att bidra med teknisk expertis till försäljningsorganisationen, stötta tillverkning och service samt vara en viktig mentor för nya medarbetare och konsulter.


Våra kunder finns över hela världen, vilket innebär att rollen kan omfatta resor några gånger per år samt enstaka möten utanför ordinarie arbetstid.



Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden


  • Ha det övergripande designansvaret i kundprojekt och interna utvecklingsprojekt.
  • Analysera, tolka och omsätta kundkrav (URS) till tekniska specifikationer och systemdesign.
  • Säkerställa att kundkrav, kvalitetskrav och regulatoriska krav uppfylls genom hela projektet.
  • Koordinera designaktiviteter mellan olika teknikdiscipliner och driva tekniska beslut framåt.
  • Leda designgranskningar och tekniska genomgångar med interna och externa intressenter.
  • Vara Cytivas tekniska representant i dialoger med kunder under projektens genomförande.
  • Delta i kundmöten, FAT-aktiviteter och vid behov besöka kundanläggningar.
  • Granska och godkänna testplaner samt stötta verifieringsaktiviteter.
  • Utreda tekniska kundärenden, CAPA-aktiviteter och designrelaterade avvikelser.
  • Stödja tillverkning, serviceorganisation och regionala team vid installationer samt IQ/OQ-aktiviteter.
  • Bidra med teknisk expertis i offert- och RFQ-faser tillsammans med säljorganisationen.
  • Delta i leverantörsrevisioner och kundaudits tillsammans med kvalitetsorganisationen.
  • Agera teknisk rådgivare i frågor relaterade till design, produktion och produktförbättringar.
  • Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och instruktioner inom verksamheten.
  • Introducera, vägleda och coacha nya medarbetare och konsulter.



Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll där du kombinerar teknisk expertis med samordning, problemlösning och kundkontakt. Du är trygg i att fatta tekniska beslut, kan skapa samsyn mellan olika intressenter och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt som driver projekt framåt.


Kvalifikationer

  • Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom teknik, bioteknik eller motsvarande område, alternativt likvärdig arbetslivserfarenhet.
  • Erfarenhet av teknisk produktutveckling, systemdesign eller processutveckling.
  • Erfarenhet av att leda eller koordinera tekniska aktiviteter i tvärfunktionella team.
  • God förståelse för kravhantering, verifiering och kvalitetsarbete.
  • Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  • Bosatt i Umeå eller närliggande område med möjlighet att jobba från vår site på daglig basis.

Kansas City, Missouri

Patient Accounts UHTMC

Full time

7:00AM - 3:30PM

Job Description

Cash Posting Lead

Lead the Charge in Financial Accuracy – Your Expertise is the Key!

Ready to take your financial skills to the next level? As the Cash Posting Lead, you’ll be the wizard behind the scenes ensuring payments flow smoothly and accurately for two hospitals. You’ll have the opportunity to not only master cash posting and account reconciliation but also mentor a team, troubleshoot issues, and elevate the entire process. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love working with numbers, and have an eye for detail, this role is calling your name!

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Master the Art of Cash Posting: You’ll manage patient and third-party remittances, ensuring payments are posted with precision. Daily system balancing? No problem! You’ve got it covered.

  • Reconcile Like a Pro: With your keen eye for detail, you’ll reconcile daily and monthly transactions between billing entities, ensuring everything is smooth and accurate.

  • Be the Compliance Champion: You’ll make sure payments and contractual allowances meet the high standards set by University Health, all while ensuring compliance with regulations.

  • Lead and Inspire: Take the reins by supervising and mentoring a team of Cash Posters. You’ll be their go-to resource for guidance and troubleshooting, stepping in to take on supervisory duties when needed.

  • Solve Problems: When something doesn’t quite add up, you’ll step in and identify the issue, keeping everything on track and reporting irregularities as needed.

  • Improve the Process: You’ll keep a close eye on daily and monthly reports, always looking for ways to streamline the process and make things even more efficient.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A Degree and Experience: An Associate’s degree (or equivalent) in Accounting or a related field is ideal, and experience with cash posting and account reconciliation is a must.

  • Clear Communicator: You’ll be explaining complex procedures to your team and working closely with other departments, so you’ll need strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Tech-Savvy: You should be proficient in patient accounting systems and spreadsheets (Excel is your friend!), plus you’ve got solid keyboard skills and can navigate a 10-key keypad with ease.

  • Detail-Oriented: You’ll juggle multiple financial tasks with accuracy, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.

  • Leadership Potential: Have you led teams before? Awesome! If not, no worries—this is your chance to grow into a leadership role and guide your team to success.

Bonus Points (Preferred):

  • Team Leadership Experience: While leadership experience is a plus, we’re excited to help you grow into the role!

  • Healthcare Accounting Knowledge: If you’re familiar with healthcare finance, that’s a huge plus, but we’re happy to help you learn along the way.

Why You’ll Love This Job:

  • Impactful Work: Your attention to detail ensures payments are processed accurately, which is vital to the financial success of University Health.

  • Grow Your Skills: Take your career to new heights by stepping into a leadership role where you’ll mentor a team, improve processes, and grow your financial expertise.

  • Be Part of a Great Team: Work alongside a group of dedicated, hard-working professionals who are just as committed to excellence as you are.

  • No Two Days Are Alike: Every day brings a new set of challenges—whether it’s reconciling transactions, guiding your team, or solving financial puzzles, you’ll always have something exciting to tackle.

  • Make a Difference: The work you do directly impacts the financial stability of the organization, allowing us to provide the best care to our community.

If you're a number-crunching, problem-solving, team-leading superstar ready to make an impact, we want YOU to apply for the Cash Posting Lead role. Let’s work together to ensure every financial transaction is smooth, efficient, and accurate!

description:

The Program Manager (PM) leads OneZero Solutions' delivery of Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) Support to the Department of State's Bureau of Diplomatic Technology, Enterprise Applications, Consular Systems and Technology (DT/EA/CST) organization. The PM is the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) on all contractual, administrative, and performance matters, and is accountable for a team of 23 cleared cybersecurity professionals who keep more than 70 FISMA-reportable consular systems authorized, compliant, and continuously monitored. Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the CO, COR, and Government Technical Monitor (GTM) for all contractual, administrative, and performance matters; resolve issues and report program status.

  • Ensure compliance with Organizational Conflict of Interest disclosure, Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) requirements, and all DoS/CA/CST security policies(RFQ §H.1–H.3).
  • Champion CMMI-aligned process discipline, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across the ISSO, engineering, and documentation teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Ten (10)+ years of experience managing large-scale cybersecurity programs (RFQ §M, Factor 2).
  • Experience managing contracts of similar size, scope, and complexity, including Firm-Fixed-Price services.
  • Demonstrated experience with Federal Government cybersecurity requirements (FISMA, NIST SP 800-37 RMF, NIST SP 800-53).
  • Current Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent project management certification.
  • Active, final SECRET security clearance; U.S. citizenship.
  • Available at the time of Call Order award and committed to the full base period of performance.
  • Proven ability to recruit, hire, retain, and develop cleared cybersecurity personnel in the National Capital Region.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting the Department of State (DT, CA, or CST) or another federal civilian agency's ISSO / Assessment & Authorization program.
  • Experience managing GSA MAS / HACS SIN task or call orders.

Technical Skills

  • Program management tooling: MS Project or equivalent, Excel-based staffing and financial models, risk registers, SharePoint/Teams.
  • Familiarity with GRC platforms (ArchAngel, iPost or equivalent) and vulnerability management platforms (Tenable, Wiz).
  • Earned-value-style tracking of FFP performance, deliverable calendars, and quality management systems (CMMI ML3 environment).

Security Clearance

Active, final SECRET

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is required. Master's degree preferred.

Remote/Hybrid/On-site and any other relevant work-environment requirement

Remote. Duties are performed remotely; the selected candidate must reside within the National Capital Region (NCR).   • Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, perform assessments, and produce high-quality deliverables.

Experience in several of the following domains:

  • Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
  • Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
  • Disaster Recovery (DR)
  • Cyber Recovery
  • Recovery Strategy Design
  • Recovery Testing and Validation
  • Crisis Management and Crisis Governance
  • Recovery Objectives (RTO/RPO)
  • Dependency Mapping and Critical Service Analysis
  • Backup, Restore, Immutability, and Data Protection
  • Isolated Recovery Environments (IRE)
  • Clean Room Solutions
  • Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Infrastructure Environments

Knowledge of DORA, NIS2, ISO 22301, or other resilience-related frameworks is considered a strong advantage.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, engaging with clients, and delivering real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - Oncology
description:
We are excited to announce a postdoctoral fellowship available in the laboratory of Dr. Charles Roberts in the Division of Molecular Oncology at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital in Memphis, TN. Dr. Roberts is a leader in the field of cancer epigenetics, and his research has provided new insights into the central role of chromatin remodeling perturbations in cancer, discoveries that have been translated into investigational therapies for both pediatric and adult cancer patients. His research specifically focuses on SWI/SNF (BAF) chromatin remodeling complexes. Perturbation of these complexes has broad relevance to cancer as at least nine genes that encode SWI/SNF subunits are collectively mutated in over 20% of all cancers, making this the most frequently mutated chromatin regulator in human malignancies. Research in the Roberts laboratory is designed to discover the mechanisms by which SWI/SNF complexes regulate chromatin and transcriptional control and lineage specification, and the mechanisms by which mutation of SWI/SNF subunits drive cancer formation. We also seek to identify specific vulnerabilities that are conferred by SWI/SNF mutation with the goal of identifying novel therapeutic opportunities.

Dr. Roberts’ research is highly regarded and he has been elected as a fellow of the Academy of the American Association of Clinical Research, to the Society for Pediatric Research, the American Pediatric Society, and American Association of Physicians. He is a passionate mentor and is fully committed to training the next generation of scientists. Dr. Roberts leads a very successful, well-funded team with postdoctoral scientists, graduate students, technologists, senior scientists, and dedicated bioinformaticians. He additionally directs the NCI St. Jude Comprehensive Cancer Center, and in 2027 will relinquish this role to become president and CEO of St. Jude Children's Research Hospital. You will receive outstanding training in the development of scientific thinking and other skills such as grant writing, manuscript writing, and effective presentation, as well as have the freedom to develop your own ideas in a rigorous and supportive environment. Previous postdocs and graduate student trainees have successfully pursued careers as leaders in academia and industry. A list of previous trainees is available upon request.

The Division of Molecular Oncology and the top-notch core resources at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital will allow you access to the world-class expertise and technology necessary to perform high level science. In addition, postdoctoral fellows at St. Jude receive a generous yearly Professional Development Allowance for travel to scientific meetings.

Minimum Education: Candidates should have recently earned/expect to earn a Ph.D., have published in peer-reviewed journals, and have a

strong background in molecular biology, genetics/epigenetics, cell biology, and/or cancer biology.


We are committed to a human-centered hiring experience. Technology may support portions of our process, but recruiting decisions involve human review and engagement. Learn more about our approach to AI.


St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

Operating at the intersection of deep technical architecture and client co-creation, our teams move at market speed to turn complex business challenges into production-ready software systems.

As an Associate Director, Full-stack Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the principal technical force customers ask for by name. You will lead high-impact AI engagements, shape modern architectural blueprints, and step into an ultra-fast, high-autonomy builder’s environment. In this role, you take direct accountability for real outcomes in production environments, designing responsive modern frontends, building robust backend data pipelines, and orchestrating advanced multi-agent workflows.

You will balance hands-on development—utilizing state-of-the-art retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, managing LLM API performance, and deploying to cloud hyper-scalers—with strategic client advisory to ensure every solution delivers measurable business value.

** This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week on-site in Frisco, TX. Candidates must reside within a commutable distance, as relocation assistance will not be provided.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack Architecture & Rapid Prototyping

  • Build and scale responsive modern frontend interfaces using React, Angular, or Vue designed to handle dynamic generative UI elements and real-time streaming outputs.

  • Develop robust backend APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Node.js to connect enterprise systems with advanced language models.

  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and ship functional, production-ready MVPs within weeks in a highly agile lab environment.

  • Optimize application performance, query execution, and rendering speeds to maintain high reliability and low latency across distributed systems.

Agentic AI & Knowledge Systems Integration

  • Design, build, and deploy multi-agent orchestration frameworks using tools like LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI that communicate, self-correct, and execute complex enterprise workflows.

  • Configure and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector engines, integrating both structured and unstructured data sources.

  • Resolve LLM deployment challenges, including API call optimization, token latencies, prompt routing, context window limits, and cost management.

  • Implement system-level security and performance best practices for scalable AI platforms.

Client Co-Creation & Technical Ownership

  • Embed directly with enterprise client teams to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable, high-impact technical architectures.

  • Partner with senior stakeholders to prioritize long-term technical value and solution integrity over quick fixes.

  • Own end-to-end technical delivery from initial scoping through deployment, driving user adoption and operational outcomes.

Platform Contribution & Operational Excellence

  • Systematically capture deployment learnings and document architectural best practices to inform ongoing enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms.

  • Collaborate daily with lab engineering leads to refine physical deployment pipelines and shared frameworks.

  • Share knowledge, code contributions, and insights openly across Slack, Teams, and cross-functional stand-ups to elevate the broader engineering community.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Who You Are

You are good at what you do and possess the required technical depth to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and a passion for driving your own personal and professional development in emerging technologies. You are deeply customer-focused, prioritizing client success above all else when co-creating custom AI solutions face-to-face with enterprise teams. Finally, you are open and borderless—naturally inclusive in how you work, thriving in a flat, highly collaborative team where you share learnings openly across our physical Frisco Lab and global digital channels.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Based in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex (or ready to relocate immediately) with a hybrid schedule of 3 days onsite per week at the Frisco, TX Agentic AI Lab.

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript backend development.

  • Hands-on experience building, designing, and deploying applications using modern frameworks and orchestrators (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI) in production.

  • Experience designing and maintaining modern frontend applications (React, Angular, or Vue), particularly handling streaming data or real-time query responses.

  • Practical understanding and deployment experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma).

  • Experience deploying containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes to major cloud hyper-scalers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and distributed computing architectures.

  • Strong proficiency with SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases, alongside solid data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark.

  • Deep familiarity with Git, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern software delivery best practices.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with LLM infrastructure tools such as LiteLLM gateways, prompt tracing platforms (e.g., Langfuse), or workflow managers (e.g., Temporal).

  • Familiarity with open-source AI ecosystems (e.g., Hugging Face), agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), system prompt tuning, model fine-tuning, and vector search caching strategies (e.g., Redis).

  • Experience using messaging queues or streaming platforms like Kafka or RabbitMQ, alongside familiarity with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions and communicate value to executive stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required.

  • Active professional certifications in major cloud hyper-scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) or AI-specific development pathways.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Informatics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).

Preferred Qualifications
  • 7+ years of experience

Licenses/Certifications

title: Rigger (Turaif)
description:
About EPSA:

We are a global family-owned business with over 60 years in the mining, civil and earth moving industry operating in several countries throughout the world.

We are seeking a talented and motivated individual to join our team.

Operational Responsibilities


• Prepare and inspect lifting gear including slings, shackles, chains, wire ropes, spreader bars, and lifting beams prior to use.
• Select appropriate rigging equipment based on load weight, configuration, and lifting requirements.
• Attach loads to cranes or lifting devices using safe and approved rigging techniques.
• Ensure proper load balance, stability, and secure fastening before lifting operations commence.
• Guide Crane Operators using standard hand signals and radio communication during lifting and positioning activities.
• Participate in equipment component removal and installation (engines, transmissions, hydraulic cylinders, structural parts, etc.).
• Interpret lifting plans, load charts, and rigging drawings as required.
• Assist in heavy equipment assembly, relocation, and major shutdown activities.
• Maintain rigging equipment registers and ensure defective gear is removed from service.


Safety & Compliance


• Comply with company safety procedures, lifting standards, and relevant legal regulations.
• Ensure all lifting operations are conducted in accordance with approved Lift Plans and Risk Assessments.
• Participate in Job Safety Analyses (JSAs) and pre-lift meetings.
• Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
• Stop any lifting activity deemed unsafe and immediately report hazards or unsafe conditions.
• Follow Lock Out–Tag Out (LOTO) procedures when required during maintenance support activities.


Environmental Responsibilities


• Ensure lifting operations are conducted with minimal environmental impact.
• Prevent oil spills, fuel leaks, or material discharge during lifting and equipment handling.
• Maintain clean and organized work areas in the workshop and field.


Qualifications


• Recognized Rigger certification (Level I, II, or equivalent as per local regulations).
• Valid certification for slinging and signaling operations.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in rigging within mining, construction, or heavy industrial environments.
• Sound knowledge of lifting equipment, load calculation, and rigging techniques.
• Ability to read and interpret lifting plans and basic technical drawings.

• Experience in open-pit mining operations.
• Additional certification in Working at Heights.
• Familiarity with heavy mining equipment (e.g., dump trucks, excavators, drills, cranes).
• First Aid or safety-related certifications.


Pre-Employment Requirements


• Reference checks will be conducted.
• Alcohol and drug testing applies as per company policy.
• All applicants will be subject to an assessment test.
• All applicants must pass a pre-employment medical examination.


What We Offer

  • Job stability.
  • Attractive salary.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religious beliefs, or sexual orientation.

Job Description:

TD Wealth – Practice Management | Advice Onboarding & Development


Who We Are

Practice Management within TD Wealth is focused on building the next generation of planning and advisory talent. Our Advice Onboarding and Development team partners with the business to deliver industry-leading learning experiences that elevate employee capability and drive meaningful business outcomes. We strive to be a strategic thinking partner to the business, designing and facilitating programs that are engaging, relevant, and aligned to enterprise priorities.


We believe learning is not an event—it is a journey. Our team is known for creating dynamic, learner-centered experiences, challenging the status quo through innovative facilitation approaches, and anchoring everything we do in business impact and client experience.


The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled Facilitator to join our Practice Management Delivery team. This is a senior facilitator role that goes beyond delivery — you will facilitate complex learning experiences and play an active role in shaping how those programs evolve and deliver impact. Success in this role requires both facilitation mastery and deep Wealth expertise.


What You’ll Do

1. Lead High-Impact Facilitation

  • Facilitate using a “guide by their side” approach, where learners actively problem-solve and apply concepts
  • Apply deep subject matter expertise in financial planning and private wealth management to ask the right questions, challenge thinking, and guide learners toward accurate, high-quality outcomes
  • Facilitate complex learning programs for diverse audiences, including senior leaders and planners/advisors
  • Create engaging, learner-driven environments that foster participation, reflection, and application
  • Lead strategic, discussion-based learning experiences, confidently validating, challenging, and expanding learner responses to ensure alignment with industry best practices
  • Bring content to life by connecting learning to business context and real-world application

2. Shape Learner Experience & Capability Building

  • Design and facilitate experiences that build capability, not just knowledge
  • Continuously enhance learner engagement, incorporating innovative and digital delivery methods
  • Create a safe, high-performance learning environment where learners can practice, receive feedback, and grow
  • Partner with leaders and SMEs to prepare them for effective delivery

3. Drive Program Excellence

  • Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of learning programs aligned to business strategy
  • Contribute to program design by providing facilitator insights, learner feedback, and recommendations
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure programs are relevant, scalable, and impactful
  • Analyze program effectiveness and contribute to ongoing enhancements and innovation

4. Act as a Strategic Partner

  • Consult with business leaders to align learning solutions with business priorities
  • Facilitate strategy sessions, leadership discussions, and capability-building initiatives
  • Bring a strong point of view on adult learning, capability development, and program effectiveness
  • Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert within Practice Management

5. Build Capability Across the Organization

  • Mentor and coach facilitators, contributing to community of practice and capability building
  • Share best practices and continuously elevate the standard of facilitation across Wealth
  • Stay current on industry trends, facilitation techniques, and learning innovation

Experience & Expertise

title: Senior Business Analyst, Finance - SSL
description:
Job Responsibilities and Requirements

The Senior Business Analyst for SSL will work internally and with external vendors to monitor, review and reconcile transactions between the Company’s policy administrative system(s), the general ledger and the bank accounts while ensuring overall data integrity of the Company’s premium, claim and commission transactions. This role will also support the evaluation, execution and expansion of automation, analytics and artificial intelligence tools that improve company processes, strengthen controls and enhance decision support.

The Sr. Business Analyst will be responsible for the completion of data related regulatory filings to the Company’s regulator(s).

The Sr. Business Analyst will also be involved in the design and implementation of future applications, training, change requests and problem reports. They will collaborate with IT and management in other departments (Claims, Underwriting, Financial, etc.) to determine the appropriate functionality and integration of while ensuring current and future business requirements are met.

In addition, the Sr. Business Analyst will help identify practical AI and automation use cases across SSL Finance and related functions, assist in defining requirements and success measures, coordinate with business and technology partners, and support adoption through testing, training, documentation and ongoing monitoring.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the liaison to IT for all SSL Administrative system related issues.
  • Investigates user concerns identifies problems, makes recommendations for resolution and collaborates with IT to implement the fix/change.
  • Seeks user feedback related to system efficiency and functionality and requests system changes and enhancements, as appropriate.
  • Attends regular meetings with managers from Underwriting, Claims, IT, Financial, etc. to determine the priority of recommended changes/enhancements.
  • Chairs System meetings as necessary to provide feedback to the SSL Management Team regarding system performance, development and status.
  • Maintains users security and authority changes and additions as necessary.
  • Regularly meets with managers to discuss new procedures, system enhancements, etc.
  • Shares information or problems and provides a forum for team building.
  • Maintains consistent company process and regulatory compliance through appropriate staff communication and training.
  • Identifies opportunities to use automation, analytics and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, improve reconciliation accuracy, strengthen exception reporting and increase timeliness of financial and operational insights.
  • Partners with Finance, IT, Claims, Underwriting and other stakeholders to document AI and automation business requirements, define expected outcomes, support prioritization and coordinate implementation activities.
  • Supports data readiness activities for AI-enabled solutions, including source-system analysis, data mapping, exception identification, validation routines and documentation of data limitations or control considerations.
  • Assists in testing, monitoring and validating AI or automation outputs to ensure results are accurate, explainable, appropriately controlled and aligned with business requirements before and after deployment.
  • Completes regulatory data filings with regulatory authorities as required.
  • Maintains documentation of AI-enabled workflows, automation rules, data transformations, process controls and user procedures to support auditability, regulatory compliance and operational continuity.
  • Develops and delivers user guidance, job aids and training materials to promote effective adoption of new systems, AI-enabled tools, dashboards and process changes.
  • Completes special projects as assigned by management.
  • Assumes additional responsibilities as needed.

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a business analyst.
  • Experience with process improvement, data analysis, reporting, workflow automation or AI-enabled business tools preferred.
  • Ability to handle multiple competing priorities and function with limited supervision.
  • Proven ability to work well in a high visibility, public oriented environment, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to effectively participate in sales presentations and customer meetings.
  • Proven ability to work with the following equipment: personal computer programs (e-mail, Microsoft Word and Excel, etc.). Ability to use any or all of this equipment to track, measure and improve performance.
  • Working knowledge of data visualization, query, reporting or AI-assisted productivity tools, with the ability to evaluate outputs, identify exceptions and communicate findings to business stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to engage in presentations and deliver training.

Ability to Travel: Up to 10%
