Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.
We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role

Every time a Remitly customer sends money, our Transaction domain is what makes it happen, orchestrating pricing, risk, payments, and disbursements into a single reliable transfer, at scale, across the world. We're building the capability layer that powers every product Remitly ships that moves money so new products can be assembled from proven, reusable building blocks instead of built from scratch.


As a Senior Product Manager on Transactions, you'll own the strategy, and roadmap for a core domain at Remitly including transaction orchestration, transaction data, and transaction eligibility/ limits. You'll partner with engineering to turn platform capabilities into product differentiators, and you'll be the person other teams across Remitly turn to when they need to build something that touches transactions.


You Will:

  • Own the lifecycle of the domain, including strategy, roadmap, and delivery, and build buy-in across engineering and cross-functional leadership.
  • Partner with teams across Remitly that build on your platform domain, balancing their needs against a coherent long term roadmap.
  • Define what success looks like for your area and drive the initiatives that move customer and company outcomes (ex: transaction reliability and ease of integration).
  • Be a genuine technical thought partner to engineering, deeply understanding the APIs, orchestration, and system tradeoffs that requirements or design impact, representing the customer in all conversations.
  • Lead modernization efforts that retire legacy systems and replace them with reusable, composable platform capabilities, without compromising the reliability customers depend on.
  • Shape the platform vision, balancing the needs of the end customer with the needs of the internal teams building on your platform.
  • Own the end-to-end transaction lifecycle, proactively identifying opportunities to automate, harden, and decouple its components as the business scales.
  • Independently build end-to-end product prototypes using our AI infra - spanning product thinking, design, data, and code - going beyond writing requirements to shipping working proof points.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of technical product management experience, ideally with some experience on platform, infrastructure, or developer facing products.
  • A track record of defining product vision and roadmap in ambiguous spaces where the strategy isn't handed to you, and delivering against it with limited guidance.
  • Good judgment on the tradeoff between shipping what one team needs now and building the capability every future team will need.
  • Technical depth: comfortable in conversations about APIs, event driven architecture, orchestration/workflow engines, and distributed systems tradeoffs.
  • Experience managing many stakeholders with competing priorities and building consensus without formal authority.
  • Real curiosity about how complex systems work end to end, a habit of digging into the data or the code rather than taking someone's word for it.
  • Experience using AI to build product prototypes across product, design, data, and code.
  • Experience owning or significantly improving a production system's reliability or automation (e.g., reducing manual intervention, improving fault tolerance, simplifying architecture).

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $156,000 -$195,000. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together
At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

Under the Company's current hybrid-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

To apply software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response, to ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through them.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Data Engineer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise-scale data platforms and data products. The role requires strong expertise in Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, cloud-based data engineering, and modern data architectures. The candidate will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines, enabling self-service analytics, driving platform modernization initiatives, and leading a team of data engineers to deliver business-critical data products.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in a large-scale enterprise environment, preferably within Banking, Financial Services, or highly regulated industries.

To be successful as a Data Engineer , you should have experience with:

  • Strong experience in Databricks Lakehouse Platform.

  • Expert-level knowledge of Apache Spark (PySpark and Spark SQL).

  • Strong programming skills in Python.

  • Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows.

  • Strong SQL tuning and performance optimization skills.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Python and PySpark-based development

  • Solid understanding of Linux environments with scripting expertise

  • Experience working with scheduling/orchestration tools such as TWS and Airflow

  • Proficient in Git and GitLab for version control and CI/CD workflows

  • Good exposure to AWS ecosystem, including Glue, Lambda, S3, Lake Formation, and Athena

Data Engineering Expertise

  • ETL/ELT framework development.

  • CDC (Change Data Capture) implementations.

  • Data Quality frameworks.

  • Batch and Real-Time processing.

  • Data Governance and Metadata Management.

  • Data Lineage and Data Catalog solutions.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job‑specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune.

title: UX Design Associate
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Your role

As a UX Design Associate, you'll help create digital experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and meaningful for customers. You'll explore how people interact with technology, identify opportunities to improve those experiences, and contribute design solutions that make products easier to use and understand.


Working alongside experienced designers, researchers, product teams, and engineers, you'll help turn customer and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and experience concepts. You'll contribute throughout the design process, from discovery and research through to testing and delivery.


This role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience designing for enterprise-scale products while learning how emerging technologies, including AI-enabled experiences, are changing the way people interact with digital products. You'll balance creative problem solving with structured analysis, using research and feedback to inform design decisions and improve customer outcomes.


Through Kyndryl's Early Career experience, you'll strengthen your skills in user research, interaction design, accessibility, facilitation, and storytelling while building a portfolio of real-world work that delivers meaningful impact.


What you will do

Understand customer needs

  • Support user research activities to better understand customer goals, challenges, and opportunities
  • Participate in interviews, workshops, usability testing, and other research activities
  • Organize research findings and help translate insights into design opportunities
  • Create journey maps, personas, workflows, and other experience design artefacts

Design user experiences

  • Develop wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and experience concepts for digital products
  • Contribute to experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and easy to navigate
  • Translate customer needs and business requirements into practical design solutions
  • Apply human-centred design principles throughout the design process

Collaborate across teams

  • Partner with designers, researchers, engineers, and product teams to develop customer-focused solutions
  • Participate in design reviews and incorporate feedback into evolving concepts
  • Help communicate design ideas through visual storytelling, presentations, and prototypes
  • Balance customer expectations, business goals, and technical considerations when developing solutions

Explore emerging technologies

  • Contribute to projects that incorporate AI-enabled experiences and digital innovation
  • Explore how evolving technologies can support better user experiences and customer outcomes
  • Use design and productivity tools to support research, ideation, and prototyping activities
  • Help evaluate new concepts through testing, feedback, and iteration

Learn and grow

  • Build expertise in UX research, interaction design, accessibility, and digital product design
  • Learn from experienced designers through coaching, collaboration, and hands-on project work
  • Develop a portfolio of customer-focused design experiences
  • Expand your ability to solve complex problems through research, creativity, and collaboration

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

Why Kyndryl:

We’re a purpose-driven company committed to innovation and empowering our people. Here, your work contributes to meaningful outcomes for clients and communities.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to provide it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in your work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Kyndryl is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Kyndryl is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status .


Required skills and experience

  • Bachelor's degree, associate degree, or equivalent practical experience completed recently or expected before start date
  • Academic, internship, volunteer, or project experience in UX design, human-centred design, interaction design, psychology, human-computer interaction, or a related field
  • Understanding of user-centred design principles and design thinking methodologies
  • Experience creating wireframes, journey maps, prototypes, user flows, or similar design deliverables
  • Experience using Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar design tools
  • Ability to gather, organize, and interpret user feedback and research insights
  • Experience collaborating on team-based projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Interest in designing accessible, inclusive, and customer-focused digital experiences

Preferred skills and experience

  • Portfolio demonstrating UX, product design, service design, or innovation-focused projects
  • Exposure to usability testing, customer research, or workshop facilitation
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
  • Interest in AI-enabled experiences and emerging interaction patterns
  • Experience using AI-supported design or productivity tools such as Figma AI, Miro AI, Adobe Firefly, or similar solutions

$63,360 to $114,120 based on a full-time schedule.

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. title: Head, P&C Business Partner - Senegal & PANA

The role will design and deliver P&C strategies and initiatives aligned with Foundation objectives and the distinct priorities of both portfolios.

The incumbent provides hands-on P&C support to employees across Senegal and PANA, strengthens oneness across locations and functions, and oversees the complete employee experience, including employee relations and engagement. The role is the primary P&C contact for the two portfolios and is supported by the Enabling Functions Business Partnering team and relevant P&C Centres of Excellence.

WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE


Business partnership and strategy

  • Serve as the P&C Business Partner to Senegal Country Program and PANA leadership, advancing both portfolios from a People & Culture perspective.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Senegal and PANA to assess organizational gaps and determine the operating capacity and capability required to deliver strategy.

title: Detox Supervisor
description:
Position Title: Detox Supervisor
Location: Lighthouse Mission, Winnipeg, MB
Reports to: Operations Director for Detox

Mission:

Building bridges of hope by supporting the physical, spiritual, social, and psychological needs of our community, we aim to bring eternal freedom and joy.

Vision:

A community where every individual's biopsychosocial and spiritual needs are met, ensuring that each person steps into a future of enduring freedom and boundless joy, one life at a time

Core Values:

• Compassion - Recognizing the multifaceted nature of human beings, we commit to addressing not just the physical, but the emotional, social, psychological, and spiritual needs, mirroring Christ's comprehensive care.
• Enduring Hope - Rooted in the belief that every individual deserves a future brimming with freedom and joy, we continually strive to be a beacon of optimism and assurance, drawing from the eternal hope of the Gospel.
• Inclusive Love - Embracing all individuals irrespective of their backgrounds, struggles, or stories, we embody Christ's unconditional love, welcoming everyone into our community with open arms, just as He did.
• Stewardship - Guided by the principle that we are caretakers of God's creations, including our fellow beings, we dedicate ourselves to selfless service, ensuring that resources, time, and skills are used effectively to bring about positive change in the lives of those we serve.

Position Summary

The Detox Supervisor provides day-to-day leadership of the detox program by ensuring continuity of care between shifts, supporting Addiction Support Workers, coordinating participant admissions and transitions, and maintaining consistent communication across the program.

This position bridges front-line operations with administrative responsibilities while helping ensure participants receive safe, compassionate, and coordinated care.

Primary Responsibilities

Clinical & Program Oversight
• Ensure continuity of care between all staff shifts.
• Review and monitor shift reports and participant documentation.
• Provide support and guidance to Addiction Support Workers.
• Monitor participant progress throughout detox.
• Ensure participant safety and program standards are maintained.

Intake & Referrals
• Coordinate participant admissions.
• Complete intake documentation.
• Maintain participant files.
• Coordinate referrals to treatment centres and community agencies.
• Develop and oversee participant discharge planning.

Administration
• Maintain required program documentation.
• Prepare reports for funding and regulatory requirements.
• Monitor occupancy and bed utilization.
• Coordinate communication with external agencies.
• Assist in policy implementation.

Leadership
• Provide day-to-day supervision of program operations.
• Support staff through coaching and mentorship.
• Ensure consistent communication between shifts.
• Assist in staff orientation and ongoing training.
• Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
• Provide coverage for support workers when needed

Additional Responsibilities
• Other duties as assigned

Education, Experience and Credentials
• Diploma or Degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, Nursing, Addictions, or related field required OR five or more years of directly related leadership experience within addictions, detoxification, shelters, healthcare, or community services.
• Current First Aid and CPR Certificate
• Leadership experience preferred
• Experience coordinating referrals is preferred
• Knowledge of addictions or withdrawal management, trauma informed care, and crisis intervention
• Experience with motivational interviewing considered an asset
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a clear Vulnerable Sector Clearance.

Personal Competencies
• Leadership
• Organizational skills
• Decision making
• Communication
• Conflict resolution
• Coaching
• Critical thinking
• Strong documentation skills

Work Environment
• The position is based in a detox facility where staff work in and among individuals going through detox recovery.
• Flexibility schedule, which may include working evenings, nights, weekends and holiday.
• The work environment reflects the Christ-centered mission, where staff collaborate in ministry-focused work that supports individuals on their recovery journey.

title: Lead WHS Partner
description:
Job Description:

Lead workplace safety across one of Australia's largest not-for-profit health and aged care organisations and help create safer, healthier workplaces where our people can thrive.

  • Lead and influence safety outcomes: Guide a team of WHS Partners and partner with leaders across Victoria to strengthen safety culture, manage risk and drive continuous improvement.
  • Be a trusted WHS expert: Provide specialist advice, coaching and practical solutions that support compliance, operational excellence and the wellbeing of our people.
  • Make a meaningful impact: Support the delivery of compassionate healthcare and aged care by ensuring safe workplaces for employees, patients, residents, clients and visitors.


About St Vincent's Health Australia

At St Vincent's Health Australia (SVHA), we are shaping a future health and aged care system that supports people with life-changing care, wherever and whoever they are.


Founded by the Sisters of Charity in 1857, St Vincent's is one of Australia's leading not-for-profit health and aged care organisations. Our 30,000 dedicated people provide compassionate care through public and private hospitals, aged care residences, virtual care and services delivered at home across New South Wales, Queensland and Victoria.


Our vision is for every person to receive excellent and compassionate care through a better and fairer health and aged care system. Together, we are focused on enhancing our impact, connecting care and transforming the system. Our work is grounded in our values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence.


About the Opportunity

Reporting to the WHS Manager - Victoria, the Lead Work Health & Safety Partner is a key leadership role responsible for providing expert WHS guidance, partnering with operational leaders, and ensuring effective implementation of WHS systems, programs and governance across Victorian operations.


Leading a team of three WHS Partners, you will play a critical role in supporting organisational safety objectives, strengthening compliance, reducing risk and driving continuous improvement initiatives that protect our people, patients, residents, clients and visitors.


This is an opportunity to influence safety outcomes at scale while contributing to SVHA's broader vision of creating safer workplaces across our healthcare and aged care services.


Your Key Responsibilities

As the Lead Work Health & Safety Partner, you will:

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of WHS Partners across Victoria.
  • Provide expert advice and support on WHS legislation, regulations, codes of practice and industry best practice.
  • Partner with leaders to identify, assess and manage workplace risks across diverse operational environments.
  • Drive strategic WHS initiatives that support organisational objectives and safety performance improvement.
  • Lead and facilitate incident investigations, including significant and complex workplace incidents.
  • Conduct audits, inspections, assurance activities and gap analyses to assess compliance and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Support sites through accreditation processes, regulatory reviews and external audits.
  • Monitor hazard, incident and injury trends and provide data-driven recommendations to reduce risk.
  • Maintain and oversee WHS risk registers, ensuring corrective actions are effectively implemented and monitored.
  • Deliver WHS education, training and capability-building programs across all levels of the organisation.
  • Provide guidance and support for effective WHS consultation arrangements, including HSRs and WHS Committees.
  • Foster strong relationships with regulators, unions and key external stakeholders.
  • Support leaders in managing WHS matters raised through consultation forums and regulatory interactions.
  • Develop and implement WHS procedures, work instructions and guidance materials.
  • Promote consistency, standardisation and continuous improvement of WHS systems and processes.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and effectiveness of the WHS Management System.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across the organisation to improve safety outcomes.


About You
You are an experienced WHS professional and people leader who enjoys partnering with stakeholders to create safer workplaces and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.
You bring a practical, solutions-focused approach and the ability to influence at all levels of a complex organisation. You are comfortable balancing operational priorities with strategic initiatives and have a genuine passion for improving workplace health, safety and wellbeing.


You Will Bring

  • Minimum five years' experience in a senior WHS role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading safety initiatives within a complex organisation.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian WHS legislation, regulations and industry standards.
  • Experience conducting investigations, audits, inspections and risk assessments.
  • Proven ability to influence, coach and build effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong leadership capability with experience developing and supporting teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Highly developed analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Strong written communication and presentation skills.
  • High level computer literacy and proficiency across Microsoft Office applications.
  • A collaborative, adaptable and customer-focused approach.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel across Victorian sites.


Essential Qualifications

  • Minimum Diploma in Work Health & Safety.
  • WHS Incident Investigation qualification (e.g. ICAM Lead Investigator).
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence.


Highly Regarded

  • Experience leading WHS functions within healthcare, aged care or similarly regulated industries.
  • Experience working in large and complex organisations.
  • Previous people leadership experience.
  • WHS Internal Auditor qualification.
  • Degree qualification in WHS or a related discipline.
  • Certificate IV in Training and Assessment.



Why Join St Vincent's?

  • Join a purpose-driven organisation
    Support the health, safety and wellbeing of the people who deliver life-changing care to communities across Australia.
  • Lead meaningful safety initiatives
    Drive improvements that influence workplace culture, reduce risk and create safer environments for thousands of employees.
  • Shape the future of safety at scale
    Contribute to strategic WHS programs across one of Australia's largest health and aged care providers.
  • Collaborate with experienced leaders and specialists
    Work alongside operational leaders, People & Culture professionals and WHS experts who are passionate about safety excellence.
  • Flexible and values-driven culture
    Join a supportive and inclusive environment committed to continuous improvement, learning and growth.
  • Excellent benefits
    Access a range of benefits designed to support your financial wellbeing, professional growth and work-life balance, including salary packaging to increase your take-home pay, ongoing learning and development opportunities, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) support, Fitness Passport access and a supportive, values-driven workplace culture.



Apply Now
Join St Vincent's Health Australia and help create safer workplaces that enable our people to deliver exceptional care to patients, residents and communities across Australia.

Applications may close before the advertised closing date.

Important Information Employment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, including identification, right-to-work, reference and nationally coordinated criminal history checks. The successful applicant must also comply with applicable St Vincent's Health Australia screening and immunisation requirements.

St Vincent's Health Australia welcomes people from all backgrounds and beliefs. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to contribute their unique experiences.

7 October 2026 11:59pm

title: CT Technologist I - Imaging Department
location: Atrium Health Navicent The Medical Center - 777 Hemlock St, Macon, GA
description:
Department:

36317 Navicent Health Medical Center - CT

Status:

Full time

Benefits Eligible:

Yes

36

Schedule Details/Additional Information:

  • Friday, Saturday and Sunday 7am - 7:30pm WOW Contract Position
  • Weekend Program: $11.00

Pay Range:

$33.05 - $49.60

Major Responsibilities

  • Examines requests and verifies orders on each assigned patient. Refers and questions orders to the Radiologist before performing exam. Contacts ordering provider when there are discrepancies.

  • Properly identify (Using two patient identifiers) and assist patients while offering a brief explanation of the procedures. Prepares patients for the procedure with a full explanation and documents on appropriate worksheets.

  • Interviews patients for a complete medical history. Reviews in-patients, ER, and outpatients EMR’s to obtain pertinent clinical history. Records medical history on requisitions. Correlates other test results and laboratory data with exam being performed.

  • Assumes responsibility for the exam from beginning of exam until completion of dictated results.

  • Prepares and administers IV contrast according to departmental protocols. On request, records contrast type and amount.

  • Evaluates technical quality of images and consults with a Radiologist if needed. Recognizes abnormal anatomy and processes any additional, reconstructed images, and/or measurements as instructed.

  • Performs basic patient care functions. Informs appropriate nursing personnel of any changes in the patient’s condition. Initiates life support measures for patients when necessary. Assists in “code blue” procedures during medical emergencies.

  • Performs CT scanning and assists Radiologist/PA during invasive procedures. Practices proper sterile technique in the preparation of necessary supplies. Performs all invasive procedures in accordance with bloodborne pathogens, isolation, and infection control policies and procedures.

  • Is authorized to obtain medication or contrast material as directed for administration by a licensed practitioner.

  • Practices principle of radiation safety for self, employees, patients and family members. Follows appropriate radiation safety standards.

  • Reports malfunctioning equipment to the department director/manager/supervisor and clinical engineering/radiology engineer precautions. Maintains knowledge and skills required to work safely in an environment that can create significant exposure to bloodborne pathogens and infectious disease.

  • Adheres to the hospital fire and safety procedures. Attends all in-service classes and completes all required safety modules.

  • Performs work in an accurate and timely manner in periods of crisis and emergency situations where time is critical. Rotates shifts as required including call back, holidays, and weekends. Adheres to the Atrium Health attendance policy by being punctual and taking measures to prevent absences.

  • Operates radiology computer system to include entering orders and charging procedures/supplies. Documents contrast administration in the MAR.

  • Maintains assigned work area in a neat and orderly fashion. Keeps area completely stocked. Cleans all work areas to promote cleanliness in the workplace.

  • Assists other medical personnel, such as anesthesia, when performing exams or services in conjunction with a CT scan.

Minimum Job Requirements

Education

Graduate of an institution accredited by an agency that ARRT recognizes in Radiologic or Nuclear Medicine Technology.

Certification / License

ARRT certification in Radiology or NMTCB for Nuclear Medicine and advanced registry from the ARRT in CT within one year of hire required. BLS required.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

Requires moderate to heavy physical efforts in lifting and moving patients, equipment and supplies. Occasional standing, walking, and sitting during normal operation. Frequently may be required to stretch, bend twist, squat or kneel in the daily operation of the CT department. May be exposed to various physical conditions throughout the day such as walking on hard surfaces, climbing stairs, being near moving equipment. Required to use radiation safety guidelines to prevent exposure to ionizing radiation.

DISCLAIMER

All responsibilities and requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only responsibilities to be performed by an employee occupying this job or position. Employees must follow any other job-related instructions and perform any other job-related duties requested by their leaders.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.


About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

title: Sr Data Engineer -- Assortment and Space Planning
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

Data Engineers within the Assortment and Space Planning Data Science team translate business requirements and build the infrastructure needed to structure and deliver the data that powers self-service analytics and hardened business applications. They acquire datasets that align with business needs and develop pipelines to transform data into useful, actionable information. Additionally, they build, test, and maintain data pipeline architectures, create data validation methods and data quality tooling, and develop, host, and maintain data products to improve reliability and confidence through monitoring, testing, and validation. These associates use modern data engineering techniques to cleanse, organize, and transform data, and to maintain, defend, and update data structures and integrity on an automated basis.

The Sr. Data Engineer position creates and establishes design standards and assurance processes for data pipelines and applications to ensure compatibility and operability of data connections, flows, and storage, and reviews internal and external business and product requirements to recommend changes and upgrades to systems and storage. Beyond this technical ownership, the role mentors and coaches less experienced engineers, partners closely with data science, analytics, and application engineering teams to align on pipeline design, and communicates pipeline decisions and data quality tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners. These responsibilities require strong technical judgment, effective communication at all levels, and the ability to balance durable design standards with the business's near-term data needs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • 40% Data Validation, ETL, Infrastructure Development: Coding validation and ETL to ensure successful data integration
  • 30% Data Infrastructure Maintenance: Backup and optimization activities to maintain performance; code, configure, test, etc data to ensure integrity
  • 20% Data Architecture Design and Analysis: Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture; Develop data architecture to meet business requirements
  • 10% Planning/Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with team leads and cross functional partners to assess business requirements and communicate opportunities

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative or technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, etc.) or relevant work experience
  • 6+ years of relevant work experience
  • Demonstrated experience in data architecture, data warehousing, and dimensional modeling
  • Demonstrated experience developing and testing ETL/ELT jobs and pipelines, configuring orchestration, automated CI/CD, writing automation scripts, and supporting pipelines in production
  • Experience with Dataform or dbt for data transformation and pipeline orchestration
  • Experience in high-level programming languages such as Python
  • Experience defining and capturing metadata and rules associated with ETL processes
  • Experience building batch and streaming pipelines
  • Prior direct experience writing analytical SQL queries and performance-tuning queries (preferably Google BigQuery)
  • Ability to stitch and maintain data from multiple sources
  • Ability to optimize pipeline runtime and lower cost on slot/storage consumption
  • Ability to prioritize requests and manage a pipeline roadmap
  • Coaching junior engineers to help improve their code, best practices, and understanding of data engineering principles

title: Communications Technician 4, Network Maintenance
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

Job Summary

Responsible for performing routine troubleshooting calls, surveys, locates, outage repair, on-call duty, shift work, track/repair CLI, power supply maintenance and construction maintenance in accordance with Comcast procedures and practices. Will be called upon to troubleshoot and resolve service failures related to any Comcast products, to include but not be limited to Video (analog and digital,) Comcast Digital Voice (CDV,) and Comcast High Speed Data (CHSI) (including Home Networking and Home Plug.)

Job Description

Core Responsibilities

  • Performs routine troubleshooting calls: troubleshoots the plant through the distribution cable to the node in order to restore customer video, CHSI, or CDV as required. Must have the ability climb poles, ladders and operate aerial lifts 18 to 20 feet above ground, as determined by the system's requirements. Must possess the ability to use basic cable test equipment. Performs work near power lines and electricity.
  • Surveys the plant in order to ensure service availability to potential customers.
  • Performs underground location of existing plant using system prints and cable locating equipment in order to prevent cable damage and service interruption. Must have the ability to read general system layouts from blueprints.
  • Responds to and repairs service interruptions during regular business hours, shift work or when "On-calls" as required. Normal work shift may include evenings and/or weekends; may include 10 hour days for 4 days a week. Must be available to work overtime including weekends, evenings and holidays.
  • Performs CLI ride-out and track and repair leakage, as necessary. Works and travels in inclement weather.
  • Performs construction maintenance duties such as: splices aerial/underground coaxial cable and equipment to restore cable plant to system specification; splices and activates new coaxial plant as required; repairs and/or replace damaged aerial/underground plant; and inspects, repairs and/or replaces power supplies as necessary. Must have the ability to use basic cable installation tools and hand tools. Must have the ability to comply with safety procedures and requirements. Lifts and carries loads of 70 lbs. or more.
  • During the course of normal day-to-day activities: cleans, maintains and stocks vehicle and equipment in order to be prepared for daily responsibilities; completes associated paperwork with each job in a timely manner; properly operate and maintain tools and equipment; reports need for vehicle repair or service when required and/or prescribed; and reports any accidents, losses, injuries or property damage to supervisor and customer when appropriate. Drives company vehicle in a safe and responsible manner.

Workplace Digital Voice (WDV) standard; Commercial Video. Manipulates connectors, fasteners, wire; use hand tools. Must have vision ability of: close vision, peripheral vision, ability to adjust focus and differentiate colors.

  • Determines acceptability of video, data and voice services by reviewing television picture quality and PC and modem connection following any installation or work on cable services to provide the best possible service for the customer. Educates the customer on the CDV service and voice mail. Conduct CDV test call. Demonstrates CHSI service and educate customer on how to connect to the service, home page, national and local content and web browsing using URL(s,) etc. Must possess the ability to manipulate objects such as pens, keyboard and mouse.

  • Provides information on available services to new and existing customers in order to sell additional services and attempt to upgrade existing services.
  • Performs standard home theater installations associated with video installations. Must have knowledge of policies and procedures for installation activities.
  • Must have fifteen months cable telecommunications (and/or broadband) or similar experience. Possesses: knowledge of cable television products and services, basic knowledge of cable system operations, basic knowledge of a cable system overview and basic knowledge of the history of cable and Comcast.
  • Must have knowledge of components on the PC desktop and ability to perform the following: launch an application; add a shortcut; log into and navigate through a dial-up or other internet service; install software like Microsoft Internet Explorer, Netscape Communicator, Microsoft Windows, MS Office applications, educational software or games; navigate through a file system via the DOS prompt or window interface; access the Control Panel to configure components such as a printer, modem and monitor.

Will successfully complete training and instruction that includes, but not be limited to, the following topics (training should reflect the Network CommTech 4 Competencies document): Cable Theory and Terms, Construction Practices, Troubleshooting to Node and Return Path, Track and Repairs CLI, Power Supply Maintenance, Forward and Reverse Alignment and Safety Program.

title: Ocean Freight Operations & Development Intern
description:
About Toll Group

At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post —

Key Responsibilities

1. Ocean Freight Operations Support

  • Handle assigned import or export shipments from end-to-end under supervision.
  • Manage booking arrangements with carriers and related parties.
  • Monitor shipment status and ensure timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain schedule control and proactively identify potential service disruptions.
  • Update operational data accurately in internal systems.
  • Coordinate with overseas offices, carriers, trucking vendors, customs brokers, customers, and other internal departments to ensure smooth shipment execution.
  • Support customer relationship management activities and respond to basic customer inquiries.
  • Ensure compliance with company SOPs and operational procedures.

2. Vendor Development & Procurement Support

  • Research and identify potential Customs Brokerage and Trucking vendors in Vietnam.
  • Participate in vendor evaluation and onboarding processes.
  • Maintain vendor databases and related documentation.
  • Assist in collecting and comparing service offerings, rates, and operational capabilities from vendors.
  • Support the implementation and activation of newly approved vendors.

3. Carrier Development & Credit Support

  • Research new carriers and service options for specific trade lanes.
  • Assist with carrier onboarding and system setup processes.
  • Support carrier credit renewal and credit-line extension applications.
  • Maintain carrier records and contract documentation.

4. Process Improvement & Data Management

  • Assist in documenting and updating SOPs, working instructions, and operational guidelines.
  • Support projects aimed at improving productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare reports, maintain data records, and support performance analysis activities.
  • Participate in ad-hoc projects assigned by management.

5. Administrative Support

  • Handle administrative tasks assigned by the Branch Manager or Ocean Freight Management Team.
  • Support document filing, record management, meeting coordination, and internal communications.

REQUIREMENTS

Education

  • Final-year university student or fresh graduate in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Import-Export, Transportation, Economics, or related fields.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong interest in international freight forwarding and logistics operations.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational capability.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and work under deadlines.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken.
  • Fast learner with a proactive and positive working attitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous internship or academic project experience in logistics, freight forwarding, shipping lines, customs brokerage, or supply chain operations is an advantage.
  • Basic understanding of ocean freight import/export processes is preferred.

BENEFITS

  • Hands-on experience in international freight forwarding and logistics operations.
  • Exposure to end-to-end ocean freight processes.
  • Opportunity to work directly with carriers, vendors, overseas offices, and customers.
  • Mentoring and coaching from experienced logistics professionals.
  • Potential opportunity for future permanent employment based on performance.

Internship Duration: 6 months

Working Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday

What moves you?

At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.

Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.

At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.

To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com

You must be entitled to work in Vietnam and be prepared to undertake pre-employment checks including a criminal history check and medical.

title: Modernization Application Architect
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Join Kyndryl as an Application Consultant and become a catalyst for innovation and transformation. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs.

As a trusted advisor, you'll forge strong relationships with our customers, gaining deep insights into their business objectives and long-term aspirations. Armed with this understanding, you'll provide expert guidance on how technology can be leveraged to propel them towards unprecedented success. From aligning processes to technology to developing and deploying bespoke solutions, you'll be the visionary architect behind their digital transformation journey. Your expertise in application development and deployment best practices will ensure seamless integration and optimized performance.

In this role, your impact will be immense. You'll conduct thorough needs assessments, uncovering the requirements for new applications or upgrades to existing ones, and document these specifications with utmost precision using cutting-edge Business Analysis (BA) methodologies. Whether it's crafting comprehensive use cases, tracing requirements meticulously, or visualizing process flows, your attention to detail will be unmatched.

Drawing upon your exceptional analytical prowess, you'll gather requirements from stakeholders and masterfully translate them into functional and nonfunctional specifications. As the driving force behind our customers' application modernization endeavors, you'll guide them through every step of the process, ensuring their systems are future-proofed and optimized for success. Your expertise will also come into play as you assist customers in selecting and customizing the perfect packaged solutions to fulfill their unique business needs.

Collaboration will be your cornerstone as you work closely with application architects and development staff to bring your visions to life. Your keen eye for detail will shine as you analyze requirements, meticulously plan design and implementation work, all while adhering to time, cost, and quality targets. You'll consult with customers on compatibility challenges, such as hardware and operating system considerations, data conversion processes, and training requirements, offering them holistic solutions that align seamlessly with their budgets.

In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.

Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.

Your Future at Kyndryl
As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

•5+ years of experience in application development and deployment
•5+ years in application migration and modernization
•5+ years in application architecture, middleware and data experience
•Variety of technologies including BI, database principles, programming fundamentals, SQL, hardware/software, operating systems and networking
•Strong technical acumen & deep working knowledge of Agile Methods, Service Architecture, and enterprise Cloud Integration
•Strong ability to influence, collaborate and build relationships with key stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams

Preferred Skills and Experience

•SaaS application implementation experience: (Oracle E-Business Suite, NetSuite, Infor, Unit 4, PeopleSoft, Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP, Lawson, etc.)
•Application modernization tools, e.g. CAST
•Experience in using and implementing DevSecOps processes
•Past experience in assisting stakeholders in quantifying risks and developing mitigation and remediation strategies


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Programmatic Specialist
description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

Aleph is seeking a strategic, high-energy Programmatic Specialist to represent Spotify across the LATAM region. You don't need to be a hands-on trafficker or optimizer, but you do need to speak the language of DSPs, SSPs, and Ad Exchanges fluently enough to sell with real credibility, handle objections, and guide agencies through the offering.

What you'll do

  • Own revenue targets and pipeline growth for Spotify's programmatic solutions (self-serve, PMPs, always-on activations) across LATAM markets.
  • Proactively prospect and identify new opportunities, and unblock stalled ones within agencies and brands — finding the right internal contact, the right angle, and the right moment to move a deal forward.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with agency programmatic desks, buying, strategy, and digital teams across multiple markets — know how agencies are structured internally and how to navigate them.
  • Evangelize Spotify's programmatic offering to agencies and clients, driving upsell and always-on activations, and supporting partners with any questions along the way.
  • Translate campaign performance data into insights and business narratives that resonate with clients at a strategic level.
  • Train and mentor sales team members on programmatic positioning and talking points.
  • Stay current on programmatic trends, self-serve platform dynamics, and industry best practices to keep pitches sharp and relevant.
  • Represent Spotify/Aleph at industry events, building market presence across the region.
  • Work with third-party vendors and partners to strengthen the offering, and coordinate with internal specialist/operations teams to ensure smooth execution once a deal is won.

What you need for this role

  • 5+ years of experience in advertising sales, business development, or account management within programmatic/digital advertising.
  • Solid working knowledge of programmatic fundamentals: DSPs, SSPs, Ad Exchanges, and self-serve platforms — enough to sell and defend the offering with authority, even if you're not the one operating it day to day.
  • Proven track record building agency/client relationships and driving revenue growth across LATAM markets (regional exposure strongly preferred).
  • Strong understanding of agency internal structures and dynamics — you know who to talk to and how to get in the door.
  • Comfort with data at a consumption level: able to read dashboards and performance reports and turn them into a compelling client story (Salesforce, Sheets/Slides, Excel).
  • A genuinely commercial mindset — you love prospecting, relationship-building, and closing; programmatic is your specialty, not just a technical checkbox.
  • Exceptional storytelling, negotiation, and presentation skills; comfortable holding a room at C-suite level.
  • Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English.

What will make us really love you

  • Commercial Drive — You love the chase: prospecting, unblocking, closing.
  • Enough Data Fluency to Sell — You can read a dashboard and turn it into a story, even if you're not the one building it.
  • Adaptability — Comfortable moving between a strategic C-suite pitch and a technical programmatic conversation in the same day.
  • AI-Curious by Default — When a new tool shows up, you test it and fold it into how you sell — briefs, pipeline signals, prospecting — rather than just tolerating it.
  • Passion for music, audio culture, or the creator economy — You get why audio matters to brands and to people, and that shows up in how you pitch.
Why Join Us?
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
#ALEPH

title: SVP Credit Officer, Healthcare
description:
Citi’s US Commercial Bank (CCB) is a rapidly growing business, targeting emerging, mid- and larger-sized companies with annual revenue generally from $100 million to $3 billion. To facilitate the CCB’s wholesale lending activities, Commercial Lending Management (CLM) serves as an in-business credit function organized around our strategic industries and global target market approach. CLM plays a critical role of the client delivery model for the CCB, translating thought-leadership, industry and product expertise, and an end-to-end ownership of the credit relationship into best-in-class lending solutions. We are seeking a dynamic and motivated credit professional to join the US CLM team.


Citi is looking for a Senior Credit Underwriter to assess and manage complex credit risk across a portfolio of commercial banking clients, playing a pivotal role in shaping sound lending decisions at one of the world's leading global banks. In this position, you will apply deep financial expertise to evaluate high-value credit exposures, ensure compliance with credit and regulatory standards, and contribute directly to the performance and integrity of Citi's Commercial Banking business. You will work alongside experienced bankers and credit professionals, bringing analytical rigour and strategic judgement to transactions that matter.


Responsibilities

  • Assess credit extension requests for new and existing commercial clients, leading the underwriting of complex, higher-value transactions and producing thorough annual credit reviews.
  • Conduct detailed financial analysis of companies, including trend analysis, ratio assessment, and interpretation of financial statements to evaluate creditworthiness and repayment capacity.
  • Evaluate collateral performance across accounts receivable, inventory, machinery, equipment, and real estate to identify changes in trends and assess secondary repayment sources.
  • Monitor borrower compliance through monthly and quarterly reviews, tracking adherence to loan covenants and flagging material deviations to the relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure credit decisions align with Citi's credit policies and regulatory requirements, contributing to satisfactory outcomes in internal and external audits.
  • Mentor and train less experienced credit staff across application processing, credit analysis, and loan closing, building team capability and knowledge transfer.
  • Conduct industry and geographical research and due diligence to support informed credit decisions and identify emerging risk factors.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the credit underwriting function.

Required qualifications & skills

  • 10 or more years of experience in credit analysis or underwriting within a financial institution, with direct involvement in loan officer or underwriting responsibilities.
  • Advanced ability to read, interpret, and assess company financial statements, cash flow projections, and competitive and industry analysis in the context of credit risk.
  • Solid knowledge of intermediate accounting theory and its practical application in the credit underwriting process.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously, maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines in a structured office environment.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders and colleagues across business areas.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, including the use of graphs and charts, as well as Moody's financial analysis software.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent university-level qualification in a relevant discipline.

Beneficial skills & qualifications


  • A background in credit training programmes, lending, or formal credit officer development within a regulated financial institution.
  • A degree in finance or accounting, or a Master's degree in a related field.
  • Familiarity with commercial banking products and services across a broad institutional context.

What we offer


At Citi, senior credit professionals gain meaningful ownership over decisions that shape the quality of our commercial lending portfolio. You will operate in a collaborative, performance-focused environment with access to global resources, continuous professional development, and the tools to make a measurable impact from day one.


  • A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility alongside meaningful team collaboration.
  • Strategic influence over credit risk decisions on complex, high-value transactions within Citi's Commercial Banking business.
  • Access to learning and professional development resources to deepen your expertise and advance your career at a global financial institution.
  • A competitive compensation and benefits package, including financial wellbeing support designed for senior professionals.
  • The opportunity to mentor and develop the next generation of credit professionals, building lasting impact within the team.
  • Wellbeing support and work-life balance provisions that recognise the demands of a senior-level role.

Apply today to bring your credit underwriting expertise to a senior role at Citi, where your assessments will directly influence some of the most consequential commercial lending decisions in the business.

title: Digital Software Delivery Lead Analyst, Vice President
description:
Digital Software Engineering Lead Analyst

Position Summary

The Digital Software Engineering Lead Analyst is a senior strategic contributor who translates emerging field developments into tangible business direction, operating as a recognized subject matter expert whose counsel shapes how technology and operational decisions are made across teams, functions, and select external partners. Bringing commercial acumen, credibility, and influence to bear, this individual drives significant delivery impact — with outputs that shape the performance trajectory of the broader sub-function.

Core Accountabilities

The role leads end-to-end delivery of complex application development initiatives spanning cross-functional teams and concurrent workstreams, providing strategic direction rather than hands-on execution. This includes owning dependency management across the broader Digital organization to ensure coherent, coordinated application deployment at scale, defining and driving the overarching delivery strategy, and orchestrating internal and external teams toward committed outcomes. The individual engages business and technical stakeholders in structured trade-off conversations that balance effort, timelines, features, and constraints — ensuring decisions are timely and well-informed. Delivery blockers are anticipated and eliminated before they become critical, escalations are handled with precision, and forward momentum is maintained in ambiguous or high-pressure environments. Clear delivery metrics spanning Design Reviews, Code Reviews, CI/CD adoption, and Design Pattern adoption are established and published to provide consistent, real-time transparency into delivery health across all teams.

The Lead Analyst sustains expert-level command of application development methodologies, standards, and best practices. A deep, authoritative understanding of the business domain, systems, and products in scope — encompassing accountabilities, boundaries, limitations, and scale factors — is maintained to interrogate architectural decisions and champion sound long-term technology choices. Teams are guided in building systems that are disciplined in resource consumption, with deliberate attention to hardware, runtime performance, load tolerance, and memory efficiency.

Serving as the primary engineering liaison to TPMs and Engineering Managers, this individual provides early and accurate visibility into schedule risk while exercising influence well beyond the immediate team perimeter to drive continuous improvement and technology adoption across the organization. Stakeholder tension is navigated with confidence — discordant perspectives are surfaced, structured dialogue is facilitated, and durable resolutions are reached. The role demands a high degree of autonomy, generating clarity and momentum even where business or technical strategy remains fluid; product definition and technical planning fall outside its remit.

Rigorous risk assessment is applied across all intake and delivery decisions, with explicit regard for the firm's reputation and the protection of Citigroup, its clients, and its assets. Sound ethical judgment governs all aspects of personal conduct and business practice without exception, and control issues are managed and escalated with full transparency — ensuring they remain visible, tracked, and resolved.

Key Qualifications

The ideal candidate brings a demonstrated track record of leading delivery functions across large-scale or multi-project technology portfolios, paired with deep grounding in application development methodologies including SDLC, Agile, and Waterfall frameworks. Exceptional stakeholder management and communication capabilities are essential, with proven ability to translate complex business requirements into precise system specifications in close partnership with end users and TPMs. A solid command of risk assessment, controls, and regulatory compliance expectations within a complex enterprise environment is equally required.
