title: QA Analyst
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To determine, negotiate and agree internal quality procedures, service standards and specification to improve performance and quality directing objectives.

Accountabilities

  • Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in quality assurance Services.
  • Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate quality assurance processes.
  • Development and governance of internal quality assurance procedures, standards and specifications, and act as a catalyst for change, mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
  • Development of reports and presentations on quality assurance performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
  • Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in quality assurance processes and provide feedback and coaching for colleagues on these highlighted areas.
  • Execution of service quality assessments to monitor the quality objectives set by the bank, and ensure they comply with regulatory requirements.
  • Participation in projects and initiatives to improve quality assurance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Determination of risk based on outcome of QA reviews, flagging risks that are outside of tolerance.

Analyst Expectations

  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
  • Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
  • Partner with other functions and business areas.
  • Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
  • Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
  • Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
  • Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
  • Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
  • Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
  • Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
  • Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
  • Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us at Barclays as a Quality Assurance Analyst, where you will play a key role in enhancing performance and ensuring high standards across quality control processes. You will be responsible for determining, negotiating, and agreeing internal quality procedures, service standards, and specifications, supporting the delivery of consistent, high‑quality outcomes.

You will work closely with stakeholders to monitor performance, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to a strong control environment. This role requires attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to drive quality outcomes in a regulated environment.

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • Advanced experience within Financial Crime, with a solid understanding of associated processes and controls.
  • Proven experience in Quality Control or Quality Assurance environments.
  • Ample MS Office skills, particularly in Excel and reporting.
  • A proactive approach, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver high‑quality outputs.

Some other highly valued skills and experience include:

  • An ICA qualification (or equivalent).
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement.
  • Good communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Glasgow.

title: Solutions Engineer (Implementation)
description:
At Intenseye, we believe protecting people at work is non-negotiable.

That’s why we’re building the world’s most advanced AI-powered platform for industrial environments, designed to help organizations move from reactive programs to proactive risk prevention across safety, operations, and quality management. Our technology gives enterprises the ability to see risk and inefficiency as they emerge, take action in real time, and prevent incidents before they happen.

Powered by cutting-edge AI and Intenseye’s proprietary Sentinel hardware, our platform delivers ethical, highly accurate intelligence across complex worksites. EHS, operations, and quality teams gain continuous leading indicators, deep operational insight, and unprecedented visibility into how work actually happens.

Today, Intenseye helps protect hundreds of thousands of workers across 25+ countries—and we’re just getting started.

Intenseye is seeking an Implementation Solutions Engineer to lead the technical deployment of our AI-powered workplace safety platform across Fortune 500 manufacturing and industrial facilities. In this role, you will be the technical resource responsible for deploying Sentinel Hub edge devices, configuring camera integrations, establishing industrial control system connections, and ensuring successful go-lives of our safety monitoring solutions. You will work closely with customer IT, EHS, and operations teams to translate our AI capabilities into production-ready deployments on complex industrial networks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support sales team during technical proof-of-concept phases when specialized deployment expertise is needed
  • Lead end-to-end technical implementation of Intenseye solutions (Edge, Cloud, Hybrid).
  • Configure and deploy IP camera integrations (RTSP/ONVIF) across various VMS platforms (Avigilon, Genetec, Milestone).
  • Deploy and configure industrial protocol integrations (OPC UA, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU) with PLCs, SCADA, and IoT.
  • Set up secure, outbound-only connectivity to Intenseye cloud services.
  • Design deployment architectures, including edge processing, server specs, and network topology, based on customer constraints.
  • Conduct IT requirements reviews, camera compatibility assessments, and validate technical prerequisites pre-deployment.
  • Configure safety rules and use cases (PPE, restricted zones, LOTO) based on customer EHS requirements.
  • Partner with Implementation Managers and Customer Success Managers to ensure smooth technical handoffs throughout the customer lifecycle
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify custom solution requirements, escalate bugs, and provide field feedback
  • Collaborate with Security/Compliance teams to address customer IT security questionnaires and technical due diligence
  • Monitor deployment stability, coordinate model fine-tuning, and create technical documentation/runbooks for customers.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Implementation Managers, Product/Engineering, Security/Compliance, and Sales teams.

Qualifications

  • 2-3 years in technical implementation, solutions engineering, or systems integration deploying enterprise software/hardware.
  • Strong expertise in networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, firewalls, VPN) and Windows/Linux server administration/virtualization.
  • Hands-on experience with IP camera systems, RTSP, and Video Management Systems (VMS).
  • Experience with enterprise IT in manufacturing, logistics, or industrial environments (Fortune 500 a plus).
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex, multi-vendor technical environments.
  • Proficiency with cloud connectivity (AWS/GCP/Azure), REST APIs, edge computing, and video codecs ().
  • Excellent technical communication, project management, and customer-centric soft skills.
  • Familiarity with industrial systems (PLC, OPC UA, Modbus, SCADA) and DevOps tools (Docker, Python scripting) is a technical communication skills with ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple customer deployments simultaneously
  • Customer-centric mindset with focus on delivering successful outcomes under tight timelines
  • Self-directed problem solver who can work independently in remote customer environments
  • Willingness to travel up to 50-60% to customer sites for on-site deployments and troubleshooting.
Bonus Qualifications:
  • Industry certifications: CCNA, CompTIA Network+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator
  • Experience with BalenaOS, fleet management platforms, or IoT device management
  • Background in EHS (Environmental Health & Safety) or workplace safety systems
  • Familiarity with AI/ML model deployment, computer vision, or edge AI applications
  • Experience with Apache Pulsar, NATS, or other message queue systems

  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Annual Learning & Development Stipend

WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE

Program Execution and Delivery

  • Lead delivery of the entrepreneurship portfolio against agreed outcomes, milestones, quality standards, and impact targets.
  • Drive partner performance through clear expectations, regular performance reviews, continuous engagement, and timely course correction.
  • Identify implementation risks early, manage delivery trade-offs, and coordinate timely mitigation actions.
  • Apply adaptive management approaches using evidence, partner feedback, and changing market context.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership on entrepreneurship, MSME development, inclusive finance, market systems, and enterprise growth.
  • Advise partners on enterprise growth, investment readiness, access to finance, ecosystem strengthening, and scalable delivery models.
  • Use market intelligence, evidence, and implementation learning to recommend portfolio improvements.

Planning and Coordination

  • Ensure effective portfolio planning, sequencing, prioritization, and resource utilization.
  • Coordinate delivery across Foundation teams, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Enable execution through influence, alignment, and removal of bottlenecks.

Partner Stewardship and Performance

  • Build trusted relationships with implementing partners and ecosystem actors.
  • Establish clear expectations and monitor partner performance.
  • Address underperformance through coaching, escalation, and agreed consequence frameworks.

Portfolio Insight, Learning and Reporting

  • Maintain visibility on portfolio performance, risks, and outcomes.
  • Provide timely reporting and actionable recommendations.
  • Generate evidence and insights that improve portfolio performance and decision-making.
  • Capture, share, and apply lessons to continuously strengthen delivery and impact.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Entrepreneurship, International Development, Public Policy, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience leading complex entrepreneurship, enterprise development, private sector development, inclusive finance, or market systems programs.
  • Deep understanding of entrepreneurship ecosystems, MSME growth, access to finance, investment readiness, business development services, and job creation pathways for young people.
  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder partnerships across West Africa, preferably with exposure to WAEMU markets and regional entrepreneurship ecosystems.
  • Relevant experience may come from development finance institutions, impact investment or SME finance organizations, enterprise support platforms, incubators or accelerators, consulting firms, foundations, NGOs, government enterprise agencies, or private sector organizations working on entrepreneurship and job creation.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results through influence, partner stewardship, strong coordination, and sound judgement rather than formal authority.
  • Strategic and practical problem solver who can connect implementation realities with Foundation priorities, country plans, and partner delivery capacity.
  • Excellent communicator able to translate complexity into clear action.
  • Data-informed decision maker who uses evidence, learning, and portfolio insights to strengthen delivery, manage risk, and improve impact.
  • Resilient, adaptable, comfortable with ambiguity, and committed to the Foundation’s values, inclusive development, and impact for young people, especially young women.

The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone.


Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment.

title: Customer Technology Advisor - Digital Workplace Services (DWS) - Consultant avant-vente H/F
description:

Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Join our dynamic team as a Customer Technology Advisor and become an integral part of our cutting-edge Go-To-Market team. As a certified expert in your field, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing technology solutions for our valued customers. Working hand in hand with our Kyndryl Consult Partners and customer partners, you will leverage your technical and solution expertise to drive targeted opportunities and exceed customer expectations.

In this role, you won't just be another advisor; you will be a trusted ally and visionary, delivering unique and differentiated value to our customers. Through captivating show-and-tell methods such as engaging demos and compelling presentations, you will showcase our credibility and eminence in the industry, leaving a lasting impression on potential customers.

As a vital member of our team, you will support Consulting, Advisory, and Architecture activities across Sales, Pre-Sales & Delivery, collaborating closely with Customer Partners and Kyndryl Consult Partners. With your extensive technical knowledge and mastery of the practice-specific domain, you will bring together the breadth of Kyndryl's expertise to develop profitable deals that drive our success.

Your dedication to continuous improvement and your passion for our practice Digital Workplace Services (DWS) will shine through as you showcase your end-to-end knowledge of the domain you align with, as well as the associated subdomains. Your technical prowess, backed by your external certifications, will establish you as a true authority in your field.

As a Customer Technology Advisor, you will possess strong technical and business acumen, allowing you to provide value driven solutions within the practice services domain(s). Your exceptional customer facing skills, combined with your articulate communication style and interpersonal finesse, will enable you to effortlessly convey the technical benefits of Kyndryl's capabilities, perfectly matching the unique needs of each customer.

As a strategic thinker, you will identify the intricate business and technical requirements of our customers, leveraging the vast capabilities of Kyndryl to generate winning cross-practice solutions. Your ability to develop and deliver compelling demonstrations, proof of concepts, and prototypes will clearly demonstrate the tangible value our offerings bring to our customers, leaving them eager to partner with us.

In addition to your technical expertise, you will also take the lead in coordinating the entire pre-sales process, ensuring quality and compliance verification while adhering to Kyndryl best practices. Your collaboration with internal and external stakeholders will generate winning responses and create optimal technical solutions. Moreover, you will actively build and nurture relationships with our external alliance partners, fostering a collaborative environment where joint solutions are co-created.

Join our team of forward thinking, tech-savvy professionals and embark on a journey of innovation, growth, and fulfillment. As a Customer Technology Advisor, you will not only shape the future of technology solutions but also make a meaningful impact on the success of our customers and Kyndryl as a whole.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Deep domain knowledge of Services offerings and technical solutions in Digital Workplace Services empowered by AI (Digital Experience Management, Modern Devices and Endpoint Management, Employee Digital Support services, Modern Work Collaboration services…)
  • Demonstrated experience translating distinctive technical knowledge into actionable customer insights and solutions elevating Employee Experience at every stage of end-user journey, and driving Digital Transformation
  • Prior selling experience in significant deals Consult, Build and Managed Services
  • Externally recognized as an expert in Digital Workplace technology solutioning areas, including technical certifications, supporting subdomain focus areas such as Microsoft Solutions office 365, COPILOT, Intune, SCCM, ServiceNow or workplace Employee Experience innovation Technologies


Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
  • 5+ years of relevant experience selling technical services for multi-industry customers


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Requirements

  • Company-issued iPhone and equipment

Please watch our Day in the Life and Pay Plan videos on our Careers page to learn more about the daily responsibilities, compensation, and expectations of the role.

title: Danaher Business System Leader Manager, Hardware
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The Danaher Business System Leader Manager, Hardware is responsible for driving a robust understanding and application of Danaher Business System (DBS) tools across the team and driving short and long term business objectives within Hardware Operations. You will partner with cross functional leaders to drive business results and increase DBS capability and culture.


Why this role? This role is designed for experienced Production, Operations, and Manufacturing leaders who have successfully driven continuous improvement within their organizations and are looking to deepen their DBS expertise. You'll work closely with site leadership, lead strategic improvement initiatives, and coach teams through transformational change. In this role, you'll have a direct impact on Safety, Quality, Delivery, Inventory, and Productivity performance while supporting the operational excellence that helps Beckman Coulter deliver life-changing diagnostic solutions to patients worldwide.


This position reports to the Sr Director of Production Operations and is part of the Hardware Manufacturing plant located in Chaska, MN, and will be an on-site role.



In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Apply DBS tools to drive transformative change to improve KPI’s in the Hardware Operations Plant, actively participate in Daily Management to take action and solve problems, coach and mentor work teams to build sustainable processes that deliver on KPI’s
  • Apply DBS to collaborate with others, asking for feedback and reacting constructively; take initiative and accountability for corrective measures
  • Collect Gemba evidence and participate actively in Kaizen. Lead others in getting to root cause at Gemba.
  • Sets and delivers on goals for self that are challenging and aspirational within the scope of available resources to support growth and DBS capability targets.
  • Include DBS in development plans and engage as a Certified Practitioner for DBS tools. Mentor peers and modify behavior based on feedback to enhance impact.



The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 9+ years of experience, or Master’s degree with 7+ years of experience, or Doctoral degree with 5+ years of experience
  • 4+ years of experience in Lean Manufacturing, Engineering, Production, or Operations is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor associates and teams of various levels, from production associates to Sr. Leaders
  • Demonstrated experience leading change initiatives and driving adoption of new processes, systems, or ways of working within a manufacturing or operations environment
  • Experience navigating ambiguity, prioritizing competing demands, and making sound decisions in a dynamic manufacturing environment



Travel Requirements:

  • Ability to travel to other Danaher Operating Companies for own development and to drive continuous improvement at other locations - up to 10% travel



It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Achieved Certified Practitioner or similar certifications in applicable DBS tools (SW, 5S, TPI, PSP, VSM)

title: Logistik Operatør til Råvareafdelingen
description:
Vil du være en vigtig del af forsyningskæden til vores produktion?

Trives du med praktisk arbejde, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus? Har du erfaring med IT, lager- og truckkørsel, og motiveres du af at holde orden og sikre, at råvarer håndteres korrekt?

Så har vi en spændende mulighed i vores råvareafdeling.


Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor du bidrager til, at råvarer, ingredienser og hjælpestoffer håndteres sikkert og effektivt, så produktionen kan køre stabilt hver dag.


Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som lagermedarbejder i råvareafdelingen får du en central rolle i den daglige drift. Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være:


Lager og varemodtagelse

  • Tømning af containere og lastbiler med råvarer, ingredienser og hjælpestoffer
  • Modtagekontrol af ingredienser, råvarer og hjælpestoffer
  • Fremførsel af råvarer og øvrige hjælpestoffer til produktionen
  • Håndtering og registrering af varer i relevante systemer
  • Bidrage til effektiv og sikker lagerdrift

Prøvehåndtering og kvalitet

  • Udtagning og håndtering af prøver fra kemikalier, ingredienser samt øvrige råvarer
  • Sikre korrekt håndtering og aflevering af prøver
  • Holde sig opdateret på relevante procedurer, GMP-krav samt sikkerheds- og miljøinstruktioner

Orden, sikkerhed og vedligehold

  • Sikre orden, ryddelighed og GMP-standarder på råvarelagre og virksomhedens udendørsarealer
  • Bidrage til rengøring af lagerområder og øvrige arbejdsområder
  • Være opmærksom på skadedyrsforekomst og medvirke til forebyggelse og bekæmpelse
  • Understøtte virksomhedens høje standarder inden for sikkerhed, miljø og kvalitet

Truckkørsel og intern transport

  • Betjening af forskellige trucktyper, herunder:
    • Picktruck
    • Stabler
    • Gaffeltruck
    • Containertruck
    • Terminaltrækker
  • Intern transport af råvarer og materialer mellem lagerområder og produktion

Samarbejde og fleksibilitet

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv trivsel i afdelingen
  • Understøtte andre lagerområder ved spidsbelastning, ferie og sygdom
  • Udføre opgaver, der dagligt aftales med nærmeste leder
  • Bidrage med idéer til løbende forbedringer af processer og arbejdsgange

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:


Har

  • Erfaring fra lager, logistik eller produktion
  • Truckcertifikat og erfaring med truckkørsel
  • Fokus på sikkerhed og kvalitet i det daglige arbejde
  • Erfaring med varemodtagelse og materialehåndtering
  • Kendskab til GMP eller arbejde i regulerede produktionsmiljøer er en fordel

Er

  • Ansvarsbevidst og pålidelig
  • Struktureret og kvalitetsorienteret
  • Praktisk anlagt og trives med fysisk arbejde
  • Fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger
  • En holdspiller med fokus på samarbejde og trivsel
  • Motiveret for at bidrage til forbedringer og udvikling

Vi tilbyder

  • En vigtig rolle i en virksomhed, hvor lager- og råvarefunktionen er afgørende for produktionen
  • En varieret hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver
  • Et uformelt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger
  • Mulighed for at præge og forbedre arbejdsgange
  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder og en arbejdsplads med høje standarder inden for sikkerhed, kvalitet og miljø

Interesseret?

Så send din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede kandidater til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Apoyamos la flexibilidad y el equilibrio entre vida profesional y personal, fomentamos un excelente ambiente de trabajo e invertimos en aprendizaje continuo a través de DXC University con certificaciones ilimitadas. description:
FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary

The Software Engineering for Audience and Measurement (SEAM) team builds the audience, identity, and measurement services that help advertisers and publishers reach the right people and understand campaign performance. The team delivers identity resolution, audience segmentation, and privacy-preserving measurement solutions at scale, enabling more effective targeting, optimized spend, and clear insights into advertising impact.

We are looking for a Sr Software Engineer that will lead the technical design and delivery of complex software solutions. These initiatives will encompass automation, analytics, and cloud optimization objectives and span multiple engineering teams. Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Software Development & Engineering, you will remain a hands-on individual contributor, partnering with Engineering, Finance, Product, Architecture, Data, Platform, and SRE. You will translate ambiguous efficiency goals into reliable solutions, guide technical decisions, and validate improvements in unit cost, developer productivity, reliability, and infrastructure. You will promote peer growth by providing technical leadership to more junior engineers, without direct people-management responsibility.

Job Description

Core Responsibilities

  • Independently lead complex optimization initiatives from problem definition and technical design through implementation, rollout, and outcome validation. Coordinate dependencies across teams, escalating material risks to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Architect and build reusable software, data pipelines, dashboards, and automation; connecting cloud spend, resource utilization, unit economics, reliability, and engineering productivity across services.
  • Partner with engineering and finance leadership, to define baselines, success measures, cost-benefit assumptions, and delivery options; validate realized savings, distinguishing recurring savings from cost avoidance.
  • Diagnose systemic inefficiencies across distributed services and data platforms; lead improvements in compute, storage, data movement, capacity, and workload placement. Execute against the aforementioned goals; simultaneously ensuring platform performance and stability.
  • Design and productionize AI- and analytics-enabled forecasting, anomaly detection, and operational automation. Evaluate accuracy, operating cost, security, and human oversight before scaling adoption.
  • Contribute to the design and delivery of scalable, available, secure, and maintainable services using cloud-native patterns, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated testing, and observability.
  • Own the technical quality of integrations between engineering telemetry, billing, financial planning, and reporting. Establish data contracts, reconciliation checks, lineage, and auditable metric definitions.
  • Support capacity planning, cost allocation, tagging, chargeback, and forecasting processes that improve financial accountability and budget accuracy across engineering teams.
  • Develop automated unit and integration tests, troubleshoot production and data-quality issues, and ensure solutions adhere to engineering, security, compliance, and operational standards.
  • Mentor (more) junior engineers through design guidance, code reviews, and technical coaching; coordinate technical work on shared initiatives and promote adoption of reusable solutions.
  • Communicate technical recommendations, delivery risks, financial assumptions, and measured outcomes to engineering and business stakeholders; identify follow-on opportunities and recommend priorities to Management
  • Stay current on cloud cost-management practices, AI capabilities, data platforms, and engineering productivity tools; prototype and evaluate technologies that can improve operational efficiency.
  • Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
  • Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

The Ideal Skillset:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically, 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Rust, or Scala.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently turn ambiguous business objectives into technical designs, phased delivery plans, and measurable outcomes across multiple services or teams.
  • Deep experience with at least one major cloud provider—AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI—and demonstrated application of billing, utilization, allocation, and capacity data to cloud optimization decisions.
  • Proficiency designing and operating cloud-native services with CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with microservices, containers, and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, or OKE.
  • Strong SQL skills and exposure to data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Presto, EMR, PostgreSQL, or Aerospike.
  • Experience building dashboards, automated reporting, data pipelines, or observability solutions using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Grafana, or business intelligence platforms.
  • Ability to analyze technical and financial data, quantify tradeoffs, debug scoped issues, and turn findings into practical engineering actions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with Engineering, Finance, Product, Architecture, Data, Platform, SRE, compliance, and end users.

BONUS POINTS:

  • Adtech or Advertising industry experience.
  • Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, forecasting, AI-assisted engineering, or advertising and audience platforms is preferred but not required.

Employees at all levels are expected to:

  • Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
  • Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamlessdigital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
  • Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
  • Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
  • Be an active part of the Net Promoter System - a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
  • Drive results and growth.
  • Respect and promote inclusion & diversity.

Raytheon’s Data, Analytics, and AI organization is seeking an SAP BW Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions using SAP BW and modern SAP cloud data technologies. In this role, you will enable high‑quality business intelligence, reporting, and analytics by delivering strong data models, optimized ETL processes, and seamless integration across SAP and non‑SAP environments. You will also play a key part in Raytheon’s data modernization initiatives, including the migration of SAP BW 7.x assets to SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) leveraging SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain SAP BW data models, including InfoCubes, InfoObjects, InfoProviders, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, and MultiProviders.
  • Lead and support the migration of BW 7.x models and logic to SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), including Datasphere data modeling, Data Fabric integration, and SAC reporting enablement.
  • Convert BW InfoObjects, InfoProviders, and transformation logic into CDS views and semantically rich data models required for BDC consumption.
  • Map legacy BW objects to modern Datasphere entities (Datasets, Views, Replication Flows, Data Builder objects).
  • Enhance BW and Datasphere performance through query optimization, process chain tuning, load orchestration, and data flow monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with business analysts, data architects, and functional SAP teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support reporting development and migration from BEx Queries to SAC Stories, Models, and Analytic Applications.
  • Maintain data quality, governance, lineage, and metadata standards across SAP BW, Datasphere, and enterprise data environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data load issues, system performance problems, and integration errors.
  • Document technical designs, data flows, conversion approaches, and operational procedures.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP BW (7.x) and/or BW/4HANA including expertise in InfoProviders, ADSOs, Open ODS Views, CompositeProviders, Process Chains, and BEx query development.
  • Solid understanding of the migration of SAP BW objects to SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) using SAP Datasphere including practical experience converting InfoObjects and InfoProviders into CDS Views or equivalent semantic models for cloud consumption.
  • Experience with SAP ECC/S4 modules and extractors (FI/CO, SD, MM, HR, etc.).
  • Experience enabling analytics in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) including Model creation, Story building, and integration with Datasphere.
  • U.S. Citizen - The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Knowledge of ABAP for BW enhancements is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as Snowflake.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies.
  • Exposure to DataOps or CI/CD pipelines for data solutions.
  • SAP BW/4HANA or SAP Datasphere certification.
  • Analytical thinking
  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Continuous improvement mindset

title: Quality Engineering Technician - First Shift
description:
Hyve Company Overview

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.



The Quality Engineering Technician (QET) supports manufacturing and quality operations by conducting process audits, driving corrective actions, maintaining quality documentation, supporting First Article Inspection (FAI) activities, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. The QET works closely with Quality Engineers, Manufacturing, Process Engineering, and Quality Control teams to improve product quality, process adherence, and operational effectiveness.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities Required:

Process Audits & Compliance

  • Conduct scheduled audits of manufacturing processes using applicable VMI Checklists, Control Plans, Quality Plans, and other quality standards.
  • Track audit completion status and maintain weekly audit schedules.
  • Document audit findings and monitor corrective actions through closure.
  • Verify process compliance and identify gaps requiring improvement.

Corrective Action & QRQC Support

  • Support Quick Response Quality Control (QRQC) activities by investigating top manufacturing quality issues.
  • Track implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of quality concerns.
  • Maintain visibility of open quality issues and action status.

Quality Control Checklist Management

  • Review and improve QC inspection checklists based on manufacturing feedback and quality findings.
  • Identify gaps in existing inspection methods and recommend corrective updates.
  • Maintain current inspection documentation and ensure deployment of revisions.

First Article Inspection (FAI) Support

  • Coordinate and track planned and completed FAI activities.
  • Maintain FAI metrics and status reporting.
  • Ensure early notification and communication of upcoming FAI requirements.
  • Assist with documentation review and completion.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve training, knowledge transfer, and quality processes.
  • Participate in process improvement projects and implementation activities.
  • Support development of standardized work practices and tracking methods for quality operations.
  • Collaborate with Quality Engineers and management to drive long-term quality improvements.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain quality tracking systems, action logs, audit records, and performance metrics.
  • Prepare summaries of audit results, quality findings, corrective actions, and improvement activities.
  • Provide regular status updates to Quality Engineering and management teams.

Qualifications:

Education

  • AS or BS degree preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education, technical training, and manufacturing quality experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing, quality, engineering technician, or quality control environment.
  • Experience supporting process audits, inspections, corrective actions, or quality system activities.
  • Experience working in high-volume manufacturing, electronics, server, or related industries preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Understanding quality systems, inspection methods, and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to interpret work instructions, control plans, quality plans, process flow diagrams, and engineering documentation.
  • Familiarity with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements and documentation preferred.
  • Experience utilizing quality tracking systems, databases, and reporting tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to identify process gaps and drive issue resolution through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Ability to collect, analyze, and present quality data and metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting manufacturing process audits.
  • Familiarity with IPC standards, defect classification, and electronic assembly inspection.
  • Experience supporting QRQC, CAPA, 8D, SCAR, or continuous improvement activities.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, or similar quality management systems.
  • Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma experience is a plus.

Benefit Insurance

  • Mental Health Care

title: IT Systems Administrator (New York)
description:
At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. We develop innovative technologies that provide underserved and overlooked borrowers with better access to credit. We are hiring an IT Systems Administrator to own day-to-day IT for our New York office. You will be the only IT person on-site, which makes you the face of IT for everyone in the office.

You are part of a global IT team reporting to IT leadership in Boston, who share tooling standards, escalation paths, and coverage.

Key Responsibilities

Identity and Google Workspace administration

  • Administer Google Workspace end-to-end (Gmail, Drive/shared drives, Calendar, Groups, Meet) plus core business/SaaS apps the NY office depends on user provisioning, access controls, and security settings coordinating with the global team on tenant-level configuration.

  • Use Google Vault, the Security Investigation Tool, and Alert Center to support audits, security investigations, and eDiscovery requests.

  • Own local access management: MFA enforcement, periodic user access reviews, device compliance, and least-privilege access, in line with global policy.

Endpoints and device management

  • Provision, troubleshoot, and repair macOS/Windows laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals.

  • Manage macOS in Jamf: enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, and compliance policies.

  • Run employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, role changes) device prep, account setup, and access changes and maintain accurate asset records for laptops, accessories, licenses, ownership, and equipment status.

Office infrastructure and AV

  • Maintain office network infrastructure (LAN/Wi-Fi, IP addressing, DNS/DHCP), coordinating with ISPs and network vendors on larger issues.

  • Set up and maintain Zoom Rooms/AV and conference rooms, keeping them reliably ready day to day to resolve printer connectivity/hardware issues.

  • Support desk setups, office moves, and new-space buildouts alongside the Workplace team.

Service delivery and documentation

  • Track and resolve Jira tickets, keeping prioritization, response times, and communication consistent.

  • Find recurring tickets and remove the cause automate a provisioning step, fix the root issue, or document the fix.

  • Write and maintain SOPs and knowledge base docs so employees can self-serve and the global team can cover NY when you're out; partner with global IT, stakeholders, and vendors on escalations and process improvement.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, or SaaS administration. A degree in IT, Computer Science, or Information Systems is welcome; equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

  • Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace in a business environment.

  • Experience supporting both macOS and Windows, with Jamf or another MDM platform.

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: LAN/Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing.

  • Experience with a ticketing system such as Jira to manage and resolve support requests.

  • Understanding of user access management, including account lifecycle and access review processes.

  • Strong communication and customer service instincts — you can explain a fix to a non-technical colleague without making them feel foolish.

  • Comfort as the sole on-site technical resource: you prioritize your own queue, know when to escalate, and stay steady when several things break at once.

Nice to Have

  • Okta: SSO, MFA, provisioning, lifecycle management, and access policies.

  • Apple Business Manager.

  • Advanced Google Workspace features: Context-Aware Access, DLP, and OAuth app control.

  • Scripting and automation — Google Apps Script, Bash, Python, or similar — to replace manual provisioning and reporting work.

  • Exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.

  • Certifications in Google Workspace, Okta, Jamf, Apple, or general IT support.

title: Lead or Senior Scientist - Genome Editing, Genomics, Biotechnology (Shengdar Q. Tsai Lab)
description:
A Lead or Senior Scientist opportunity with the Tsai Lab to develop a therapeutic platform for in vivo base editing treatments and drug products to treat patients with bone marrow failure disorders at St. Jude.

Help us build an individualized therapeutic base editing platform to treat St. Jude patients with rare bone marrow failure disorders by correcting their disease-causing mutations in their hematopoietic stem cells in vivo. Dr. Tsai leads the recently launched DRIVE project (Delivering Rare-disease In vivo Editors), funding a multi-institutional, public-private partnership to develop in vivo base editors for treatment of bone marrow failure disorders.

Bring your expertise in genome editing drug development to a Lead Scientist role in the Tsai Lab, where you will help advance genome editing technologies toward individualized treatments for pediatric patients. Our goal is to develop in vivo base editing drug products, complete IND-enabling studies, and open clinical trials in the next 3 years.

About the job opportunity. We are seeking an outstanding and highly motivated Lead Scientist or Senior Scientist to help lead efforts to develop personalized genome editing treatments. We care deeply about the success of our scientists, and this is a unique opportunity to help lead development of an in vivo gene therapeutic gene editing platform and drug products at St. Jude, with substantial room for career growth and advancement.

Overview of our lab. The Tsai lab is a highly collaborative, creative, and motivated group of scientists at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital. Our research centers on development of state-of-the-art genomic methods for understanding the global activities of genome editors, protein engineering to improve capabilities for precise editing, and translation to autologous genome edited hematopoietic stem cell therapies. Dr. Tsai also co-leads the PARADIGM (Partnership to Advance Development of Individualized Genomic Medicines) blue sky project.

You would have opportunities to lead an exciting and fast-paced drug development effort:

  • Design and develop in vivo base editing drug products to treat St. Jude patients with bone marrow failure disorders.
  • Characterize the genotoxicity of candidate drug products using state-of-the art genomic assays such as CHANGE-seq-BE and CHANCE-seq, including variant-aware analysis.
  • Optimize potency and specificity of a HSC-targeted lipid nanoparticle gene editing approach.
  • Co-lead a multi-disciplinary team to test a new streamlined platform approach for in vivo genome editing medicines.

You would learn valuable skills that include:

  • Genome engineering, high-throughput genomics, laboratory automation, IND-enabling studies for genome editing drug development.

Project-dependent responsibilities would include:

  • Coordinate a team of scientists working to develop a novel gene editing platform.
  • Accelerate lead-target discovery, genotoxicity characterization, and cargo optimization.
  • Non-clinical pharmacology studies of an HSC-targeted lipid nanoparticle.
  • Continuously assess and manage project technical and drug development risks.
  • Analyze experimental outcomes and develop high-quality summaries.
  • Summarize results and present updates to the broader DRIVE and ARPA-H teams.
  • Draft manuscripts and figures for publication in high-impact journals.

Application process

Apply now to join our talented team!


Please include a cover letter explaining your interest addressed to Dr. Tsai who will read and review all qualified applications. If you have questions about the position, please don’t hesitate to e-mail Dr. Tsai directly (shengdar.tsai@stjude.org).


Minimum Education and/or Training:

  • PhD in relevant scientific area is required, such as genomics, molecular and cell biology.
  • Expertise in genome editing, genomics, next-generation sequencing.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Four or more years of hands-on research laboratory experience working with CRISPR genome editors and NGS library preparation.

Lead Scientist Minimum Experience:

  • Twelve (12) years of relevant work experience is required with a Bachelor’s degree
  • Ten (10) years of relevant experience is required with a Master's degree
  • Seven (7) years of relevant work experience is required with a PhD

Salary Range: $125,840.00/yr. - $238,160.00/yr.


Senior Scientist Minimum Experience:

  • Ten (10) years relevant work experience is required
  • Eight (8) years of relevant work experience is required with a Master's degree
  • Five (5) years of relevant work experience is required with a PhD

Salary Range: $104,000/yr. - $186,160.00/yr.


St. Jude Benefits

St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital is one of the world’s leading pediatric hospitals whose mission is to advance cures for catastrophic childhood diseases. Consistent with the vision of our founder, no child is denied treatment based on race, religion, or ability to pay.

St. Jude has been consistently named one of the best companies to work for by Fortune, Glassdoor, and others. St. Jude offers excellent benefits, a competitive salary, relocation assistance, and actively fosters professional development. As part of your role, you will have opportunities to attend and present at national and international meetings such as ASGCT, ASH, Keystone Genome Engineering, CSHL Genome Editing, and FASEB Genome Engineering.

title: Principal Product Manager ESG and Investment Foundations
description:
WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is a global provider of integrated investment management solutions, part of Deutsche Börse Group, trusted by more than half of the world's top 100 financial companies. Five years ago, SimCorp's ESG solution did not exist. Today, many of these financial institutions use it for regulatory reporting such as SFDR-PAI and the EU Taxonomy. The newest addition is an AI agent that turns plain-language questions into working ESG analytics. Next on the roadmap: ESG attribution — explaining why a portfolio's ESG results changed between periods, or why they differ from a benchmark.

Our Product Owner is moving to a new role within SimCorp, and we are looking for the person to take over the backlog, the sprints, and the daily decisions that turn regulation into working software.

The timing matters. ESG is becoming part of a larger product area, Investment Foundations, which also covers business entities and a funded programme to eliminate free codes from our standard solutions. The backlogs will merge in the near term, and the role grows with them. You start with ESG.

You will work with an established engineering team (hiring is underway for 1–2 more) and closely with the Product Manager for Investment Foundations. The role can be based in Copenhagen, Frankfurt, Paris, London or Warsaw.

This is a very involved role with real ownership and direct client contact. Ideas get a fair hearing here, including unconventional ones; if yours holds up, you will get the backing to build it. You'd be joining a product with real traction and demanding users — the tightest feedback loop a Product Owner can ask for — and AI product work that is already in production, with room to push it further.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  • Own and prioritize the backlog, sprint by sprint, balancing client value, platform quality and technical health
  • Translate regulatory text into product increments and acceptance criteria — often while the text is still in consultation
  • Set goals with the team and own the outcomes we have promised clients, not just the output
  • Prototype before building: a mock-up, a rough demo, a client call. Being wrong on paper is cheap; being wrong in production is not.
  • Act as a knowledgeable subject-matter resource in client and auditor meetings, and host the user group for our ESG community
  • Work with data vendors and partners, including within Deutsche Börse Group, which SimCorp is part of
  • Say no, often, and explain why — the backlog holds more good ideas than the team has quarters
  • Use AI in your daily work: for research, for prototyping, and increasingly for building. Product management here is moving toward building, not just specifying — the title on this ad says Product Owner but treat it as a starting point.

WHAT WE VALUE

We would rather say this now than in the interview. Compliance software leaves no room for "mostly right". The domain is dense and getting wider, and it takes months to get genuinely good — we will teach you, but you have to want it. You will depend on teams you do not control, so coordination, not authority, is the daily tool. And the rules sometimes change while you are building for them.

People who ask "why" one more time than expected, follow problems into other teams' domains, and stay on the call until the thing works do well here. How many years you have carried the Product Owner title matters less than whether you learn faster than the regulation changes.

You will be a good match if you have several of the following:

  • Curiosity about AI and about how the investment industry works
  • Experience with ESG or regulatory reporting, e.g. SFDR-PAI or the EU Taxonomy
  • Knowledge of SimCorp's ESG solution or SimCorp Dimension (a plus)
  • Experience with B2B or enterprise software, especially data-heavy products
  • Experience owning the backlog and delivering with engineering teams
  • Clear written and verbal communication

BENEFITS

  • Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
  • Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
  • Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
  • Inclusive and diverse company culture
  • Pension and health benefits and bonus
  • Work-life balance – We truly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self's, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
  • Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

  • Supporting employee lifecycle operations by processing HR transactions related to hiring, onboarding, talent movement, headcount changes, terminations and more, while ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with established processes.

We’re committed to our people’s growth and well-being because our success is tied to theirs. title: Programme Manager
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

Focused on delivering individual projects, ensuring completion within scope, time, and budget with a more immediate focus.

Accountabilities

  • Scope Management: Manages a single project with specific, defined objectives, deadlines, and deliverables. Their focus is on completing the project on time, within scope, and on budget.
  • Strategic Focus: Operates more tactically, focusing on day-to-day management of resources, schedules, and deliverables for their individual project.
  • Time Horizon: Works with a shorter, more defined timeframe as projects have a set beginning and end.
  • Stakeholder Management: Primarily manages stakeholders related to their specific project, ensuring communication and expectations are clear for the project’s deliverables.
  • Risk and Issue Management: Focuses on risks and issues specific to their project and works to mitigate them within the project’s scope.
  • Resource Management: Manages resources for their individual project, ensuring that the project team has the necessary skills, tools, and time to complete the work.
  • Financial Management: Focuses on managing the budget of their specific project, ensuring it is completed within the financial constraints.
  • Metrics: Measures success based on the timely completion of project deliverables within scope, time, and budget.
  • Change Management: Manages changes that directly impact their specific project, including scope changes, timelines, or resource allocation adjustments.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

You’ll lead high-profile programmes managing change across data, technology and the businesses groupwide, bringing together multiple teams and senior stakeholders to navigate complexity, drive delivery and achieve strategic, operational, and regulatory outcomes.

The Integrated Financial Crime (IFC) portfolio is a multi-faceted initiative of Financial Crime change spanning over 30 programmes to build a robust risk-based environment. It focuses on enhancing Financial Crime processes groupwide, strengthening skills across all lines of defence, empowering partners, colleagues and customers to combat Financial Crime by raising awareness of the risks.

To be successful as a Programme Manager, you should have the following essential skills:

  • Large-Scale Data Transformation: Experience leading large-scale data transformation programmes, with ample knowledge of data architecture, quality, governance and lineage. Experience delivering data solutions that support strategic, operational, and regulatory outcomes.
  • Programme Leadership: Experience leading multi-faceted, multi-stream transformation programmes, with ample governance, planning, risk and delivery management capabilities. Comfortable navigating changing priorities and ambiguity.
  • Senior Stakeholder Management: Ample experience influencing senior stakeholders, driving strategies and operating across multi-faceted matrix organisations. Ability to align multiple teams, priorities and dependencies to maintain delivery momentum.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

title: Faculty Position, Center of Excellence in Neuro-Oncology Sciences (CENOS)
description:
Center of Excellence in Neuro-Oncology Sciences (CENOS)
Developmental Neurobiology Department

St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital invites applications for a research faculty position at the assistant/associate member rank (equivalent to assistant or associate professor) to join the newly established Center of Excellence in Neuro-Oncology Sciences (CENOS). CENOS aims to address foundational biological questions and drive clinically impactful discoveries to advance knowledge and enhance survival outcomes for children with malignant brain tumors. Successful applicants will join a cohort of thriving research groups who study childhood brain tumors from complementary angles.


We are seeking an investigator to lead a multidisciplinary research program focused on advancing our understanding of malignant childhood brain tumors through innovative approaches in fundamental biology, neuroscience, neuro-immunology, metabolism, data science, and related disciplines. We welcome candidates with expertise spanning mechanistic and translational research, including the development of human stem cell and organoid models to study mechanisms of tumorigenesis; application of advanced multi-omics technologies to characterize tumor, immune, and metabolic states and discover resistance mechanisms; deployment of cancer neuroscience strategies to study communication networks that promote and maintain malignancy; investigation of neuro-immune interactions and metabolic dependencies that influence tumor initiation, progression, and therapeutic response; evaluation of novel selective dependencies and the mechanisms governing these vulnerabilities; and application of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other advanced data science methodologies to enhance biological discovery, diagnostics, and treatments for malignant childhood brain tumors. Early career investigators interested in contributing to a culture of excellence at St. Jude are encouraged to apply.


St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital is a world-class research institution dedicated to pediatric cancer and other catastrophic diseases of childhood. Our mission is to advance research and cures for pediatric cancer, the number one cause of death by disease for U.S. children past infancy. We are the first and only National Cancer Institute (NCI)-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center dedicated solely to children. Our Cancer Center has been recognized with the highest possible ranking of “exceptional” in its two most recent five-year reviews by the NCI.


St. Jude is a highly interactive environment offering its faculty a remarkable opportunity to perform groundbreaking independent and collaborative research. We provide long-term institutional support past start-up to facilitate innovation and discovery. St. Jude provides an impressive array of shared resources and core facilities to support research and discovery efforts across the institution relevant to pediatric cancer. This includes an extensive biorepository of clinical samples, patient derived xenografts, and genomic datasets matched to patients enrolled on St. Jude clinical trials. CENOS investigators have access to specialized departmental shared resources that include cutting edge live cell imaging, image processing & image data science, human stem cells, cell sorting and advanced animal behavior assessment. Our institutional commitment to lead in the cutting-edge imaging required for cancer neuroscience includes investments in advanced systems that include Lattice Light Sheet & MOSAIC microscopes, Helios and Teneo 3D electron microscopes, multiphoton microscopes with resonant scanning and optogenetic capabilities as well as a variety of super-resolution modalities.


We offer highly competitive packages, including substantial startup funds, equipment, laboratory space, personnel support and institutional support beyond the start-up phase. CENOS faculty reside in the Advanced Research Center, a 625,000 square foot facility designed to house cutting-edge technologies and resources to transform science and accelerate discoveries. Successful applicants may hold a Ph.D. and/or M.D. degree, have at least three years of relevant postgraduate experience, and a demonstrated track record of productivity. You will join a collaborative network of basic, translational, and clinical investigators conducting high-impact, interdisciplinary research.
