title: Managing Consultant IT Strategy & Transformation - Consultant IT H/F
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

At Kyndryl, we help leading IT organizations transform their operating models, improve performance, and evolve their practices to address new business and technology challenges.

We are looking for a Managing Consultant who can assess complex situations, define pragmatic transformation roadmaps, and support their implementation. Beyond frameworks and methodologies, success requires a strong consulting mindset: critical thinking, analytical skills, influential leadership, and a clear focus on outcomes.

Your Role

You will work with CIOs, CTOs, IT Operations Directors, and Executive Committees on large-scale modernization, performance improvement, and IT transformation initiatives.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assessing IT organizations, governance, processes, and performance.
  • Developing strategic recommendations and actionable transformation roadmaps.
  • Designing Target Operating Models and evolving organizations around products, platforms, and services.
  • Transforming IT practices using approaches such as ITIL 4, SRE, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, and Agile at scale.
  • Defining performance indicators and effective management mechanisms.
  • Engaging stakeholders and embedding the adoption of new ways of working.

What Will Make You Successful

You are able to:

  • Structure and solve complex business and technology challenges.
  • Turn insights into practical, actionable recommendations.
  • Produce executive-level analyses and deliverables.
  • Challenge existing practices with sound judgement and pragmatism.
  • Build alignment across multidisciplinary teams and influence without formal authority.
  • Develop trusted, long-term client relationships.
  • Write differentiated proposals aligned with clients’ business and technology priorities.


Who You Are

Your Expertise

You have strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • IT Operating Models and Organization Design
  • IT Governance and Transformation
  • IT Service Management and ITIL
  • SRE, Platform Engineering, and DevSecOps
  • Performance Management and Continuous Improvement
  • Organizational Change Management

Candidate Profile

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering, business, or a related discipline.
  • At least 15 years of experience in IT, including 6 years in a comparable role.
  • Significant experience in management consulting and/or the transformation of a large IT organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both French and English.
  • Based in the Paris region, with mobility depending on client assignments.
  • ITIL, SAFe, Cloud, SRE, or DevOps certifications are valued.

Why Join Us?

You will join a team specializing in IT strategy and transformation, working directly with senior IT leaders from major organizations.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Design the IT operating models of tomorrow.
  • Support high-impact transformation programs.
  • Contribute to the development of our consulting offerings and methodologies.
  • Strengthen your expertise alongside recognized industry professionals.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Maintenance Tech
description:
Tempur Sealy. Iconic brands. Storied history. Industry-leading innovation.

Tempur Sealy is committed to improving the sleep of more people, every night, all around the world. As a leading designer, manufacturer, distributor, and retailer of bedding products worldwide, we know how crucial a good night of sleep is to overall health and wellness. Utilizing over a century of knowledge and industry-leading innovation, we deliver award-winning products that provide breakthrough sleep solutions to consumers in over 100 countries. Our highly recognized brands include Tempur-Pedic®, Sealy® and Stearns & Foster®. We hire people who have a passion for helping others find their best night’s sleep. No matter what stage of your career, you can build your future at Tempur Sealy!

Tempur-Sealy is hiring a 1st shift maintenance technician at our Belmont, MS facility. The Maintenance Technician is a multi-skilled craftsperson responsible for the installation/start-up and troubleshooting of all mechanical and electrical processes used in manufacturing, as well as support equipment located in the building or on the grounds-the objective being to maximize production and functional longevity and appearance of the building, grounds and equipment.


Salary Range: $26.55 - $34.00 hourly


What you will do:

  • Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of all plant machinery, equipment, building and grounds.
  • Utilize 5s in the workplace, be cognizant of and use continuous improvement activities and practices, support and utilize effective root cause analysis, PM, TPM, and Best Maintenance Practices.
  • Follow proscribed 5-S policies' including insuring workplace is clean at the end of job, project, or workday
  • Fabricate and install special equipment as needed.
  • Perform maintenance, administrative, production, or other duties as assigned.
  • Perform and improve PM inspections, TPM events, and machinery knowledge database support.
  • Meet or exceed all safety required items 5S, PPE, Forklift training, aerial lift training, LOTO, and individual awareness training.
  • In the areas of pneumatic and hydraulic systems use applied knowledge of PM's, diagnostics, and trouble shooting.
  • Working knowledge of basic shop tools and machinery to properly use and direct the use of welders, oxy-acetylene torch, band saws, drill press, and hand tools.
  • Develop knowledge of blade change procedures to the extent that the knowledge is used to train operators, write procedures, and diagnose problems.

Requirements:

  • General knowledge and experience with chemical process systems including but not limited to pumps, valves, piping, control devices, gauges, and regulators is a plus.
  • Experience working with 480, 240 and 110v, DC power, and control circuits.
  • Mechanical, pneumatic, electrical and hydraulic experience is required.
  • High level working knowledge of mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, repair, and failure diagnostics.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in troubleshooting and repair of AC and DC drives, motor controls, PLC equipment, controls, and electro/mechanical devices.
  • Read and understand electrical schematics and mechanical diagram’s ability to use basic sketches to convey ideas.
  • Knowledge to install and maintain equipment, machinery, motors, drives, conveyors, switches, blades, bearings, electrical systems, hydraulic systems, and pneumatic systems
  • Arc Flash experience preferred
  • 3 to 4 years plant manufacturing experience preferred
  • Two-year technical degree, Vocational, or Apprenticeship Program preferred.
  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Able to work all shifts, if needed

title: Capture Portfolio Analyst, X-BAT Family of Systems (FoS) (R6011)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Capture Portfolio Analyst, X-BAT Family of Systems (FoS) to strengthen the analytical rigor, long-range planning, and operating discipline of the X-BAT FoS Capture organization.

As a core member of the X-BAT FoS Capture team, you will partner closely with the X-BAT FoS Capture Organization to maintain a high-confidence view of the current and future opportunity pipeline and assist in driving decisive action across the portfolio. You will turn pipeline data into actionable insights that inform prioritization, resource decisions, revenue planning, and long-term growth strategy.

This role owns the integrity and quality of X-BAT FoS portfolio pipeline information in Salesforce and related reporting tools and will establish the standards, review the data for completeness and credibility, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and drive corrective actions across the portfolio.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, experience working with CRM and business-planning data, comfort partnering with Finance, and the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations. This role will help ensure X-BAT FoS maintains a resilient pipeline across near-term pursuits and a three- to ten-year opportunity horizon.

What you'll do:

Capture Portfolio Strategy and Management
  • Maintain an integrated view of the X-BAT FoS opportunity pipeline across near-term, mid-term, and long-range pursuits.
  • Analyze opportunities using criteria including timing, estimated value, probability of win, market attractiveness, strategic relevance, expected revenue contribution, and resourcing requirements.
  • Partner with the X-BAT FoS Capture Organization to identify priority opportunities, inform portfolio trade-space decisions, and recommend actions to strengthen the pipeline.
  • Track changes in opportunity value, timing, stage progression, probability of win, customer funding, and other factors that affect forecast confidence.
  • Identify pipeline gaps, timing shortfalls, concentration risks, single-point dependencies, and opportunities that lack sufficient capture activity or next steps.
  • Recommend actions to create pipeline resilience, including alternate pursuits, adjacent customers, related mission areas, acquisition pathways, partner opportunities, and additional sources of demand.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of the X-BAT FoS opportunity space across a multi-year horizon and help identify and track actions needed to mature early opportunities into successful capture efforts.
Salesforce Data Quality and Reporting
  • Serve as the X-BAT FoS Capture organization’s lead for pipeline-data integrity, reporting standards, and Salesforce opportunity-management discipline.
  • Establish and maintain common expectations for opportunity stages, required data fields, forecast assumptions, probability assessments, next steps, and update cadence.
  • Review Salesforce opportunity records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and credibility; coordinate with account and opportunity owners to correct gaps, stale data, and unsupported assumptions.
  • Develop and maintain concise dashboards, trackers, and pipeline-review products that provide visibility into portfolio health, capture status, forecast changes, and key risks.
  • Partner with enterprise business-systems teams, as required, to improve reports, dashboards, workflows, and data structures that support X-BAT FoS pipeline management.
  • Maintain common definitions, reporting guidance, and pipeline-management best practices across the organization.
Finance and Revenue Planning
  • Partner closely with Finance to ensure a clear, traceable connection between Salesforce opportunity data, bookings assumptions, revenue forecasts, customer funding expectations, and long-range financial plans.
  • Reconcile pipeline assumptions, forecast timing, probability assessments, and anticipated award values with financial-planning inputs and revenue-recognition assumptions.
  • Support scenario analysis to assess the effect of opportunity delays, funding changes, competitive losses, scope changes, and alternate capture outcomes on the X-BAT FoS forecast.
  • Help maintain a recurring pipeline-to-finance review cadence and track resulting actions, decisions, and assumption changes.
Pipeline Risk and Operating Rigor
  • Identify risks to current and future pipeline health, including schedule uncertainty, customer-funding risk, acquisition delays, competitive pressure, overreliance on a limited number of pursuits, and insufficient capture activity.
  • Develop risk-mitigation recommendations and contingency plans with capture leads, account owners, Finance, business development, programs, and other stakeholders.
  • Support recurring pipeline reviews through time-phased analyses and dashboards that show opportunity maturation, anticipated awards, bookings, backlog, revenue contribution, key decisions, and follow-up actions.
  • Support knowledge management by maintaining pipeline assumptions, opportunity histories, risk registers, and lessons learned from wins, losses, cancellations, and schedule slips.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience, Master’s degree with 6+ years of relevant experience, or PhD with 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in business development, capture, sales operations, program management, finance, consulting, or another analytical operating environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate incomplete or changing data and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Experience using Salesforce to analyze opportunity data, maintain pipeline visibility, develop reports or dashboards, and support business-planning decisions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including development of concise analyses, trackers, dashboards, and briefing materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage data quality, establish reporting standards, and coordinate updates across multiple record owners or stakeholders.
  • Experience evaluating opportunities based on timing, value, probability, customer funding, strategic relevance, and expected business impact.
  • Experience leading and delivering cross-functional deliverables, decision points, and follow-up actions across multiple concurrent efforts.
  • U.S. citizenship required, with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting U.S. Government capture, defense business development, or government-contracting pipeline management.
  • Aviation, aerospace, defense, autonomy, uncrewed systems, tactical aviation, mission systems, AI-enabled capability, or advanced-manufacturing experience.
  • Familiarity with DoD or U.S. Government acquisition processes, budget cycles, requirements development, solicitations, and program-of-record pathways.
  • Experience developing or improving Salesforce reports, dashboards, opportunity-management processes, data governance, workflow automation, or CRM reporting.
  • Experience supporting domestic and international defense pursuits, including Foreign Military Sales, Direct Commercial Sales, or allied defense-market development.

title: Logistic Coordinator
description:
As a Logistics Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring the efficient flow of products and information throughout the supply chain. This position is responsible for coordinating customer orders, managing inventory allocations, supporting shipping operations, resolving logistics issues, and ensuring on-time delivery of products. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a strong commitment to customer service and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and track supply chain activities through collaboration with internal teams, suppliers, customers, carriers, and distribution partners.
  • Review daily sales order queues and process orders according to customer requirements and requested ship dates.
  • Monitor future-dated orders and prioritize expedited and priority shipments.
  • Allocate inventory to customer orders and process complete orders for shipment.
  • Coordinate the release of credit-hold orders by working with the Credit Department and Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
  • Monitor customer payments, credit reports, and order hold statuses, communicating updates to shipping teams as needed.
  • Review past-due orders and coordinate with shipping, planning, and customer service teams to resolve fulfillment issues.
  • Investigate inventory shortages and coordinate stock allocations, repacks, and replenishment activities.
  • Review and verify order accuracy, product specifications, and supporting documentation prior to shipment.
  • Obtain, review, and validate test reports and quality documentation for customer orders.
  • Coordinate product labeling requirements and arrange for the creation of labels when necessary.
  • Prepare commercial invoices and export documentation for international shipments.
  • Liaise with internal teams to ensure compliance documentation, including export and regulatory paperwork, is provided accurately and on time.
  • Process and manage drop shipments, special orders, and manually allocated orders.
  • Track inventory availability using MRP systems and communicate estimated fulfillment timelines to stakeholders.
  • Assist warehouse and shipping teams in resolving order processing, inventory location, and shipment closure issues.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies, missing stock, and transaction history to support order fulfillment.
  • Prioritize and coordinate rush and rated orders to meet customer and contractual requirements.
  • Monitor and optimize shipping methods, costs, and delivery timelines using logistics systems and transportation tools.
  • Generate tracking information and provide shipment status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare logistics, inventory, shipment, and performance reports for management review.
  • Document shipment delays and maintain accurate records of order status and logistics performance.
  • Open and manage IT support tickets related to order processing and system issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve logistics processes, inventory management, and overall supply chain efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required; post-secondary education in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field is an asset.
  • Previous experience in logistics, supply chain, customer service, shipping, inventory control, order management, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience working with ERP, MRP, warehouse management systems, and transportation management systems.
  • Knowledge of export documentation and international shipping processes is an asset.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments.
  • Ability to sit, stand, and move throughout an office, warehouse, or manufacturing environment as needed.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and carry materials up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

What We Offer

Base salary range is between $60k and $70k/year.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon’s Air & Space Defense Systems (ASDS) strategic business unit (SBU) specializes in multi-domain integrated air and missile defense, advanced sensors, space-based systems, hypersonics, effectors and cyber solutions. Focused on program execution, business growth and the highest level of customer satisfaction, the ASDS team provides customers with unmatched capabilities of detection and sensing, command and control, and air-to-air, air-to-surface, and surface-to-air munitions to accomplish air, space and missile defense missions.


ASDS SBU Engineering Team is looking for a Deputy for the Upper Tier Missile Defense (UTMD) Radar Capability (RCap) IPT organization focusing on Domestic programs, capabilities development, and radar build configuration delivery for the AN/TPY-2 Radar. The AN/TPY-2 is the world’s most advanced mobile radar system. The TPY radar is a multi-functional X-band radar which may be deployed globally in either terminal or forward-based mode. Numerous TPY radar systems are currently deployed around the world and are an integral part of the U.S. Ballistic Missile Defense System (BMDS). As a member of our elite RCap team, we want you to develop solutions to protect Warfighter’s technology advantage.


The Deputy Integrated Product Team Lead (IPTL) for Domestic Programs will be responsible for the management and coordination of the technical execution, cost, and schedule for their applicable scope, across multiple teams covering Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Integration and Test. This includes task planning to create milestones and schedules and managing competing priorities across the TPY-2 portfolio. The successful candidate will be expected to build the team’s abilities and be able to work with both internal and external customers. They will also be expected to participate in proposal efforts in support of new business and have knowledge of financial status and planning for the team.


This position is 100% onsite in Woburn, MA.


What You Will Do

  • Act as the voice of the customer to assure customer satisfaction with respect to cost, schedule, product quality, delivery, and performance.
  • Support proposals and negotiations with the customer.
  • Support the Domestic Program Managers to identify key personnel, developing long-term plans and maintaining the product line business model.
  • Execute capability development, conduct Program status meetings, tracking and communicating program metrics.
  • Present status, Risk & Opportunity Management, and EAC data for RCap to program leadership.
  • Review program status including tracking and review by Program Leadership.
  • Frequent interaction with MDA customer’s technical leadership, as well as regular customer briefings at management reviews and Program Management Reviews.
  • Domestic travel will be required (~10%).

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations.
  • Experience in Program Management and/or IPT execution within the Defense Industry.
  • Experience as customer interface in the Defense Industry.
  • Experience with technical and financial data and reporting.
  • Experience with Earned Value Management System (EVMS), Integrated Master Plan (IMP) / Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), and/or Risk and Opportunity Management.
  • Active and transferable U.S. government issued Secret security clearance is required prior to start date. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience with AN/TPY-2 or similar radar systems.
  • Direct experience managing resources with annual budgets exceeding $30 million.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with senior levels of leadership effectively – including customer, teammates, and suppliers.
  • Established relationship with Missile Defense Agency customer.
  • Prior experience with Department of Defense Radar Design and Development Programs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work across business areas, manage tasks, requirements and commitments and interface successfully with numerous disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience as a change agent, able to energize organizations to achieve beyond expectations.
  • Champion all of RTX’s values while managing multiple and competing priorities.

What We Offer

  • Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
  • Relocation Eligible.

title: Java SQL Application Development - Vice President
description:
The Application Development Tech Lead is a senior, hands-on technical leadership position responsible for architecting and building core platforms. As a hands-on technical leader for one or more Scrum teams, you will serve as a key voice in our architecture, driving innovation and ensuring our engineering practices meet the highest standards of quality and efficiency. This role is ideal for a "player-coach" who thrives on influencing system design, mentoring engineers, and contributing directly to the codebase.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Personnel Management: Manage one or more Application Development teams to accomplish established goals, while handling core personnel duties.
  • Technical Oversight: Utilize in-depth knowledge and skills across multiple Application Development domains to provide technical oversight of systems and applications.
  • Solution Architecture: Review and analyze proposed technical solutions across ongoing and upcoming projects.
  • Strategic Contribution: Contribute to the formulation of technical and architectural strategies for Application Development and related functional areas.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Develop a comprehensive understanding of how various business areas integrate to achieve organizational goals.
  • Decision-Making: Provide evaluative judgment based on the analysis of factual data in complex, ambiguous, or unique situations.
  • Delivery & Work Allocation: Drive impact across Application Development by monitoring end-to-end delivery and managing day-to-day operations, including resource planning and work allocation within the team/project.
  • Standards & Governance: Ensure essential procedures and governance policies are followed, contribute to defining engineering standards, and negotiate with external parties when necessary.
  • Innovation & Tooling: Actively explore and integrate modern AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, advanced code analyzers) to accelerate delivery velocity, elevate code quality, and foster a culture of engineering innovation.

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience: 12+ years of hands on experience in software design and development, with deep expertise in Java technologies. Proven track record in developing and optimizing multithreaded, high-throughput applications.
  • Database Expertise: In-depth experience with SQL Server, including database design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Frontend Knowledge: Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) is a significant plus.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Hands-on experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern infrastructure tooling.
  • Architecture & Integration: Strong knowledge of system integration principles and practical experience implementing modern integration patterns (e.g., RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging queues).
  • Problem-Solving: Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to execute effectively in fast-paced environments.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, conduct code reviews, and mentor engineers.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent university degree/experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Master’s degree preferred

title: SAP Basis & BTP Administrator
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Your role

The role will provide end-to-end technical coverage for SAP platforms, including system administration, installations/upgrades, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, transport/change management, scheduling, cloud infrastructure, and operational automation.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in SAP Basis and a good understanding of modern SAP cloud technologies and enterprise scheduling/change-management tools.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer and support SAP landscapes including ECC, S/4HANA, HANA, DB2, and SAP Cloud environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and operational stability.

  • Perform SAP installations, upgrades, kernel patches, migrations, system copies, refreshes, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities.

  • Monitor and optimize SAP systems through health checks, performance tuning, incident resolution, user administration, job management, and system configuration.

  • Manage and support SAP HANA databases, including performance monitoring, troubleshooting, upgrades, patching, replication, backup, and recovery.

  • Provide technical support for SAP Cloud platforms (IaaS/PaaS), collaborating with infrastructure, security, network, and cloud teams on migrations, integrations, and connectivity issues.

  • Administer and support SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including account management, services, connectivity, integrations, monitoring, and platform issue resolution.

  • Support SAP Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, alerting, health checks, reporting, lifecycle management, and change governance.

  • Manage SAP transport and enterprise scheduling processes using Rev-Trac, IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS), V-TOM, and Redwood, ensuring controlled deployments, job automation, and issue resolution.

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Experience & Technical Skills

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Basis Administration across enterprise SAP landscapes.

  • Strong experience supporting SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and DB2-based SAP environments.

  • Expertise in SAP system monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, incident management, and operational support.

  • Experience with SAP installations, upgrades, patching, kernel upgrades, system copies, refreshes, and migrations.

  • Knowledge of SAP high availability, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes.

  • Experience supporting SAP workloads on cloud (IaaS/PaaS) environments, including cloud connectivity and integrations.

  • Working knowledge of SAP BTP, SAP Solution Manager, and SAP Cloud ALM.

  • Experience with SAP transport and change management, including Rev-Trac or equivalent tools.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise scheduling tools such as IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS), V-TOM, and Redwood.

  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure components including compute, storage, networking, security, and availability.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including SAP, infrastructure, database, cloud, security, and application teams.

  • Capable of managing production-critical environments and resolving high-priority incidents under pressure.

  • Strong documentation, knowledge-sharing, and process improvement skills.

  • Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently while collaborating with global teams.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


What You Will Do:

  • Support the design, development, and maintenance of flight-critical embedded software for commercial aviation solutions and avionics products.
  • Provide technical leadership to assigned cross-functional engineering project team responsible for the design, development, and verification of real-time embedded software.
  • Support project team activities related to the specification of requirements, software implementation, test case development, verification test execution, and certification support.
  • Develop, coordinate, and conduct complex tests and debugs systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.
  • Conduct multidisciplinary research and collaborate with systems and hardware architects in the planning, design, development, and utilization of embedded processing systems.
  • Mentor software developers in technical and process-related areas.
  • Develop solutions that satisfy numerous avionics industry standards, such as POSIX, ARINC-615A (data load), ARINC-653 (application interface), ARINC-661 (display interface), IEEE 803.2 (ethernet), and ARINC-664 (AFDX).
  • Travel up to 10% as needed.

What You Will Learn:

  • You will deepen your understanding of aircraft systems engineering, gaining insights into integration and development processes.
  • You will gain exposure to Avionics regulatory and certification requirements and processes.
  • You will expand your professional network, working alongside industry experts and global teams.
  • You will learn why people enjoy and feel fulfilled by working in our industry.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years of experience.
  • Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle.
  • C / C++ programming experience.
  • Proficiency with modern software development best practices and configuration management tools.

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Experience with DO-178B/C (DAL A or B preferred)
  • Experience with real-time operating systems (VxWorks or LinxOS)
  • Experience with designing architectures
  • Expertise leading a low-level software development and verification tasks
  • Effective communicator, excellent interpersonal skills, and ability to work with various teams.
  • Energetic and proactive self-starter that builds sound, collaborative relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify complex problems, evaluate options, and develop solutions.

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
  • Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
  • Tuition reimbursement program
  • Student Loan Repayment Program

  • Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
  • Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
  • Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
  • Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
  • Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
  • And more!

This role may be eligible for relocation.


Learn More & Apply Now!


Collins Aerospace makes modern flight possible. Of course, that wouldn’t be possible without the capabilities and technologies of our organization, as well as our engineers – a highly skilled, accomplished network that spans more than 180 sites, 24 countries and 6 Strategic Business Units (SBUs).


Our industry-leading experts are setting the standards for the aerospace industry and paving the way for the future. But as new challenges present themselves, we need fresh, creative and motivated minds to overcome these hurdles, help us break barriers and achieve new levels of innovation. Do you have what it takes to join a global organization that doesn’t shy away from big opportunities? Together, we will nurture an engineering culture that values intellectual curiosity, risk takers and integrity. A place where we will challenge ourselves, our teams, and the status quo and where we will work to find a way – the right way – to achieve what others can only dream of.

Nevada State University, a four-year Minority Serving public institution with a statewide mission, is dedicated to excellence in teaching and learning and committed to the advancement of a diverse and largely underserved student population. Designated a Hispanic Serving (HSI) and Asian American Native American Pacific Islander Institution (AANAPI), Nevada State is a university where teaching and student support are valued above all else.

Nevada State University continues to grow as an institution of higher education. In Fall 2025, the enrollment surpassed 8,400, with 8,287 undergraduate students and 117 graduate students. A majority of our students are first generation, racial/ethnic minorities, parents, and/or returning students, of which 48% are Hispanic, 10% are Asian/Pacific Islander, 10% are Black/African American, and 22% are White.

We celebrate the storied backgrounds of our campus community. We operate with a shared commitment to represent and serve the diverse population of Nevada and to encourage the exchange of ideas that respects and honors the lived experiences of our students, staff, and faculty. We foster a culture of inclusive excellence so our members can live authentically, fully engage, and flourish. In order to strengthen the university and progress its mission, the university dedicates itself to intentional and ongoing reflection to meeting the evolving needs of Nevada State University, the surrounding communities, and the State of Nevada.

We seek applicants who are passionate about working with this promising student population and collaborating with faculty and staff across departments to make a lasting impact in developing our institution and our community.

We encourage you to highlight your background in fostering an inclusive campus culture and supporting the success of students who are historically underrepresented in higher education.

Core Responsibilities:

Support presidential, public affairs and university communications efforts

  • Assist with drafting and editing campus communications, announcements, briefing materials and other written content.
  • Conduct research and gather information to support presidential remarks, talking points and communications.
  • Assist with communications related to university priorities, initiatives and issues affecting Nevada State and higher education.

Assist with public affairs, government relations and community engagement

  • Research higher education, government and public policy issues relevant to Nevada State University.
  • Assist with preparing background materials and briefings for meetings with community leaders, elected officials, government partners and other external stakeholders.
  • Help track legislative, governmental and community issues that may affect the university.
  • Support university efforts to strengthen relationships with community and public-sector partners.

Assist with digital communications and university storytelling

  • Help develop content highlighting university programs, events, students, faculty and staff.
  • Assist with content for university digital platforms, including web, email and social media.
  • Identify potential stories and gather information, quotes and other content from members of the campus community.

Support presidential, university and community events

  • Assist with planning and coordinating events involving the Office of the President.
  • Help prepare event materials, communications, guest information and logistical materials.
  • Provide on-site communications and event support as needed.

Assist with media relations and communications research

  • Help monitor media coverage and identify relevant news, public affairs and higher education trends.
  • Assist with maintaining media lists and organizing media-related materials.
  • Conduct background research to support press releases, media responses and other communications projects.

Provide special project and administrative support

  • Assist with special projects and initiatives coordinated through the Office of the President.
  • Participate in communications and public affairs planning meetings and regular check-ins.
  • Organize project materials and track assignments as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be in good academic standing and maintain a GPA of 2.0 or higher.
  • Must be enrolled as a degree seeking student with a minimum of 6 credits in the current or upcoming semester at Nevada State.
  • Eligibility to work in the United States without sponsorship (Nevada State does not sponsor employment-related visas).

Please note: Applicants must meet the posted minimum qualifications at the time of application in order to be considered for the position.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Students who are majoring in Communication, Visual Media, History, History - Pre-Law, Interdisciplinary Studies, Business and Criminal Justice.
  • Students pursuing a related minor, such as Communication, Creative Writing, Visual Media or Business, are also encouraged to apply.
  • Coursework or experience in public speaking, professional writing, journalism, digital media, research methods, government, public policy, marketing, graphic design or multimedia production would benefit a student in this role.
  • Strong writing, editing, research and verbal communication skills, along with attention to detail, organization and an interest in public affairs, government, media, higher education or community engagement.
  • Experience with student government, a student publication, social media, event planning, community service or a government or nonprofit organization would also be valuable.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Canva, social media platforms, photography, video production or content management systems.

Work Hours:

This position will work 10-15 hours per week with a flexible schedule Monday through Friday during regular university business hours. The specific schedule will be coordinated with the selected student based on their class schedule and the department’s needs. Occasional attendance at university events outside the intern’s regular schedule may be requested with advance notice. Student employees can work up to 19.5 hours per week.

title: Field Claim Representative
description:
Field Claims Representative

Who We Are
Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com

The Role

  • Conduct and manage on-site insurance property claim inventory assignments pursuant to SOS field inventory processes.
  • Complete all tasks assigned in a diligent manner consistent with department, facility or operational and corporate goals and objectives.
  • Assist in business development activities in conjunction with new and existing service offerings.
  • Promote, build, and maintain good customer relations with adjusters assist in retention and repeat use.
  • Communicate with your Field Manager and Service Manager on a daily basis with regards to operational issues and/or improvements.
  • Follow all standard operating and safety procedures, written and oral, at all times.
  • Ability and willingness to take on additional responsibilities as assigned.

  • Present in a professional manner both in personal and vehicle appearance.
  • Ability to work in adverse conditions (post loss insurance claims).
  • Perform work assignments in a safe and concise manner, following all Enservio safety standards.
  • You will coordinate with our Scheduling team on scheduled and receiving assignments.
  • You will meet with insured, their POC, the adjuster, public adjuster, and/or restoration company onsite.
  • You conduct a walkthrough and a brief interview of the insured while taking overall photos of each room in the home/business.
  • You will work independently capturing a complete inventory of the total loss contents throughout the home/business.
  • You will be responsible for completing reports and administrative duties within 24 hours of completion of the inventory capture.

Job Description

Great Basin College (GBC) is recruiting for a full-time faculty to teach courses in Industrial Maintenance (Millwright/Fixed Maintenance). This position is based at the Elko campus.


The successful candidate will teach a variety of courses focusing on pumps, power transmissions, rigging, blueprint reading, shaft alignment, and other aspects of fixed maintenance and repair. The successful candidate will develop and revise curriculum to keep classes current with industry standards.


Under the supervision of the Dean, faculty teach course content; assess student learning; stay current in their teaching field; actively refer students to supportive college resources; complete professional development; use current technology; and maintain appropriate standards of ethics and professional conduct.


Qualifications

  • Associate degree from a regionally accredited institution in Millwright Technology or related field. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of an Associate degree.
  • Five (5) years of experience in mining-related fixed equipment repair & maintenance is required.
  • Experience in career and technical education strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work as a team member with a genuine spirit of cooperation and flexibility.
  • Computer literate in Microsoft Office products.
  • Experience in alternative educational delivery methods or willingness to learn alternative delivery methodology.
  • Evidence of ability to communicate effectively in writing and orally.
  • Prefer post-secondary teaching experience.
  • Willingness and ability to travel by car throughout the large GBC service area as needed to campus and industry locations, with or without accommodations as per the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and teach classes in all aspects of Millwright Technology.
  • Supervise students in classroom and laboratory settings.
  • Direct and assess students’ progress in achieving required competencies.
  • Interact with mining and industry partners to enhance community partnerships.
  • May teach evening and distance education classes.
  • Handle administrative responsibilities related to teaching and program support.
  • Represent the college professionally

Academic Faculty – 1

This is a 12 month "A" contract position, 12 month contracts are used for year round programs.


The budgeted salary range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000

Salary is based on relatable education and experience, internal equity and budgets.

Our retirement plan is beyond compare. Your 19.25% contribution is generously matched by the University. With the faculty retirement plan, you are 100% vested your first day. Sit back and watch your retirement dollars grow! All permanent employees on an annual "A" or "B" contract who are employed at least 50% full-time are eligible to participate in the NSHE retirement program unless they are members of PERS of Nevada.

  • 12 paid holidays
  • Life insurance, long-term disability
  • Generous annual and sick leave with 24 annual leave days, a beginning balance of 30 sick leave days.
  • ComPsych supports employees through life's difficult moments.

Dependents of faculty have unlimited credits, but in order to be eligible children must be unmarried and under the age of 24 and must receive at least 50% of their financial support from the employee and/or employee’s spouse or domestic partner.

If you are using education completed in foreign colleges or universities to meet qualification requirements, you must show that your education credentials have been evaluated by a private organization that specializes in interpretation of foreign education programs and such education has been deemed equivalent to that gained in an accredited U.S. education program; or full credit has been given for the courses at a U.S. accredited college or university. About Great Basin College

Located in the high desert of rural Nevada, Great Basin College is a Carnegie classified baccalaureate and associates degree granting institution embracing a comprehensive hybrid mission to deliver a full four-year liberal arts and sciences, community college and applied technical learning curricula. With its main campus in Elko, a beautiful site with residential housing and state-of-the-art learning technologies, GBC serves the largest geographic area of Nevada’s colleges. Great Basin College serves the citizens residing in ten of Nevada’s most rural counties, covering 86,514 square miles and bordering five states. This service area includes centers in Battle Mountain, Ely, Pahrump and Winnemucca. Additionally, satellite locations can be found in twenty other frontier communities.

Our vast geography is known for its spectacular mountain ranges and picturesque valleys, providing a myriad of outdoor recreational opportunities. In addition, Elko is home to several well-known western museums and the world renown, National Cowboy Poetry Gathering, begun 35 years ago to honor and share the traditions of Western storytelling, nurturing the expressive culture of the American West.

GBC provides a “private college” experience with public college affordable access to postsecondary education in an environment that embraces and respects all cultures. It stands among the most innovative colleges in America, integrating many disciplines into single courses and programs, helping students to develop critical thinking and self-directed learning skills. Graduates of Great Basin College are fully prepared to enter their chosen careers with the knowledge and confidence to succeed in the global marketplace.

For more information visit GBC or the Area website.

description:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

37.5

Technology Solutions

$81,600 - $115,200 CAD

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance.

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description:

Department Overview

Our Credit Platform line of business is responsible for delivering innovative, scalable, and customer-focused lending solutions that support the end-to-end credit lifecycle across TD. Our teams partner closely with Product Owners, Technology, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Operations, Risk, and Compliance to enable secure, efficient, and compliant credit origination and funding experiences for customers and colleagues.

As a valued member of our team, you will help shape strategic lending capabilities, drive business and technology transformation, and contribute to products that have enterprise-wide impact. You will work alongside cross-functional Agile PODs to ensure business objectives are translated into high-quality solutions that deliver measurable value.


Job Accountabilities - What You'll Do

As a Senior Business Systems Analyst, you will be a key member of an Agile Product Delivery team, serving as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams. You will lead requirements analysis, solution definition, backlog readiness, dependency management, and delivery support activities to ensure successful outcomes across the product lifecycle. This role aligns with the BSA POD responsibilities covering intake, analysis, documentation, backlog management, delivery support, governance, and stakeholder collaboration.

Drive Business & Solution Analysis

  • Lead discovery sessions to understand business objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and operational challenges.
  • Perform end-to-end impact assessments and identify impacted systems, integrations, data flows, and external dependencies.
  • Define functional requirements, business rules, process flows, API interactions, and solution scope.
  • Document clear in-scope and out-of-scope requirements to support successful delivery.

Shape Product Backlogs & Drive Delivery Readiness

  • Partner with Product Owners to decompose initiatives and features into epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Create and maintain stories using BDD/Gherkin standards and ensure requirements are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Facilitate backlog refinement sessions and support story estimation activities.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability between business objectives, requirements, stories, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.

Enable Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, and Quality Engineers throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Provide ongoing requirement clarification during sprint execution and support defect triage, solution validation, and scope management.
  • Ensure stories meet Definition of Ready criteria before sprint commitment and support Definition of Done validation before closure.

Manage Dependencies & Stakeholder Relationships

  • Act as a key point of contact for business and technology stakeholders.
  • Identify, track, and manage cross-team dependencies, risks, assumptions, and integration impacts.
  • Facilitate collaboration across Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
  • Escalate delivery risks and issues proactively to support informed decision-making.

Support Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure documentation, Jira artifacts, and governance records remain accurate and current.
  • Maintain risk, dependency, and issue tracking artifacts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery practices, requirements quality, documentation standards, and team collaboration.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance predictability, quality, and customer outcomes.

Where You'll Work

You’ll be expected to work Primarily onsite at a TD location for meetings, team events and experiences. The hiring manager will provide more information about how this works for their team.

Job Requirements - What You Need to Succeed

We're proud to work with a diverse team of colleagues. If you have relevant experience that isn't specifically listed below, we'd still like to hear from you.

Required

  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of Business Systems Analysis experience within Banking, Financial Services, or related industries.
  • Strong experience performing business system analysis, impact assessments, process analysis, and requirements documentation.
  • Experience analyzing application codebases to understand system functionality, identify dependencies, and define technical requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and business/system requirements.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments supporting backlog refinement, sprint planning, and iterative delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional dependencies and supporting end-to-end delivery across multiple teams.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, API integration analysis, system interfaces, and requirements traceability.

Preferred

  • Experience in Lending, Funding, or related banking platforms.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot to accelerate code analysis, requirement gathering, impact assessments, and documentation.
  • Knowledge of API-driven architectures, system integrations, and digital platform modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of Mainframe capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Quality Engineering, Architecture, and Product Management teams.
  • Familiarity with regulatory, risk, compliance, and governance requirements within financial services.
  • Agile, Scrum, or SAFe certifications.

Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to work on strategically important lending and funding initiatives that impact millions of customers and colleagues. This role offers exposure to enterprise-scale products, modern technology platforms, cross-functional Agile teams, and transformational programs that are shaping the future of lending at TD.

Who We Are:

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.


Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.


Accommodation
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

location: New York New York United States
description:
We are seeking a highly accomplished Java engineer to join our Realtime Risk Data team. This role is at the forefront of architecting, leading, and significantly enhancing our comprehensive real-time risk data acquisition, processing, and distribution framework. You will serve as a technical thought leader, driving the strategic adoption and implementation of cutting-edge streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka for high-throughput data ingestion, Apache Flink for complex event processing and real-time analytics, and Apache Pinot for ultra-low-latency OLAP queries on large datasets.


You will also oversee the management of petabyte-scale datasets on S3, enabling efficient querying via Trino. This role demands deep technical expertise, a strategic mindset, and the ability to mentor and guide engineering teams in designing, developing, and optimizing mission-critical, high-performance real-time data solutions that directly impact global financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architectural Leadership: Serve as the principal architect for scalable, high-performance Java-based real-time data solutions, ensuring robust design for high availability, fault tolerance, and resilience for both real-time and EOD risk processes.
  • Strategic Implementation: Drive the strategic implementation and optimization of distributed stream processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Apache Flink) and real-time data storage technologies (Apache Pinot) for ultra-low-latency analytics and complex event processing.
  • Data Pipeline Mastery: Lead the end-to-end design, development, and operation of real-time streaming data pipelines, integrating with large-scale object storage solutions like S3 and analytics engines such as Trino.
  • Technical Excellence & Mentorship: Champion continuous improvement in data reliability, efficiency, and scalability. Establish and enforce best practices for code quality, performance optimization, and system resilience through hands-on leadership and thorough peer code reviews. Mentor and technically guide senior and lead developers.
  • SDLC Ownership: Drive significant contributions across all phases of the Agile software development lifecycle, from architectural vision and detailed design to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support for critical real-time data systems.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate strategically with business analysts, product managers, quality assurance teams, and other engineering leads to ensure the delivery of seamlessly integrated, high-impact technology solutions that align with business objectives and architectural standards.
  • Innovation & Research: Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies in real time data processing, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures, evaluating and proposing their adoption were beneficial.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Senior Data Engineering Expertise: 6+ years of progressive experience in data engineering and software development, with a significant focus on building high-performance, large scale distributed systems.
  • Java Mastery: Expert-level command of Java (version 11 or higher) with a deep understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, advanced OOP concepts, design patterns, and performance tuning.
  • Real-time Streaming Core: Proven, hands-on production experience and deep architectural understanding of:
  • Apache Kafka or related technologies: For high-throughput, fault-tolerant message queuing and streaming.
  • Apache Flink or related technologies: For advanced real-time stream processing, complex event processing (CEP), and stateful computations.
  • Apache Pinot or related technologies: For ultra-low-latency OLAP queries on streaming data.
  • Distributed Systems Architecture: Strong expertise in designing and implementing highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems.
  • Data Storage & Querying: Extensive experience with large-scale data storage solutions (e.g., S3, HDFS) and distributed query engines (e.g., Trino/Presto, Spark SQL).
  • SQL Proficiency: Advanced SQL knowledge with experience in optimizing complex queries for large datasets. Agile Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives and teams within an Agile software development environment.
  • Communication & Problem Solving: Exceptional communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and drive consensus on architectural decisions.


Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Cloud-Native Data Ecosystems: Experience with cloud-native data services on platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly related to streaming and real-time analytics.
  • Container Orchestration: Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and OpenShift for deploying and managing real-time data applications.
  • API Development: Experience in designing and implementing high-performance RESTful APIs and event-driven microservices architectures.
  • Performance Engineering: Deep understanding and experience with performance tuning, profiling, and optimization of real-time streaming applications and data stores.
  • Financial Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial derivatives, fixed income products, and risk management concepts from a technical data perspective.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentoring: A proven track record of mentoring junior to senior engineers, fostering technical growth, and building high-performing engineering teams.
  • Data Governance & Security: Experience with data governance, data quality, and security best practices in real-time data environments. Global Team Experience: Experience working effectively within a geographically distributed, global development team.


Qualification / Education

  • Advanced Degree: Strong academic record, ideally with a Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical/quantitative discipline.
