title: Product Development Associate
description:
PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE
Madhappy is a Los Angeles-based clothing brand made for a community of optimists, born in 2017. Madhappy uses apparel, events, and experimental retail spaces – including its permanent flagship in West Hollywood – to explore a personal expression as a means to an improved state of mind. Its own seasonal stores – with past and present locations including New York City (Soho), Aspen, Miami, East Hampton, and Tokyo – are each designed to reflect their site, while still sharing the brand’s DNA. The brand currently produces a selection of ever-evolving, evergreen classic styles, seasonally available collections and collaborations. Madhappy supports research and awareness in mental health through The Madhappy Foundation (a 501c(3) non-profit) and writes Local Optimist, a print magazine. Each to celebrate us as works-in-progress, and the personal and collective expression that is a part of that.
About the job
We are looking to hire a full time Product Development Associate for Madhappy.
In this position, In this role, you will support the product development process from concept to production, ensuring high-quality, trend-driven apparel that aligns with our brand standards. Reporting directly to the PD & Production Manager, you will play a key role in coordinating between design, vendors, and production teams to bring designs to life efficiently and effectively.
You must be based in or willing to move to Los Angeles to be considered for this position.
Responsibilities
● Collaborate with the design team to interpret seasonal concepts and develop innovative, market-ready products.
● Source and evaluate fabrics, trims, and other materials to ensure alignment with quality and design standards.
● Prepare and maintain detailed tech packs, including measurements, construction details, and material specifications.
● Communicate with suppliers and manufacturers to review samples, resolve issues, and ensure production timelines are met.
● Oversee the creation and review of prototypes and samples, ensuring consistency with design intent and quality requirements.
● Assist in cost analysis and negotiations to ensure development aligns with budget parameters.
● Partner with the quality assurance team to ensure that all garments meet established standards for fit, quality, and durability.
● Track production schedules and follow up with vendors to ensure on-time delivery.
● Stay informed on industry trends, competitor products, and new developments in materials and construction techniques.
● Maintain organized records of product development processes and prepare reports as required.
About you
Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Textiles, Product Development, or a related field.
● 1-3 years of experience in product development or a related role within the apparel industry.
● Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and design-related software; experience with PLM systems is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of fabrics, trims, and garment construction methods.
● Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
Characteristics
● Be a great task grasper but an even greater strategist being able to find gaps and how to fill them.
● Seek and create steps needed to execute goals.
● Have a critical mind and eye to flag potential issues.
● Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Problem-solving mindset with the ability to address production challenges quickly and effectively.
● Passion for fashion and a deep understanding of current and emerging trends in the industry.
● Passion for the brand and mental health, a plus.
Benefits
● 15 days PTO, and 9 days sick pay annually
● Paid holidays
● Health, dental, and vision insurance with 75% premium coverage by Madhappy
● Retirement plans available
● $600 quarterly health stipends
● Employee discount and early access to products
About Madhappy
Madhappy is a clothing brand for a community of optimists. Born in Los Angeles, 2017, the brand has built itself around an optimistic ideology, expressed through apparel, events, and experimental retail spaces around the world. Madhappy writes Local Optimist magazine, supports research and awareness in mental health through Madhappy Foundation.

About Local Optimist
Local Optimist is a space for radical discovery and connection. By focusing on open conversations and mindful exploration, we orient people with reliable, optimistic resources — available at any moment.

About The Madhappy Foundation
The Madhappy Foundation™ is non-profit organization, 501(c)(3) with a mission to improve mental health globally. Through The Madhappy Foundation™, 1% of proceeds from every sale benefit our efforts to raise awareness, fund research, and positively impact the mental health movement.

Wist je dat maar liefst een derde van alle Greetz-medewerkers werkzaam is binnen onze bruisende en innovatieve productieomgeving? Als onderdeel van ons team van Technische Operators, Warehouse Operators en Logistieke Operators werk je mee aan een bijzonder doel: het op tijd bezorgen van persoonlijke kaarten en verrassende cadeaus, zeven dagen per week.

Over Greetz

Wist je dat een derde van alle collega’s bij Greetz actief is in onze levendige en moderne productieomgeving? Hier werkt een team van zo’n 50 vaste medewerkers met passie en precisie aan één gezamenlijk doel: het op tijd leveren van gepersonaliseerde kaarten en verrassende cadeaus. Als Technisch Operator, Warehouse Operator of Productie Medewerker maak je deel uit van het kloppende hart van onze organisatie – waar we elke dag letterlijk een glimlach bezorgen.

Jouw werkdag als Productiemedewerker

Geen dag is hetzelfde in onze productiehal. Je werkt mee aan verschillende onderdelen van ons Productieproces, zoals:

Het zorgvuldig orderpicken van gifts;
Het samenvoegen van kaarten en cadeaus;
Het verpakken en verzendklaar maken van bestellingen;
Het personaliseren van producten zoals; Mokken, ballonnen en chocolade;
Het orderpicken en opblazen van ballonnen;

Waarom deze rol bij jou past

Greetz groeit en daarom zoeken we een gemotiveerde en nauwkeurige collega om ons team te versterken. Je krijgt bij ons de kans om allround opgeleid te worden, zodat je verschillende taken binnen het productieproces kunt uitvoeren.   • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring in een productieomgeving (bijvoorbeeld als orderpicker of inpakker);

  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar doordeweeks en in avonduren. Greetz werkt tot 00.30 uur;
  • Je bent woonachtig in (de omgeving van) Almere en kunt zelfstandig reizen;
  • Je werkt secuur, bent leergierig en draagt graag bij aan een positief teamgevoel.

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Een tijdelijke aanstelling binnen een informeel en hecht team;

The Role

Your role
As an AI Data Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll be the architect behind the high-performance data infrastructure that powers our autonomous systems. We aren't just moving tables; we’re building the real-time pipelines that allow agentic AI to reason over the world’s most complex enterprise environments.

Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next.

What you will do
Orchestrate Intelligence
•Architect for RAG: You’ll design and scale the pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), transforming massive volumes of unstructured IT logs and documentation into optimized Vector Embeddings.
•Scale vector infrastructure: You will be responsible for the health and performance of our vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate), ensuring sub-second retrieval speeds for agentic reasoning loops.

Master Data Transformation
•Engineer semantic layers: Move beyond simple ETL to build knowledge graphs and semantic layers that provide agents with the necessary context to navigate complex infrastructure puzzles.

title: Service TNL-PNC/Bend/Tube
description:
As a family-run, high-tech company with nearly 19,000 employees at 71 locations worldwide, we are looking for forward thinkers with unconventional ideas and drive to join our team. Our company culture, which values collaboration and mutual trust, creates the ideal framework for boldly trying new things and questioning the status quo. Our technologies inspire people to develop and produce things that are currently unimaginable. Whether lasers, machine tools, EUV or electronics - TRUMPF is building technological worlds for future generations. Are you ready for new challenges?

Hoe dapper ben jij?

Bij TRUMPF werk je aan innovatieve gereedschap machines en lasertechnologie. Met jouw technische kennis en frisse blik help je de maakindustrie vooruit. Als onafhankelijk familie bedrijf bieden we jou de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om je dappere ideeën in de praktijk te brengen! Met jou aan boord willen we graag vooruit in de digitale wereld van de maakindustrie. Onze passie en creatieve drive zorgen ervoor dat we een innovatieve kracht zijn op meer dan 70 TRUMPF locaties wereldwijd.

Jouw rol
Je houdt van het werk als Service Engineer, maar zoekt vooral uitdaging en afwisseling. Bij TRUMPF zit je dan goed. Voor het installeren, onderhouden en repareren van CNC-gestuurde machines zoeken we iemand met technische kennis, probleemoplossend vermogen en creativiteit. Als Service Engineer binnen het Pons-, Combi-, Bend- en Tube-team werk je aan uiteenlopende TRUMPF-machines voor plaat- en buisverwerking. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen het zelfstandig in bedrijf nemen van een afzonderlijke machine en het installeren van een complete, geautomatiseerde productielijn. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden, repareren en installeren van CNC-gestuurde ponsmachines, pons-lasercombinaties, kantbanken en buislasers bij klanten door heel Nederland. De klanten variëren van kleine bedrijven met enkele machines tot multinationals met meerdere volledig geautomatiseerde systemen. Het werk is interessant en uitdagend, met veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je werkzaamheden vinden plaats bij klanten door heel Nederland. Je huisadres geldt daarbij als standplaats. Via een digitale workflow ontvang je jouw inzetten en opdrachten. Uiteraard heb je dagelijks contact met collega’s om de werkzaamheden af te stemmen. Bij meerdaagse opdrachten kan een hotelovernachting gewenst zijn.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bedrijfscultuur die openstaat voor nieuwe ideeën en oplossingen.
  • Een auto van de zaak, laptop en telefoon.
  • 40 vakantiedagen.
  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling.
  • Een marktconform salaris tussen de € 3.500,= - € 5.000,= afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

Jouw profiel

  • Je beschikt over een afgerond MBO (4)-diploma

(mechatronica /elektrotechniek).

  • Een pro-actieve, representatieve en klantgerichte houding.
  • Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Duits in niet vereist maar wel een pré.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare affiniteit met digitalisering.
  • Je bent een ondernemend type en gewend om zelfstandig te werken.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs.

Enthousiast geworden over deze uitdaging? Dan kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie ! Om een goede match met de vacature te kunnen maken, vragen wij je om ons je CV en motivatiebrief te sturen. Deze kun je mailen naar hrm@nl.trumpf.com. Als je vragen hebt over de vacature of TRUMPF in het algemeen, neem dan contact op met HR tel.: 088-4002400.

  • Responds immediately to emergency and crisis situations; physically intervenes in accordance with training to situations that have a potential for injury.
  • Investigates incidents that occur on Advocate Health property and completes timely and accurate reports. Addresses and escalates complaints to the appropriate leader and provides supporting documentation.
  • Performs liaison rounding duties to cultivate close partnerships with all departments and units. Delivers security awareness education to team members to leverage their assistance in the overall security of the site.
  • Liaisons with federal, state, and local law enforcement and first responder agencies. Coordinates, briefs, and monitors every law enforcement prisoner patient guard to ensure policy compliance and prevent unsafe practices.
  • Maintains current Department training standards in radio communications, verbal de-escalation, hemorrhage control (e.g. “STOP the BLEED”), CPR, application of clinical restraints, conducted energy weapon (e.g. TASER), to include training on any/all department-issued equipment and/or requirements identified in training academy and the Annual Training Plan.
  • Assists with exterior traffic and crowd control, including parking enforcement, valet parking assist, and vehicular assistance.

Licensure, Registration, and/or Certification Required:

  • Security Officer Healthcare Certification (CHSO) issued by the International Association for Healthcare Security and Safety (IAHSS) must be obtained on a one-time basis within two years of appointment to this role. Recertification is not required.
  • For North Carolina teammates, an Unarmed Guard License issued by NC Protective Services must be obtained within 1 year and maintained through training and competency assessments.
  • Stop the Bleed Certification must be obtained within 1 year of hire date.
  • A valid driver’s license issued by the Division of Motor Vehicle.
  • Firearm Owners Identification (FOID) Card issued by the Illinois State Police or Concealed Carry Weapon (CCW) license issued by the Department of Justice (DOJ).
  • Certified in Conducted Energy Weapon (e.g. TASER) use within 90 days of hire and periodically thereafter.

Education Required:

  • High school graduate or GED

Experience Required:

  • Typically requires 1 years of experience in a security, related public safety, or customer service area that includes experiences in responding to emergent situations and identifying and resolving issues that pose a potential risk to patients, visitors, teammates and/or property.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required:

  • An above average level of emotional intelligence, including empathetic and compassionate responses to teammate, visitor, and patient incidents.
  • The ability to function in a work environment in which we maximize teammate talent, treat each other with respect, and care for one another like family and with kindness.
  • A daily commitment to patient-centered safety practices.
  • Collaborative work with medical staff and external law enforcement, as appropriate.
  • The ability to remain calm under pressure to support a safe, welcoming, and therapeutic environment for everyone in the facility.
  • The ability to interact with peers with positive intent and create innovative solutions through collaborative relationships.
  • Must successfully pass background investigation, drug screen, pre-placement physical post-offer, pre-employment and periodically thereafter.
  • Illinois team members must have completed State of Illinois 20-hour Basic Security Officer course.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise mature judgment and sound reasoning while maintaining a courteous and tactful demeanor in dealings with teammates, visitors, and patients, even if they are verbally aggressive persons.
  • Demonstrated experience in quickly assessing dangerous situations and taking appropriate action.
  • Demonstrated ability in verbal and written communications.
  • Ability to use a computer to document work (e.g. Microsoft Word, Excel, navigating a web page, and database entry).
  • Ability to defend self-and/or others in case of physical confrontations when de-escalation efforts fail and there is cause to physically restrain a person against their will who is non-compliant and committing a criminal act or lacks capacity and is attempting to elope.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with people; ability to hear radio and telephone communications at both high and low decibels.
  • Ability to communicate via radio and telephone with clear diction without impediments.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Must sit, stand, walk, and drive throughout the workday and must lift up to 35 lbs. occasionally. Must be able to push/pull with 35 lbs. of force.
  • Have 20/20 vision in both eyes or correctable to 20/20 with corrective lenses in both eyes.
  • May be exposed to mechanical, electrical, chemical, explosive, and radiation hazards. Protective clothing must be worn as necessary.
  • Operates all equipment necessary to perform the job.
  • Frequent exposure to aggressive behavior and emotionally charged situations.
  • Must be able to handle personal stress and possible violence.
  • Must be physically fit and able to walk all areas of the facilities and grounds, to restrain those who need restraint and be able to assist clinical teammates with lifting patients of all sizes.

Preferred Job Requirements

  • Behavioral Threat Assessment knowledge
  • Use of Force Review
  • Crime through environmental design awareness
  • Ability to present material and facilitate meetings

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

title: Engineering Lead Analyst – SonarQube & Code Quality Engineering - VP
description:
The Engineering Lead Analyst – SonarQube & Code Quality Engineering is a senior-level engineering role responsible for leading static code analysis, automated code quality governance, security vulnerability remediation, and AI-augmented developer enablement across enterprise software delivery pipelines.


In this role, you will champion software reliability, maintainability, clean-coding standards, and automated quality gates. You will partner with development teams, system architects, and platform engineering to integrate and manage enterprise-scale code quality platforms (such as SonarQube) both on-premises and in cloud/SaaS environments. Additionally, you will drive modern engineering practices by embedding Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) within your own software delivery and leveraging Agentic AI workers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architectures to optimize developer experience, streamline code governance, and boost engineering velocity.

Key Responsibilities


1. Code Quality & Static Analysis Platform Ownership

  • Lead the architecture, deployment, administration, and continuous enhancement of enterprise Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Code Quality platforms (e.g., SonarQube, DeepSource, Codacy, Semgrep).
  • Configure, calibrate, and enforce automated Quality Gates, code rulesets, technical debt calculation models, and code-coverage baselines across multi-language enterprise repositories.
  • Oversee version upgrades, patching, high availability, and operational maintenance for on-premises and SaaS/cloud-hosted code quality infrastructure.

2. CI/CD & Pipeline Integration

  • Embed automated code quality scanning and gating into modern CI/CD orchestration platforms (e.g., Tekton, Harness, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Standardize build-time and pull-request scanning workflows, ensuring seamless developer feedback loops, fast pipeline execution, and automated branch policy validation.
  • Containerize and maintain scanning tools and quality agents using Docker, Podman, and OpenShift/Kubernetes environments.

3. Automated BDD Testing & Robust Engineering Delivery

  • Leverage existing automated Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) testing frameworks (e.g., Cucumber, Behave) within own day-to-day software development lifecycle to ensure all platform features, integrations, and automation scripts promoted to production are of the highest quality.
  • Build reliability, robustness, and fault tolerance into all delivered engineering components, maintaining high test coverage and rigorous functional/regression verification prior to release.
  • Ensure automated test suites run seamlessly as mandatory validation gates within CI/CD pipelines before promotion to production environments.

4. Agentic AI & Model Context Protocol (MCP) Enablement

  • Architect, configure, and operationalize Agentic AI workers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool ecosystems to enhance developer productivity and modernize code review workflows.
  • Integrate AI-driven agents into development environments and CI/CD pipelines to assist engineers with automated quality triage, intelligent remediation suggestions, boilerplate generation, and static analysis interpretation.
  • Continuously evaluate and implement emerging AI tools and MCP servers that improve Developer Experience (DevEx), reduce manual toil, and accelerate engineering velocity across the firm.

5. Technical Governance, Security Remediation & Root Cause Analysis

  • Partner with Cyber Security, Architecture, and Application teams to triage, track, and remediate static code vulnerabilities, Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), and OWASP Top 10 risks.
  • Conduct deep-dive root cause analyses (RCA) on recurring defect patterns, code smells, architectural bottlenecks, and pipeline failures.
  • Provide subject matter expertise (SME) on clean coding standards, refactoring strategies, and design patterns across languages including Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go.

6. Leadership, Mentorship & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the technical authority on code quality, static analysis, and AI-enabled engineering practices for internal stakeholders and engineering leadership.
  • Advise, mentor, and upskill junior engineers and development teams on best practices for clean code, unit testing, BDD execution, and leveraging AI developer tools safely.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and Release Engineering to define quality roadmaps, KPIs, and engineering velocity metrics.

7. Risk, Compliance & Governance

  • Appropriately assess risk during technical decision-making, demonstrating strict consideration for the firm’s reputation and safeguarding Citi’s assets.
  • Ensure all quality tools, pipelines, AI agents, and processes adhere to Citi compliance policies, internal audit standards, information security guidelines, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications & Competencies


Experience & Technical Background

  • 13+ years of relevant experience in a Software Engineering, DevOps, or Code Quality Engineering role within a large-scale, complex, or global enterprise (Financial Services experience strongly preferred).
  • Static Analysis Platforms: Proven hands-on administration and engineering experience with SonarQube(Enterprise/Data Center edition preferred) and related static analysis/linter tooling (Semgrep, Codacy, DeepSource, Checkmarx, SonarLint).
  • Programming Proficiency: Strong development or scripting skills in one or more core languages: Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go.
  • CI/CD & DevOps: Deep working knowledge of CI/CD pipeline automation tools such as Jenkins, Harness, Tekton, or GitHub Actions.
  • Containers & Cloud: Practical experience with container technologies (Docker, Podman, OpenShift, or Kubernetes).
  • BDD & Automated Testing: Proven experience leveraging existing BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Behave) and unit/functional test suites (JUnit, PyTest, Playwright, Cypress) within personal software development workflows to deliver production-grade, highly reliable code.
  • Agentic AI & Tooling: Familiarity or hands-on experience with Agentic AI architectures, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration, LLM-based coding assistants, or AI-augmented developer tooling.
  • Cybersecurity & Compliance: Demonstrated experience in vulnerability management, static security scanning, and automated gating for security compliance.

Soft Skills & Leadership Capabilities

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and diagnostic problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  • Proven track record of driving operational process improvements and reducing technical debt.
  • Ability to thrive in a global matrixed organization, managing tight deadlines and competing priorities independently.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree / University Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Master’s Degree in a related technical discipline is preferred.

description:
Bring more to life.


At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact, innovating at the speed of life.


Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.

DHR Enterprise AI Solutions is Danaher's enterprise AI engineering capability, responsible for identifying opportunities, building and scaling reusable AI solutions, and accelerating measurable business impact across operating companies. We combine product, architecture, AI science, engineering and operations to industrialise AI, establish enterprise standards and enable the next generation of AI-powered products, workflows, applications and decision-making.


We look forward to welcoming you to our organisation. In DHR Enterprise AI Solutions, you will be responsible for transforming Danaher's AI strategy into scalable, production-grade capabilities by leading the engineering, integration and operational teams that build, industrialise, operate and support enterprise AI solutions across our global operating companies.


Reporting directly to the Senior Director of DHR Enterprise AI Solutions, you will lead the AI Engineering, Integration & Operations organisation and play a critical role in converting innovative ideas, prototypes and reusable capabilities into resilient, secure and adopted solutions that generate measurable business value at enterprise scale.


This is a Danaher Corporate role, hosted by our Cytiva operating company in Kraków, and will be an on-site role (Kraków).


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


  • Build, scale, operate and continuously enhance reusable DS / ML / AI solutions, services, products and accelerators that enable Danaher to adopt AI faster and with less effort, creating sustainable business impact.
  • Evolve the strategy and operating model and foster best engineering practices to enable DHR Enterprise AI Solutions and Danaher to rapidly move from experimentation and prototypes to scalable, governed, supportable and production-grade AI solutions.
  • Establish world-class engineering, integration, deployment, operational, Level 3 support and service-management practices that ensure AI solutions are delivered quickly, operated reliably and continuously improved throughout their lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Governance and operating-company leaders to balance innovation, quality, speed, reuse and measurable business value while maintaining enterprise alignment.
  • Translate business priorities and strategic opportunities into engineering capacity, capability and execution plans that maximise impact, accelerate reliable delivery and support long-term scalability.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams spanning AI science, AI engineering, software engineering, integrations, operations and support, creating an environment where technical talent can grow, innovate and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  • Shape and develop a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organisation that embraces accountability, continuous learning, technical excellence and collaboration.


The essential requirements of the job include:


  • Proven experience in building DS, ML and AI solutions and in leading AI engineering, software engineering, platform engineering or technology delivery organisations in a complex global environment.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling multidisciplinary engineering teams that consistently deliver secure, reliable and reusable AI capabilities.
  • Deep understanding of AI solution development, cloud platforms, software architecture, APIs, integrations, CI/CD, reliability engineering and production operations.
  • Experience leading technical experts across multiple disciplines, geographies and organisational boundaries.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect engineering investment, delivery priorities and operational excellence to measurable business outcomes.
  • Integrity, strong team orientation and the ability to influence and engage stakeholders across business and technology functions through trust, collaboration and results.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


  • Building and scaling AI, software or digital solutions used across multiple business units or operating companies.

  • Working in life sciences, diagnostics, healthcare, advanced manufacturing or other regulated industries.

Våra produkter används av kunder världen över för forskning och produktion av biotekniska läkemedel, såsom insulin, vacciner samt behandlingar mot cancer och inflammatoriska sjukdomar.


Med över 1 600 medarbetare i Uppsala är vi stolta över att vara stadens största privata arbetsgivare och en viktig del av den globala life science-industrin.


På Cytiva finns en stor bredd av karriärmöjligheter. Vi rekryterar löpande talanger inom exempelvis produktion, forskning och utveckling, kvalitet, teknik, digitalisering och kommersiella funktioner. Varje år välkomnar vi ett stort antal examensarbetare och närmare 100 sommarjobbare till vår verksamhet i Uppsala. Många av dem väljer senare att återvända till Cytiva för examensarbete, traineeprogram eller fast anställning efter avslutade studier.


Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig på UTNARMs karriärmässa 2026 och vill gärna lära känna dig redan nu. Om du är intresserad av framtida möjligheter hos oss är du varmt välkommen att skicka in en öppen ansökan via denna annons. Genom att registrera ditt intresse kan vi hålla kontakten och informera dig om kommande sommarjobb, examensarbeten och andra spännande möjligheter inom Cytiva i Uppsala.


I din ansökan får du gärna berätta:

  • Vem du är och vad som motiverar dig.
  • Vilka områden inom life science eller teknik du brinner extra för.
  • Var i Cytivas organisation du ser dig själv utvecklas.
  • Vad du hoppas få ut av ett framtida sommarjobb eller examensarbete.

Passa också gärna på att besöka oss på UTNARM för att träffa våra medarbetare, ställa frågor om Cytiva och få en bättre inblick i hur vi tillsammans bidrar till att göra livsavgörande terapier tillgängliga för patienter världen över.


Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!


Meet Cytiva at the UTNARM Career Fair 2026!


Cytiva is a global leader in technologies and services that help accelerate the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies. Our products are used by customers around the world to research and produce biopharmaceuticals, including insulin, vaccines, and treatments for cancer and inflammatory diseases.


With more than 1,600 employees in Uppsala, Sweden, we are proud to be the city's largest private employer and an important contributor to the global life sciences industry.


At Cytiva, you'll find a wide range of career opportunities. We continuously recruit talented individuals across areas such as manufacturing, research and development, quality, engineering, digital solutions, and commercial functions. Every year, we welcome a large number of thesis workers and close to 100 summer interns to our Uppsala site. Many of them later return to Cytiva for thesis projects, graduate opportunities, or full-time positions after completing their studies.


We look forward to meeting you at the UTNARM Career Fair 2026 and would love to get to know you even before the event. If you are interested in future opportunities at Cytiva, we encourage you to submit an open application through this posting. By registering your interest, we can stay connected and keep you informed about upcoming summer internships, master's thesis projects, and other exciting opportunities at our Uppsala site.


In your application, we would love to learn more about:

  • Who you are and what motivates you.
  • The areas within life sciences, biotechnology, or engineering that you are most passionate about.
  • Where you see yourself developing within Cytiva.
  • What you hope to gain from a future internship or thesis project.

We also encourage you to visit our booth at UTNARM to meet our employees, learn more about Cytiva, and discover how we work together to help make life-changing therapies accessible to patients around the world.

We look forward to meeting you!


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Finance BP, Hongkong

Job Title

Finance BP, Hongkong

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:
• Leads the financial planning process for assigned business units, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term strategic planning, ensuring that all financial plans are aligned with corporate objectives and provide a clear roadmap for achieving financial targets.
• Conducts complex financial analysis, such as profitability analysis, margin analysis, and ROI assessments, to support high-impact business decisions and drive continuous improvement in financial performance.
• Works with limited supervision and broad guidelines, regularly applying independent judgment on matters of significance to drive project success and compliance.
• Acts as a trusted advisor to business leaders by providing strategic financial insights and recommendations, helping to shape business strategies and ensure that financial considerations are fully integrated into decision-making processes.
• Collaborates with cross-functional teams to evaluate the financial impact of business initiatives, such as product launches, market expansions, and cost-reduction programs, ensuring that financial risks and opportunities are fully understood and with compliance to financial accounting principles.
• Contributes to the monthly business review process by coordinating the preparation of financial materials, leading discussions on financial performance, and identifying actions needed to achieve financial goals.
• Evaluates investment business cases, including capital expenditures, R&D projects, and strategic marketing initiatives, ensuring that all financial assumptions are rigorous and that potential returns are aligned with the company's strategic priorities.
• Monitors the financial health of assigned business units by tracking key performance indicators, identifying emerging risks and opportunities, and working with business leaders to develop and implement corrective actions.
• Ensures compliance with internal controls, corporate policies, and regulatory requirements by supporting financial processes, maintaining accurate records, and supporting internal and external audits as needed.
• Leads or participates in initiatives to improve financial processes and systems, identifying opportunities for increased efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness in financial planning, reporting, and analysis activities.

Minimum required Education:
Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or equivalent.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor degree or above, major in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
  • Approximately five to eight years of progressive finance experience, including demonstrable business partnering with commercial or sales teams

  • Working knowledge of pricing and margin mechanics, and comfort supporting deal and tender decisions under time pressure
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Cantonese; Mandarin is a strong advantage given the Greater China reporting line
  • Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, able to build bridges between people
  • Hands on, pro-active, solution driven, very accurate but with sense of big picture

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, medical technology, or another regulated industry

  • Prior experience in a matrixed multinational, partnering across a regional and local reporting structure

Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

title: Data Scientist - Analytics Business Consulting
description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.


The Role

As a Data Scientist in our EU Analytics practice, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
You will play a pivotal role in building advanced analytical models and methodologies, integrating Veeva Data Cloud products with complex European healthcare data assets. You will drive innovation across our analytical offerings, ensuring Veeva remains at the forefront of data-led, tech-enabled Life Sciences commercial models. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to bridge technical modeling with practical business insights across European markets. You will take ownership of any of our analytics assets (e.g., design solution, manage expectations, status accountancy, impact measurement).

What You'll Do

  • Design, prototype, and scale advanced analytics solutions for Life Sciences customers across European markets
  • Process, harmonize, and connect Veeva Data Cloud products with diverse European healthcare data assets
  • Develop and apply statistical methodologies, machine learning, and AI models to solve complex, high-impact commercial and strategic business questions in the Life Sciences space
  • Build and design HCP precision engagement engines that connect disparate healthcare datasets integrated seamlessly with customer CRM information to enable personalized, data-driven targeting and activation
  • Collaborate closely in integrated, cross-functional teams alongside product managers, data engineers, operations, and consultants to deliver end-to-end analytical solutions and ensure continuous feedback and iteration
  • Maintain clear documentation of data methodologies, model architectures, and validation processes to ensure defensibility, scalability, and transparency across client engagements

Requirements

  • 2+ years of proven experience in data science, advanced analytics, or machine learning roles, preferably within Life Sciences, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare analytics
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams. Skilled at translating complex technical challenges to non-technical stakeholders, driving impactful problem-solving sessions, and championing a pragmatic approach to solution design
  • Strong technical expertise across Python, SQL, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI, with a proven ability to design and implement predictive models and intelligent algorithms that solve complex business problems
  • You bring Experience writing process documentation, technical specifications, and data collection guidelines to ensure quality, scalability, and repeatability across projects

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Veeva products
  • Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • Languages in addition to English
  • Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
  • Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
  • Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines) and automation tools such as Apache Airflow
  • Familiarity with cloud based computing resources such as AWS

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva
  • Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
  • Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day
#RemoteUK
#LI-Associate

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.
If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Christmas Toy Shop Worker
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

The Christmas Toy Shop Worker provides support to the Community and Family Services during the Christmas season on a temporary basis.

  • Receive and process donations of toys for distribution and provide assistance with packing and sorting toy donations.

  • Assist with registration as required

  • Working environment is typically in the office in generally agreeable conditions.
  • Ability to lift/move up to 20 lbs. (10 kg).

Education, Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Completed High School or equivalent

Experience and Skilled Knowledge Requirements:

  • A minimum of one (1) year of prior related experience working in community-based programs would be a definite asset.

  • Ability to stand for long periods of time

title: Engineering Lead Analyst – Test Automation Platform Engineering - VP
description:
The Engineering Lead Analyst – Test Automation Platform Engineering is a senior-level technical leadership role responsible for driving the architecture, implementation, management, operational support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise test management and automation platforms.


In this role, you will lead efforts to modernize test automation capabilities across the global technology ecosystem. You will architect end-to-end integration workflows, embed automated quality gates into enterprise CI/CD pipelines, and administer as well as operationally support both vendor and internally developed enterprise platforms (e.g., Core Performance Engineering / Performance Center, ALM-Quality Center, Zephyr Enterprise, CSDP / Octane).


Additionally, you will play a critical role in production operations—delivering tier-3 platform support to rapidly and safely troubleshoot, triage, and remediate performance and availability issues in complex, distributed production environments.


The ideal candidate blends deep hands-on expertise in software testing frameworks, modern DevOps pipelines, containerized infrastructure, message-driven integration, and robust operational resilience practices with strong governance, compliance, and stakeholder leadership skills.

Key Responsibilities


1. Platform Engineering & Operational Support

  • Install, configure, upgrade, administer, and support enterprise test management and performance engineering toolsets (e.g., Core Performance Engineering / Performance Center, ALM-Quality Center, Zephyr Enterprise, Core Software Development Platform [CSDP] / Octane).
  • Provide end-to-end operational support for hosted internally developed and vendor enterprise applications, establishing robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability.
  • Rapidly and safely troubleshoot, triage, and remediate performance, stability, and availability incidents in production and non-production environments while adhering to strict change management and operational risk protocols.
  • Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews, driving preventive actions to enhance platform resilience, scalability, and uptime.
  • Proactively monitor platform health, conduct capacity planning, and implement continuous system and operational enhancements.
  • Actively maintain software assets to remediate cyber security vulnerabilities, manage patch lifecycles, and enforce secure baseline configurations.

2. Architecture, Workflow & Integration

  • Architect robust workflows across Test Management systems to ensure full bidirectional traceability between business requirements, test plans, test execution, and defect lifecycles, meeting internal SDLC and audit standards.
  • Design, build, and deploy integration solutions and event-driven data synchronization pipelines across disparate systems using messaging technologies (e.g., Apache Kafka, REST APIs, Webhooks).
  • Package, deploy, and support containerized platform utilities and testing services within enterprise container platforms and CI/CD pipelines.

3. CI/CD & Test Automation Frameworks

  • Design and embed automated quality gates into DevOps CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Tekton, Harness).
  • Lead the design, development, and standardization of functional test automation frameworks, including Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Cucumber, Behave, and related test automation tools.
  • Partner with development, QA, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to establish seamless shift-left testing practices, continuous feedback loops, and automated regression suites.

4. Governance, Risk & Controls

  • Serve as a Technology Subject Matter Expert (SME) for internal and external stakeholders, contributing to the strategic roadmap for the Quality Engineering platform domain.
  • Provide direction and oversight to ensure compliance with firm-mandated controls, regulatory frameworks, information security standards, and audit requirements.
  • Appropriately assess risk when technical and business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding assets by adhering to enterprise policies, practicing sound judgment, and managing control issues transparently.
  • Ensure that disaster recovery (DR), business continuity planning (BCP), and failover procedures are validated and routinely tested.

5. Leadership & Collaboration

  • Influence engineering and architectural decisions through consultative advice, technical evaluations, and collaborative design reviews.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers and analysts, fostering technical excellence and continuous learning across engineering and operations.
  • Collaborate effectively across cross-functional, virtual, and global teams in a matrixed organizational structure.

Required Qualifications & Competencies

Experience & Background

  • 13+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or quality engineering automation within a large-scale, complex enterprise or global financial services environment.
  • Production Operations & Support: Proven track record providing operational support for enterprise-scale, hosted internally developed and vendor applications, with demonstrated expertise in safely troubleshooting, triaging, and remediating production performance and availability issues.
  • Demonstrated experience in incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), disaster recovery exercises, and operational process change and improvement.
  • Strong diagnostic, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex platform, infrastructure, and integration challenges under pressure.

Technical Skills & Platform Expertise

  • Test & Performance Management Tools: Deep administration and engineering experience with enterprise tools such as ALM-Quality Center, Zephyr Enterprise, Core Software Development Platform (CSDP) / Octane, or Core Performance Engineering (formerly Performance Center).
  • Test Automation & Frameworks: Solid experience architecting and building automated functional testing frameworks using BDD tools (Cucumber, Behave) and integrating them into automated test suites.
  • CI/CD & DevOps Automation: Practical experience embedding automated test execution and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as Jenkins, Tekton, or Harness.
  • Integration & Messaging: Proven experience developing integration services and data pipelines using Apache Kafka, message queues, and RESTful APIs.
  • Containerization & Cloud Native: Hands-on experience developing, packaging, and deploying containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift) within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Vulnerability Management & Reliability: Solid understanding of secure coding practices, CVE/vulnerability remediation, infrastructure security hardening, and high availability/resilience patterns.

Soft Skills & Leadership

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to prioritize competing initiatives, take end-to-end ownership, and deliver results under tight deadlines and high-pressure operational scenarios.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building capabilities in a global, matrixed operating model.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree / University Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Master’s Degree in a related technical discipline is preferred.

They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

title: Restoration Supervisor
description:

As a Restoration Supervisor, you'll guide teams through emergency response and restoration projects, ensuring quality, safety, and customer satisfaction every step of the way. As a Restoration Supervisor, you're at the center of the action. You'll monitor moisture readings, assess equipment needs, and ensure remediation procedures meet IICRC standards.   • Advanced understanding of water remediation procedures consistent with IICRC S-500 Standards
  • Strong knowledge of moisture reading instruments, drying sciences, and cleaning agents for specific losses such as sewage or mold claims
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, mobile devices, and relevant applications
  • Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills with coworkers, supervisors, and customers
  • Skilled in demolition, tear outs, and safe work practices with the ability to train others on technique and precaution
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • College certification in Environmental Studies, Environmental Technician, or related construction/building discipline, an asset
  • IICRC Certifications: Water Remediation Technician (WRT), Fire and Smoke Restoration Technician (FSRT), Applied Microbial Remediation Technician (AMRT),
  • Forklift certification, an asset

  • Valid driver's license and clean driving abstract
  • Fit test and other safety certifications

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Raytheon’s Data, Analytics, and AI organization is seeking a hands-on Senior Data Scientist to help turn complex factory and test data into insights and solutions that improve how we build products. In this role, you will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, and software teams to solve real manufacturing problems using statistics, machine learning, and data-driven applications. Your work will have a direct connection to production, from identifying the causes of process variation to developing predictive models and tools that help engineers make faster, better decisions.

You’ll engage across the full data science lifecycle: exploring large, multifaceted datasets, developing and validating models alongside domain experts, and helping transition successful solutions into production environments. You will also play a key role in guiding how our organization applies modern analytics and AI techniques within manufacturing.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the technical work and the problem-solving that happens when data meets the real world.

What You Will Do

  • Develop statistical and machine learning solutions that address manufacturing, test, quality, and production challenges

  • Explore large and complex datasets to identify patterns, process drivers, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

  • Build and deploy Python-based analytical and machine learning applications that are used by engineers and factory teams

  • Partner directly with engineers, operators, and technical stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into practical data solutions

  • Develop visualizations and analytical tools that make complex data easier to understand and act on

  • Help establish sustainable approaches for deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning solutions

  • Mentor other data scientists and engineers and contribute to the team's technical direction and best practices

  • Build deep expertise in factory and test data and use that knowledge to identify new opportunities for data science and automation

  • Your work will not stop at a notebook or prototype. Successful solutions will be used to influence real engineering and manufacturing decisions.

This is a hybrid role based in Tucson, Arizona.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires a University degree or equivalent experience and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience.
  • Professional experience using Python for data analysis, statistical modeling, or machine learning
  • Experience developing machine learning or advanced analytical solutions beyond academic or experimental projects
  • Strong understanding of applied statistics and quantitative analysis
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL
  • Ability to communicate technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing, engineering, test, quality, or other complex technical datasets
  • U.S. Citizen - The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more would be valuable:
  • Experience deploying or supporting machine learning models in production environments
  • Experience with Python libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, or scikit-image
  • Experience with statistical analysis tools such as Minitab, R, JMP, or SAS
  • Knowledge of machine learning lifecycle and MLOps practices, including model versioning, monitoring, evaluation, and tools such as MLflow
  • Experience with cloud-based data or machine learning environments such as AWS or Azure
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Experience applying large language models or generative AI to practical business or engineering problems
  • Experience mentoring other technical professionals or providing technical leadership

What We Offer

Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

title: Project Manager,  Supply Chain Tech Finance (REMOTE)
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Project Manager is responsible for leading the financial planning, governance, and operational execution of a complex Supply Chain Technology portfolio. This role serves as a key liaison between Technology, Finance, and business stakeholders, ensuring accurate financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and budget management across multiple initiatives and funding sources. The Project Manager is accountable for maintaining fiscal calendars, coordinating budgeting cycles, tracking operating and capital expenditures, monitoring Accounts Payable activities, and supporting financial variance analysis and reporting.

This position requires strong financial acumen, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships across cross-functional teams. The Project Manager partners closely with technology leaders, finance teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure financial commitments are met, risks are proactively identified, and portfolio investments align with strategic objectives. While supporting project delivery activities as needed, the primary focus of this role is the ongoing management, reporting, and governance of the financial health of a mixed technology portfolio.


Key Responsibilities:

  • 75% - Delivery & Execution - Establishes and executes effective communication with Project Stakeholders; Partners with stakeholders to lead the project planning effort, including the formulation of the project scope, definition of the project deliverables and the required delivery dates, creation of a logical work breakdown structure, and definition of major project milestones; Understands organizational/initiative goals and success criteria to apply to project work. Ability and understanding of project plans and development, risk identification & mitigation. Applies lessons learned to inform future initiatives; Creates, monitors, tracks, and adjusts project plans based on critical milestones for a project of group of initiatives; Assists in development, then executes change management process and activities within Technology organization; Works with stakeholders to determine and align dependencies, then proactively risk and issues via identification and mitigation plans.
  • 25% - Resource & Financial Management - Executes fiscal management and reporting for operational, product/business, technology, and vendor stakeholders; includes gross labor, capital spend, and non-labor forecasting for tracking, reporting, and variance analysis.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

  • Position Reports to Senior Director, Pro Paint.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.

  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel skills for financial analysis, reporting, and budget tracking.
  • Proficient knowledge of Tableau and data visualization/reporting tools.

  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, forecasts, financial reporting, and variance analysis.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior DevOps Engineer

Job Description

This role is based in Baner, Pune .

As a Azure DevOps & GitHub Administrator you would be responsible for administering and supporting Azure DevOps and GitHub environments, enabling CI/CD automation, and maintaining internal tools that support embedded development teams. You will manage repository configurations, pipelines, licenses, and integrations while working closely with development and QA teams to improve workflow efficiency, test automation, and platform reliability

Your Role

Azure DevOps Administration

  • Onboard new users by creating accounts, assigning access levels, and managing group memberships.
  • Maintain Azure Boards, team areas, iterations, and work item processes.
  • Create, update, and troubleshoot build and release pipelines, ensuring performance and reliability.

GitHub Repository Administration

  • Create and configure new repositories, permissions, and branch protections.
  • Support migration of repositories and associated issues, pull requests, and CI workflows.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize GitHub Actions workflows.
  • Integrate GitHub with tools such as Dependabot, Codespaces, and other DevOps extensions.

Test Automation

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for test automation using Azure Pipelines and GitHub Actions.
  • Support migration from manual tests to automated frameworks.
  • Collaborate with QA and development teams to improve automated test coverage and quality.

Tools Support

  • Learn, maintain, and enhance tooling used by embedded development teams.
  • Provide administration, troubleshooting, and development support for internal tools and integrations.

License Management

  • Assist in acquiring new licenses for compilers and development tools.
  • Track usage, renewals, and compliance of toolchain and software licenses.

You're the Right Fit If you have :

  • Bachelors in computer science / information technology engineering or equivalent with 6+ years of relevant work experience

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands‑on experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines).
  • Scripting experience in Python for automation and tooling.
  • Basic understanding of embedded systems and toolchains.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience with license management is a plus.

Nice‑to‑Have

  • Experience migrating repositories and CI configurations.
  • Familiarity with Docker, containerization, and artifact repositories.
  • Knowledge of security best practices for repositories and CI/CD pipelines.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
• Learn more about our business.

• Learn more about our purpose.

title: Senior Consultant Avant-Vente Modernisation Mainframe & IA H/F
description:

Activités d'avant-vente

  • Participer activement aux rendez-vous clients aux côtés des équipes commerciales.

Innovation & IA

  • Contribuer au développement de nouvelles offres associant Mainframe, modernisation et IA.
  • Assurer une veille des innovations du marché.


Who You Are

Expérience

  • 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans les systèmes d'information, l'architecture, le conseil ou les environnements Mainframe.
  • Expérience significative de la relation client et de l'avant-vente.
  • Capacité à présenter et défendre des recommandations auprès de décideurs tant en français qu’en anglais

Nous ne recherchons pas nécessairement un expert de l'exploitation Mainframe.

Nous recherchons avant tout un professionnel ayant travaillé avec les technologies Mainframe et capable d'en comprendre les architectures, les dépendances applicatives et les enjeux de modernisation.

  • COBOL
  • CICS
  • DB2
  • IMS
  • JCL
  • MQ
  • RACF
  • ZLinux
  • ...

Ainsi que des connaissances sur :

  • API Management
  • Intégration applicative
  • Architecture d'entreprise
  • Modernisation applicative
  • DevOps

  • Goût pour les échanges avec les clients.
  • Capacité à construire une vision de transformation cohérente plutôt qu'à résoudre uniquement des problématiques techniques.
  • Connaissance d'industries (Banque, Assurance, Grande distribution, ...)

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - David Solecki lab
description:
The Solecki Lab is building imaging-based biosensor platforms that makes chromatin states and cell polarity decisions visible in living neurons and experimentally queryable as cell-biological systems. We are looking for postdoctoral fellows who do not simply want to perform experiments but wants to help build the experimental framework for understanding how cell biological transitions unfold as neurons mature and assemble into brain circuits......by watching these processes happen in real time.

Are you a trainee who wants to be scientifically invested in defining cell states like chromatin organization or cell polarity beyond the limits of indirect molecular biology or biochemistry approaches? Postdoctoral researchers in the lab will carry out their own independent research projects and make use of live-cell biosensors, advanced microscopy, neuronal differentiation systems, acute perturbations, and quantitative image analysis in order to find out how intracellular state transitions are organized in developing neurons. The aim is not merely to apply existing tools, but to help in the development of new experimental approaches, including probes, assays, imaging strategies, and perturbation methods, that make previously invisible cell biological processes visible, measurable, and capable of being tested mechanistically.

Successful fellows will have the opportunity to define a major project within the lab’s broader effort to understand neuronal maturation, chromatin-state dynamics, polarity transitions, nuclear organization, and circuit assembly. Fellows will work closely with the PI and an interdisciplinary team to develop high-risk, high-reward experiments, generate first-author publications, present at national and international meetings, and build a scientific identity at the interface of developmental neurobiology, live-cell imaging, biosensor engineering, and quantitative cell biology.


Join a supportive multi-disciplinary lab comprised of biophysicists, optics experts, data scientists, cell-biologists and developmental neurobiologists that unravel how the brain is built during development. You will be on the ground floor of transformative biosensor platforms with exposure to cutting-edge imaging technologies like lattice light sheet or super-resolution platforms, data science core labs, and an unusually collaborative environment where new imaging probes, microscopy, and analytical methods converge on fundamental problems in brain development.


The Ideal Candidate will have:

  • A PhD in cell biology, biophysics, gene regulation, neuroscience or related discipline
  • Prior experience in live-cell imaging, super-resolution microscopy, and/or imaging probe development.
  • Familiarity with programming languages (e.g. R, Python) for data analysis
  • Strong record of peer-reviewed publications
  • Ability to independently design and execute experiments and interpret data
  • Ability for cogent experimental preparation, validation, documentation, and troubleshooting.

In your cover letter, please describe one experimental system, assay, protocol, or project that you personally helped build or improve. What was not working at first? What did you change? How did you know the system had become reliable? What discovery did it enable?


Contact To apply for this position, send a C.V., Description of Research Interests, Outline of Career Aspirations and the contact information of 3 referees to: David J. Solecki, PhD, Department of Developmental Neurobiology, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, 262 Danny Thomas Place, Memphis TN 38105, USA, david.solecki@stjude.org

title: Claims Specialist
description:
Why is Health Advocate a great place to work? For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day. Employees are given the training they need to do their jobs well, and they work with supervisors and staff who are supportive and friendly. Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

2025:

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

2024:

  • Excellence in Customer Service Awards: Organization of the Year (Small)

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

  • Best in Biz Awards: Most Customer-Friendly Company of the Year – Medium and large category (Silver)

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

Join Us as a Claims Resolution Champion

At Health Advocate, we’re on a mission to simplify healthcare and empower our members to navigate their benefits confidently. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact by resolving complex claims and advocating for those who need support, this is your chance to transform lives.

As a Claims Specialist, you’ll go beyond solving billing issues—you’ll serve as an advocate, educator, and problem-solver for our members. By leveraging your expertise in claims, benefits, and coordination of care, you’ll ensure timely resolutions that ease stress and deliver value. In this role, you’ll join a team that values collaboration, precision, and compassion.

What You’ll Do: Advocate, Resolve, Educate

This role is more than answering questions—it’s about being a trusted guide for our members. Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

  • Resolve Complex Claims Issues: Investigate billing discrepancies, identify errors, and coordinate resolutions among members, carriers, and providers for timely claim processing.
  • Coordinate Benefits Across Carriers: Manage cases involving Medicaid, Medicare, motor vehicle claims, and other benefit programs, ensuring proper coordination.
  • Educate and Empower Members: Help members understand their benefit plans, educate them on coverage details, and guide them through challenging claims scenarios.
  • Ensure Accuracy: Adhere to internal policies, procedures, and federal regulations to process claims in a precise and timely manner.
  • Collaborate and Escalate: Partner with team members and escalate unresolved issues to supervisors or carriers when necessary.
  • Support Team Growth: Mentor new team members, share best practices, and contribute to continuous process improvements.

Who You Are: A Detail-Oriented Advocate

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about helping others, thrives on solving challenges, and brings technical expertise to the table.

  • Experienced Professional: You have at least 2 years of experience in healthcare, customer service, or claims.
  • Problem-Solver: You excel at analyzing claims, identifying root causes, and proposing practical solutions.
  • Empathetic Communicator: You possess strong listening skills and the ability to guide members with care and patience, even in complex or emotionally charged situations.
  • Knowledgeable and Resourceful: Familiarity with plan documents, ACA guidelines, Medicare, COBRA, and benefits such as dental, vision, and behavioral health is a plus.
  • Tech-Savvy: You’re proficient in MS Word and Excel and comfortable using internal databases to document and track cases.

Why Health Advocate?

At Health Advocate, we don’t just resolve claims—we build trust and provide peace of mind. Here’s what you’ll gain by joining us:

  • Purpose-Driven Work: Be a key player in simplifying healthcare for members and making a real difference in their lives.
  • Tools for Success: Access advanced systems, comprehensive training, and the support of a collaborative team.
  • Competitive pay starting at $18.00 per hour.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy competitive pay, robust medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) with company match, PTO, and more.
  • A Culture of Care: Join a team that values empathy, innovation, and teamwork.

Your Next Move

Ready to transform challenges into resolutions and make healthcare easier for those we serve? Apply today and take the first step toward a rewarding career with Health Advocate!

Work Environment

This position is fully remote.

To ensure compliance with HIPAA requirements and protect member privacy, employees must maintain a dedicated workspace that supports confidential conversations and secure handling of sensitive information.

Applicants must have:

  • A private, HIPAA-compliant workspace where confidential member information cannot be viewed or overheard by others
  • Sufficient desk space to accommodate a dual-monitor workstation and related equipment
  • Reliable high-speed internet with a minimum download speed of 200 Mbps
  • The ability to work in a professional, distraction-free environment during scheduled work hours

Health Advocate provides the computer equipment, monitors, and other necessary technology required to perform the role.

Physical Requirements:
This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.

Mental and Cognitive Requirements:
The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.

Work Environment:
This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.
